Subject. Coal Situation.

Made by. D.P.S. Killingbeck Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

With regard to the coal situation prevailing
in Shanghai at the end of November, many of the
remarks in the report of October still hold good.
The future position of the local market still remains
very uncertain and local dealers are reluctant to
express opinions which may eventually prove incorrect
and misleading.

One important feature, however, is the
decrease in imports of bituminous coal to Shanghai
during the month under review.

Imports during September totalled approximately
140,000 tons; for October, 98,000 tons; whilst the
figure for November is as low as 50,000 tons. In
explanation of this fact, it is learned that, while
stocks of coal are actually available in Shantung,
Japan and Formosa, it is becoming increasingly
difficult to transport stocks. The exports from
these sources are under the control of Japanese
interests, who are compelled to charter only Japanese
ships for transport. As there is a very heavy
demand on Japanese shipping, it is thought probable
that imports in the near future may register a further
drop. There does not appear to be any possibility
of Indian coal being imported for some time to come,
as with the exchange being so unfavourable, it is
impossible to offer Indian coal at competitive prices.

Another point worthy of mention is that the
Shanghai Power Company have chartered an extra

THE KAILAN MINING ADMINISTRATION,
Shanghai, November 14, 1939.

18 // 39

E.T. Nash, Esq.,
Secretariat,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Mr. Nash,

With regard to your letter F. 30/12 of 7th November, it is extremely difficult to make any worthwhile observations as to the future coal position in this market. There are so many unknown factors which have an important bearing on the arrival of coal in this port, anyone of which, if guessed wrongly, can upset the general position considerably.

You ask me for my observations on the October Police Report.

The first paragraph is, I think, quite sound, and is in fact my own view of the situation.

Although the views expressed by the Hongay Sales and ourselves, as set forth in the second and third paragraphs of the report, appear contradictory, I do not think that they are necessarily incorrect.

From the point of view of Hongay Sales, who are operating almost entirely in a foreign currency, prices will fluctuate in accordance with exchange. They did moreover increase prices in September or early October to allow for the increase in freight rates which occurred at the outbreak of war in Europe and also for the depreciation in exchange. More recently their prices have dropped a little with the improvement of the dollar to 5d and more.

As far as we are concerned there has been no change in K.M.A. prices since 1st August and therefore some time we will have to make up for the very much higher cost of transporting coal from Chinwangtao to Shanghai.

It follows therefore that our two firms are looking at the picture from rather different angles.

As regards paragraph 4, I have referred already to the increase in shipping freight rates. The only point to note here is that it is hardly correct to say that rates averaged 3/ to 3/6d per ton during July to September; 4/-, 4/6, 5/-, per ton was much nearer the mark.

The last paragraph I should say was entirely correct.

You will note that I have skipped the question of whether there will be a shortage or not. In my own private opinion I feel that there may well be, and I give you a resumé of my reasons for so saying:-

If you would refer to a note I made for Sir Robert a short time ago, you will see that this market is dependent on ourselves, Japan, Tsingtao and India for its coal supplies. As far as I can see, Japan and Shantung are producing what was expected from them, but, as you will see from the Imports Table attached to the police report, nothing arrived from India, in October, except for the Power Company. With the present uncertainty over exchange, I think practically nothing

E.T. Nash 先生，
秘书处，
上海工部局，
上海。

亲爱的 Nash 先生：

关于您11月7日的来信 F. 30/12，要对本地市场未来的煤炭形势做出任何有价值的观察都极其困难。有许多未知因素对煤炭抵达本港具有重要影响，其中任何一个如果猜测错误，都会极大地扰乱总体形势。

您要求我对10月份的警务报告发表意见。

我认为第一段相当中肯，事实上这也是我对局势的看法。

虽然报告中第二段和第三段所述的恒义销售处（Hongay Sales）和我方的观点看似矛盾，但我认为它们不一定是不正确的。

从几乎完全使用外币运营的恒义销售处的角度来看，价格将随汇率波动。此外，他们在9月或10月初提高了价格，以应对欧洲战争爆发时发生的运费上涨以及汇率贬值。最近，随着美元汇率改善至5便士及以上，他们的价格略有下降。

就我方而言，自8月1日以来，开滦矿务总局（K.M.A.）的价格一直没有变化，因此我们迟早必须弥补从秦皇岛到上海运输煤炭的高昂成本。

因此，我们两家公司是从相当不同的角度来看待这一局面的。

关于第4段，我已经提到了航运运费的增加。这里唯一需要注意的是，说7月至9月的平均费率为每吨3先令至3先令6便士是不太准确的；每吨4先令、4先令6便士、5先令更接近实际情况。

我认为最后一段是完全正确的。

您会注意到，我跳过了是否会出现短缺的问题。在我个人的私下意见中，我觉得很有可能会出现短缺，我在此简述我的理由：-

如果您参考我不久前为 Robert 爵士写的一份备忘录，您会看到本市场的煤炭供应依赖于我方、日本、青岛和印度。据我所知，日本和山东的产量符合预期，但是，正如您从附在警务报告后的进口表中所见，10月份除了电力公司外，没有来自印度的货物到达。鉴于目前汇率的不确定性，我认为实际上没有什么

page_data.en:
2.

will arrive from India except for the Power Company, as a comparatively small fluctuation in the value of the dollar can make a considerable difference in the final selling price of coal, and until people feel a little bit more sure of the situation they will not take the risk of ordering one or two shipments if there is a chance that a week or so later a competitor will be able to get coal for $10 or $15 per ton less.

On the other hand I think that we are apt to be somewhat frightened of the word "shortage". It does not necessarily follow that people will suffer great hardship if they are unable to buy as much coal as they want. In the past coal has been reasonably cheap in Shanghai and people have not had to do much in the way of economising with it. If they find there is a shortage, or if prices become exorbitant, I am sure that a great deal can be done to get along without it, or rather, with very much reduced quantities. Moreover I believe a good deal can be done by mixing bituminous and anthracite coal so that if Hongay are able to keep regular supplies going, many people will be able to manage with the mixture and the requirements of the market will thereby be considerably reduced. In addition there is the factor that for some time now people have had at the back of their minds the idea that there might be a shortage this winter, and I believe that many firms have been putting aside coal against the cold weather season. In two or three cases that I know of, factories have up to three months' supply on hand, and, if this practice has been widely followed, there must be large reserves in Shanghai of which we have no record. In support of this statement I would say that the average consumption of coal in Shanghai over the first six months of the year was in the neighbourhood of 190,000 tons. In July, August and September, nearly 700,000 tons were issued from wharves, jumping the average up to over 230,000 tons for these three months. To a certain extent this increase was accounted for by additional supplies taken by the Power Company, nevertheless I feel that there may be something in the idea that this coal was not entirely for consumption but for stock.

I admit that if there is a shortage it is an easy step for this shortage to become acute, in which case the situation might become serious as it is by no means easy in these days to get fresh supplies quickly. During the past year, a shortage could have been remedied by importing supplies from India which would have arrived within, say, four to six weeks. Now, apart from the question of exchange, it is a different problem, for, although I believe there is still plenty of coal in Calcutta, there is a very definite dearth of ships to carry it. It may mean therefore that one would have to wait eight to ten weeks before getting any fresh supplies to alleviate an acute shortage, by which time the situation might have become really serious.

I have hesitated before going into this question in such detail and would like to emphasize again that this is only my private opinion and must not be taken as that of my firm. I am sending it along to you, however, for what it is worth, but would ask you, if you decide to pass it on to Sir Robert Calder-Marshall, to let him know that this only represents my personal view of the situation.

Yours sincerely,

L. Handley-Derry.

2.

除电力公司外，将从印度运抵，因为美元价值的较小波动就能使煤炭的最终售价产生相当大的差异，而在人们对局势感到更有把握之前，如果有可能在一周左右后竞争对手能以每吨低 10 或 15 美元的价格获得煤炭，他们就不会冒险订购一两批货物。

另一方面，我认为我们往往有点被“短缺”这个词吓到。如果人们无法买到他们想要的那么多煤炭，并不一定意味着他们会遭受巨大的困难。过去上海的煤炭价格相当便宜，人们无需在节约用煤方面做太多努力。如果他们发现出现短缺，或者价格变得过高，我相信可以做很多事情来在没有煤炭的情况下维持，或者说，在大幅减少用量的情况下维持。此外，我相信通过将烟煤和无烟煤混合使用可以取得很大成效，因此如果 Hongay（音译）能够保持定期供应，许多人将能够通过使用混合煤来应付，从而大幅减少市场需求。另外还有一个因素，即一段时间以来，人们心中一直存有今年冬天可能会出现短缺的想法，我相信许多商行一直在为寒冷季节储备煤炭。在我所知的两三个案例中，工厂手头有多达三个月的供应量，如果这种做法被广泛采用，那么上海必定存在大量我们没有记录的储备。为了支持这一说法，我要指出，今年上半年上海的平均煤炭消费量约为 190,000 吨。在七月、八月和九月，从码头发出的煤炭接近 700,000 吨，使这三个月的平均值跃升至超过 230,000 吨。在一定程度上，这一增长是由于电力公司增加了供应量，但我仍然觉得，这种煤炭并非完全用于消费，而是用于库存的说法可能有一定道理。

我承认，如果出现短缺，短缺很容易变得严重，在这种情况下，局势可能会变得严峻，因为在当今形势下，迅速获得新供应绝非易事。在过去一年里，可以通过从印度进口供应来弥补短缺，这些供应将在四到六周内运抵。现在，除了汇率问题外，情况有所不同，因为尽管我相信加尔各答仍有大量煤炭，但非常缺乏运输煤炭的船只。因此，这可能意味着必须等待八到十周才能获得任何新供应以缓解严重短缺，而到那时局势可能已经变得真正严重。

我在如此详细地探讨这个问题之前曾犹豫不决，并希望再次强调，这仅是我的个人意见，不得被视为我所在公司的意见。然而，我还是将其发送给您，供您参考，但如果您决定将其转交给 Robert Calder-Marshall 爵士，请让他知道这仅代表我对局势的个人看法。

此致，

L. Handley-Derry.

Coal Situation.

A noteworthy feature of the coal situation prevailing in
Shanghai at the end of October is the fact that imports of bituminous
coal to Shanghai show a decided drop compared with imports during
September. October imports of bituminous coal totalled 98,060 tons
as against the September total of 141,600 tons. Importers attribute
this to the fact that dealers were ordering coal in very small
quantities when the rate of exchange depreciated and, as supplies
are ordered some considerable time before reaching Shanghai shortage
has only now occurred. Information as to the probable condition
of the local coal market in the immediate future is of a very
contradictory nature.

Messrs. Hongay Coal Sales Ltd. are inclined to the view
that no shortage of coal will be noticed during the winter and that,
in the event of the rate of exchange remaining as it is, no serious
increase in prices will be registered.

Messrs. Kailan Mining Administration on the other hand
anticipate a coal shortage during the winter months and a price
increase although responsible officials of both companies state
that is is almost impossible to forecast the coal situation with
any degree of accuracy.

One factor that will have an effect on the price of coal
is the increased freight charges. During July, August and
September, freight charges averaged 3/- to 3/6d. sterling per ton.
During October, the average cost per ton reached 8/6 whilst ship-
owners are now reluctant to undertake transport of coal at less
than 10/- per ton.

The view is held that should a shortage of coal become
apparent, profiteering on the part of small dealers will ensue.

十月底上海 prevailing 的煤炭形势的一个显著特征是，与九月份相比，上海烟煤进口量明显下降。十月份烟煤进口总量为 98,060 吨，而九月份总量为 141,600 吨。进口商将此归因于这样一个事实：当汇率贬值时，经销商订购的煤炭数量非常少，而且由于供应是在抵达上海前相当长一段时间订购的，因此短缺直到最近才出现。关于近期本地煤炭市场可能状况的信息性质非常矛盾。

Hongay Coal Sales Ltd.（音译）倾向于认为，冬季不会出现煤炭短缺，并且如果汇率保持不变，价格不会出现严重上涨。

A noteworthy feature of the coal situation prevailing in Shanghai at the end of September is the fact that local dealers do not place much credence in reports which recently appeared in local papers to the effect that an acute shortage of coal will be felt in Shanghai during coming months.

It is probable that large consumers, such as factories, etc. may experience difficulty in obtaining sufficient supplies, as they have been using Calcutta slack coal. Owing to the high cost of this coal, and the increased freight and insurance charges, dealers will not risk importing Coal from India. Should importers order large stocks of Calcutta coal, they would be liable to lose money should the imports of slack coal from Japanese occupied areas suddenly increase. There is a tendency on the part of dealers who have stocks of slack coal, to sell this only in small quantities in the hope of obtaining better prices.

Shantung coal is reported to be coming to Shanghai only in very small quantities, owing to better markets being available at other centres in the Yangtsze Valley.

9月1日上海的煤炭形势略显动荡，煤炭经销商和进口商不愿就近期煤炭市场的可能状况发表意见。据估计，目前上海可供一般使用的库存相当于一个月的供应量，且普遍认为在未来几个月内本地将出现短缺。

由于汇率条件不利，印度煤炭仅以足以满足即时需求的数量进口到上海，因为进口商认为在外汇如此动荡的情况下风险太大。

目前，有一定数量的日本煤炭运抵上海，但如果国际局势导致运抵上海的供应中断，短缺可能会变得严重。据说日本煤炭在新加坡和马尼拉的市场比在上海更受欢迎。

Date... April 3. 1939.
Subject.. Coal situation in Shanghai on April 1, 1939.
Made by.. D.S. Henchman....................Forwarded by.. C. Crawford

Most important detail relevant to the coal
situation in Shanghai on April 1, 1939, is the
marked increase in arrivals from the Japanese controlled
mines in Shantung. Dealers in coal from this area
anticipate that, from now on, they will be able to
export up to 1,000 tons daily from Tsingtao. Some of
this coal will, no doubt, find its way to the
gradually awakening industrial concerns on the Yangtse
River; it is expected, however, that large quantities
will reach Shanghai.

Following the closure of the mines during
Chinese New Year, K.M.A. imports have returned to
normal while arrivals of anthracite from the Hongay
and other Indo-China mines, show little change.

Total stocks show a few thousand tons reduction,
but, despite this, supplies are considered to be ample.
Prices when compared with figures available on
March 1, remain unaltered.

Ample stocks of both Indian and Japanese coal
together with an almost negligible increase in the local
rate of consumption, account for the very marked falling
off in coal imports for the month of December. Though
Kailan Mining Administration and Hongay arrivals remain
constant, those from Calcutta, Miki and Liukiang show a decrease
of from forty to fifty per cent. Interesting to note is the
arrival of one shipment of bituminous coal from Shantung,
the first to arrive from this source since the outbreak of
hostilities in 1937 and the more remarkable when the
hitherto insuperable difficulties in obtaining rolling
stock at the mines and wharfage facilities in Tsingtao,
are considered.

Prices for K.M.A. and Hongay coal are unaltered
while a reduction in respect of Indian and Japanese coal
is noted.

Subject Coal Situation on January 1, 1939.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. Clausen

Ample stocks of both Indian and Japanese coal together with an almost negligible increase in the local rate of consumption, account for the very marked falling off in coal imports for the month of December. Though Kailan Mining Administration and Hongay arrivals remain constant, those from Calcutta, Miki and Liukiang show a decrease of from forty to fifty per cent. Prices for K.M.A. and Hongay coal are unaltered while a reduction in respect of Indian and Japanese coal is noted.

Coal Situation on December 1st, 1938.
---------------------------------------

Large imports of bituminous coal from abroad again
mark the coal situation for the month of November and the
comparatively small issues of this coal indicate that big
stocks are held at the wharves on the Pootung side of the
Whangpoo. A slight decrease in arrivals of Indian coal
is more than offset by increased shipments of Japanese fuel;
this latter coal, however, is, for the greater part, intend-
ed for consumption by Japanese operated concerns and thus
is unlikely to affect the general market.

Hongay anthracite imports, roughly speaking, remain
constant but no arrivals are reported from Dongtreu; ship-
ments from other mines in Indo-China show no increase.
H.B.K. imports of hard coal from Liukiang are greatly in
excess of the figures for last month but, as in the case
of the soft coal mentioned above, are mainly for Japanese
consumption.

An item of interest is the intended importation by the
Shanghai Power Co. of some 40,000 tons of deteriorated soft
coal from the U.S.A.

Prices, with the exception of a small decrease in the
cost of Indian coal, are constant with the figures quoted
for the end of October.

Total stocks, due to the increase in Japanese
importations, are probably slightly in excess of the
tonnage recorded last month.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY
No. F 200 / 146 (11)
Date 11 / 28

November 3, 1933

Failure to treat reports concerning coal situation
in a confidential manner.

During the past two months whilst engaged in
collecting information for the monthly coal situation
reports I have received vehement and embarassing
complaints from two sources regarding the passing-on of
information.

Due to keen competition in the coal trade,
businessmen, while prepared to assist the Police, do not
wish information to be passed on to rivals and I therefore
respectfully submit that it would be advisable to request
persons to whom Police reports are forwarded, not to show
the said reports to the employees or management of firms
engaged in the importation or sale of Coal. Apart from
the point of view of ethics, it should be noted that unless
discretion is observed in this matter, it will be impossible
to obtain information in the future.

Certified true copy.

H. C. Eardley
KZB/

Subject......... Coal Situation on November 1, 1938.

Made by.. D.S. Henchman         Forwarded by C. [Signature]

The month of October, where coal is concerned, has
been marked by a considerable increase in the importation
of bituminous fuel from abroad. Issues of this coal have
been small and the general indication is that large stocks
are being stored. Efforts have been made to ascertain
the approximate tonnage of these stocks, particularly in
respect of coal stored in Pootung, and detailed figures are given
later in this report.

Due to the above mentioned importations of foreign
fuel, the prospect of a coal shortage in Shanghai this winter
continues to diminish and so great has been the increase in
arrivals of Indian coal that the price has fallen by $2 per
ton. The decrease has brought forth a cry of protest from
dealers in other than Calcutta coal; these gentlemen having
imported coal from South Africa, Australia and elsewhere,
presumably intended to store it until a real shortage was
felt and the price consequently rose.

Importations of bituminous coal from Kailan and of
anthracite from Indo-China show little variation, and prices,
through slightly increased in the case of the former, remain
unaltered where the latter is concerned.

由于上述外国燃料的进口，上海今年冬季煤炭短缺的前景继续减弱，印度煤炭到货量的增加幅度之大，导致价格每吨下跌了2美元。这一下跌引发了非加尔各答煤炭经销商的抗议呼声；这些先生们从南非、澳大利亚等地进口了煤炭，大概是打算将其储存起来，直到出现真正的短缺，价格随之上涨。

Regarding the coal situation in Shanghai on
October 1, there is little change to report.
Large quantities of soft coal continue to arrive
from abroad; India, Australia and Formosa, in that order,
being the main sources of supply.
Kailan Mining Administration imports show a
slight increase while those of Hongay Sales, anthracite,
remain steady. Shipments of anthracite have also been
received from Liukiang, Mentoukuo, Kebao and Dongtreu.
K.M.A. continue to supply coal in limited quantities
to old clients at prices which do not vary from those
quoted for September. Hongay Sales' prices for anthracite
remain steady while this company has also decided to limit
quantities sold. Costs for Indian, Australian and
Formosan coal are high.
With the weather remaining warm no shortage is,
as yet, felt in Shanghai, while stocks continue to be
sufficient to supply all reasonable demands.

关于10月1日上海的煤炭局势，几乎没有变化可报。
大量软煤继续从国外运抵；印度、澳大利亚和台湾依次为主要供应来源。
开滦矿务局的进口量略有增加，而鸿基销售公司的无烟煤进口量保持稳定。还收到了来自柳江、门头沟、克宝（音译）和东潮的无烟煤发货。
开滦矿务局继续以与九月份报价不变的价格，向老客户限量供应煤炭。鸿基销售公司的无烟煤价格保持稳定，同时该公司也决定限制销售量。印度、澳大利亚和台湾煤炭的成本较高。
由于天气依然温暖，上海目前尚未感到短缺，同时库存继续足以满足所有合理需求。

Subject Coal Situation on September 1, 1938.
Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by W Logan A.S.I

A steady increase for the past month in the
quantity of coal imported from other than the Kailan or
French Indo China areas and a decrease in the amount
imported by the Kailan Mining Administration are the salient
features of the coal situation existing in Shanghai at the
end of August.

Stocks due to the extra imports referred to above
are probably in excess of those available at the end of
July while prices for both bituminous coal (other than
K.M.A.) and anthracite are higher.

Due to increased demands from Japan, labour trouble,
difficulties in land transport and the fact that as winter
approaches, the Company's coal commands a higher price in
the North than in Shanghai, it is anticipated that K.M.A.
imports will continue to decrease. As far as this company
is concerned a stage has already been reached when it is
possible only to fill existing contracts and small orders
from customers of long standing.

As K.M.A. supplies decrease so will imports from
abroad increase and though a serious shortage is not
expected, prices, as exchange fluctuates or the chance to
profiteer improves, will soar considerably higher than they
are at present. Providing the present rate of exchange
is maintained it is considered that no noticeable change
in the situation, either as regards quantity or prices,
will be evident until the end of October. By this time
K.M.A. if continuing to reduce their shipments, will have
considerably diminished their stocks and the opportunity
will have arrived for dealers in bituminous coal from

过去一个月，来自开滦或法属印度支那以外地区的煤炭进口量稳步增加，而开滦矿务局的进口量减少，这是八月底上海煤炭局势的显著特征。

由于上述额外进口，库存可能超过七月底的水平，而烟煤（开滦矿务局除外）和无烟煤的价格均较高。

由于日本需求增加、劳工纠纷、陆路运输困难，以及随着冬季临近，该公司煤炭在北方的价格高于上海这一事实，预计开滦矿务局的进口量将继续减少。就该公司而言，目前已达到只能履行现有合同和长期客户的小额订单的阶段。

随着开滦矿务局供应量的减少，国外进口量将增加，虽然预计不会出现严重短缺，但随着汇率波动或投机机会改善，价格将大幅飙升，远高于目前水平。如果维持目前的汇率，预计在十月底之前，无论是数量还是价格，局势都不会出现明显变化。届时，如果开滦矿务局继续减少发货，其库存将大幅减少，烟煤经销商的机会也将到来

At this time (end of October), a shortage of

in the past relied on both Shanse and Honan as well as

The foreign consumer will probably suffer more

should be no difficulty in obtaining at reasonable cost
large quantities of slack coal or dust, from which the

Chinese are manufactured.
It will be seen, then, from the foregoing
paragraphs that during the coming winter the consumer of
bituminous coal while not experiencing any serious difficulty
in obtaining his supplies, may expect to be the victim of
a certain amount of profiteering and that the owner of
the apartment house or block of flats will experience
some difficulty in obtaining anthracite in sufficient
quantities to enable him to operate his steam heating
devices at full pressure.

此时（十月底），无烟煤也可能出现短缺。过去依赖山西、河南以及洪崖（Hongay）供应无烟煤的经销商可能会发现，在需求最旺盛的冬季月份，由于上述地区目前无法提供货源支持，洪崖将难以满足几乎整个上海市场的需求。
外国消费者受到的影响可能比中国消费者更大，因为值得注意的是，虽然烟煤要价高昂，且足量的无烟煤可能难以获得，但以合理成本大量获取用于制造中国人使用的“煤球”或小型蛋形煤饼的散煤或煤粉，应该没有困难。
因此，从前述段落可以看出，在即将到来的冬季，烟煤消费者在获取供应方面虽不会遇到任何严重困难，但可能会遭受一定程度的牟取暴利之苦；而公寓大楼或联排住宅的所有者在获取足量无烟煤以使其蒸汽供暖设备全压运行方面，将会遇到一些困难。

    Hongay Sales Ltd. have in stock some 70,000 tons
of anthracite coal distributed in the French Concession and
Settlement, which quantity, it is expected, will be increased
to about 80,000 tons by the end of the current month. It
is the policy of Hongay Sales Ltd. to import as much coal as
possible during the summer months when freights are lower
than later in the year and also to have sufficient in stock
to meet the first heavy orders of the cold season, hence
the reason for the large stock in hand. Information to
hand indicates that Nee Tai Shing and Dah Loong Shing Coal
Companies have distributed in the Settlement and French
Concession some 18,000 tons of anthracite coal while there
is a further 5,000 tons of anthracite coal believed to be
distributed in various retail shops in the Settlement and
French Concession. It is to be understood that the figures
quoted above , with the exception of the paragraph referring
to the imports from India, etc., are exclusive of the stocks
held by the Power Company, Gas Company and Water Works Co.

    There does not appear to be any reason to anticipate
an acute shortage of coal in view of the fact that stocks
to augment the shortage of K.M.A. Coal are obtainable in
India, etc., but the adverse rate of exchange and high cost
of freight will tend to force the price of the commodity up
considerably beyond the present sale of prices.

        In addition to the above quantity, there are

the Shanghai Power Company and the Japanese authorities,
the remainder being used to supply the local needs.
The approximate consumption of bituminous coal during
May was roughly 15,000 tons, exclusive of that used by
utility concerns.
        The recent strike at the Kailan Mining
Administration mines was responsible for a shortage of
approximately one month's output of coal and this
combined with the demands of the Japanese that Kailan
Mining Coal be directed to Japan, plus the coal which
the Railways in North China are claiming, renders it
difficult for the Kailan Mining Administration to
adequately supply local demands. To offset the shortage
of Kailan Mining Administration bituminous coal,

page_data.en:
（批：This Page for information 21/7/41）
At the meeting of the Coal Sub-Committee held on Thursday, July
17, 1941, at 2.15 p.m., there are:-
Present:
Sir Robert Calder-Marshall, K.B.E. (Chairman)
Messrs. A.E. Fraser
L.W. Hutton
Y. Ohashi
L.M. Pharis
R. von der Crone, and
T. Beesley (Secretary)
（批：a 7855(2) / 8 M）
Absent:
Messrs. J. du Rivau
T. Wakimoto

The Chairman states that at the last meeting it was
decided to increase the Terms of Reference of the Committee and
he saw the Secretary & Commissioner General in connection with
members' suggestion that Mr. Pharis and Mr. Toyokawa be invited
to serve on the Committee. It was agreed to extend an invitation
and on behalf of members he welcomes Mr. Pharis to the Committee.
Continuing the Chairman says that Mr. Toyokawa felt that he had
not sufficient knowledge of the subject and would be unable to be
of much assistance and therefore declined the invitation.

The Chairman refers to a memorandum, submitted by
Mr. Fraser since the last meeting, on bituminous coal. The memo-
randum, which has been circulated to members, shows a shortage of
approximately 700,000 tons of coal per annum which must be made up
in some way. Members agree with the Chairman that the whole solu-
tion depends on the release of supplies from Japanese sources and
the question of securing tonnage.

Mr. Pharis states that the matter is wholly a shipping
problem and is of the opinion that were bottoms made available
supplies of coal could be obtained in small quantities from the
South.
page_data.zh:
（批注：本页供参考 1941年7月21日）
在1941年7月17日（星期四）下午2时15分举行的煤炭小组委员会会议上，出席者如下：

出席：
罗伯特·考尔德-马歇尔爵士，K.B.E.（主席）
A.E. 弗雷泽先生
L.W. 赫顿先生
大桥先生 (Y. Ohashi)
L.M. 法里斯先生
R. 冯·德·克罗内先生，以及
T. 比斯利先生（秘书）
（批注：a 7855(2) / 8 M）

缺席：
J. 迪里沃先生
T. 若本先生

主席指出，在上次会议上决定扩大委员会的职权范围，他就委员们建议邀请法里斯先生和丰川先生加入委员会一事，与秘书兼总办进行了接洽。会议同意发出邀请，他代表各位委员欢迎法里斯先生加入委员会。主席接着说，丰川先生觉得自己对该议题了解不足，无法提供太多帮助，因此婉拒了邀请。

主席提及弗雷泽先生自上次会议以来提交的一份关于烟煤的备忘录。该备忘录已分发给各位委员，显示每年约有70万吨的煤炭短缺，必须以某种方式弥补。委员们同意主席的看法，即整个解决方案取决于能否从日本方面释放供应以及能否获得航运吨位的问题。

法里斯先生表示，这完全是一个航运问题，他认为如果有船只可用，可以从南方少量获取煤炭供应。

page_data.en:
2.

The Chairman asks Mr. Ohashi whether he has any
information in regard to Shantung Coal and Mr. Ohashi replies
that he is unable to give any more information as to how much
Shantung Coal is likely to be made available. He enquires
as to the progress of the negotiations between the Shanghai
Power Company and Mr. Toyokawa and Mr. Pharis informs Members
that the position is quite satisfactory; all locally have
agreed to the release of coal for the Power Company and if
negotiations succeed then with the coal from outside sources
the Company's position should be satisfactory. The matter
now lies with Tokyo. In the meantime the Power Company's coal
situation is getting somewhat critical and by the end of this
month unless supplies are secured the Company will only have
from 112,000 to 115,000 tons of coal.

Mr. Hutton refers to the figures given in a recent
Police report. Members agree that they appear to be in-
complete, one item omitted being the shipments received by
the Kailan Mining Administration. Mr. Hutton is of the view
that there should be no difficulty in the Police obtaining
particulars of the arrivals of all shipments and in obtain-
ing a check, if this is not already done, on their informa-
tion from the Customs House. It is also pointed out that the
Police figures do not include Pootung stocks.

Members agree that the position as regards Anthracite
coal is fairly satisfactory.

Mr. Ohashi asks what the exact figure of requirements
of bituminous coal is, i.e. that needed from Japanese sources.

After full discussion members agree that, excluding
Shanghai Power Company's needs, Shanghai requires approximately
35,000 tons of bituminous coal per month in addition to what is
at present arriving.

Mr. Ohashi enquires whether the Council could use
its influence to charter ships. Mr. Hutton explains
page_data.zh:
2.

主席询问大桥先生是否有关于山东煤炭的信息，大桥先生回答说，他无法提供更多关于可能有多少山东煤炭可供使用的信息。他询问上海电力公司与丰川先生谈判的进展，法里斯先生告知各位委员，情况相当令人满意；本地各方已同意向电力公司释放煤炭，如果谈判成功，加上来自外部来源的煤炭，该公司的状况应该是令人满意的。此事现在取决于东京方面。与此同时，电力公司的煤炭状况变得 somewhat critical（有些危急），除非能确保供应，否则到本月底该公司将只有112,000至115,000吨煤炭。

赫顿先生提及最近一份警务处报告中给出的数据。委员们同意这些数据似乎不完整，其中遗漏的一项是由开滦矿务总局收到的装运量。赫顿先生认为，警务处在获取所有到货的详细情况方面应该没有困难，如果尚未这样做的话，还可以从海关获取信息进行核对。还有人指出，警务处的数据不包括浦东的库存。

委员们同意，无烟煤的状况相当令人满意。

大桥先生询问烟煤需求的确切数字是多少，即需要从日本方面获得的数量。

经过充分讨论，委员们同意，除上海电力公司的需求外，上海每月除了目前到达的数量外，还需要大约35,000吨烟煤。

大桥先生询问工部局是否能利用其影响力租船。赫顿先生解释了

page_data.en:
3.
the difficulties in securing tonnage and Mr. Beesley remarks
that recently in connection with the bringing of rice supplies
difficulty was experienced in securing any space. Mr. Ohashi
further enquires whether the British Ministry of Shipping
could be asked to free certain ships for Shanghai and the
Chairman answers that the Ministry must decide on what is
in its opinion of first importance and under existing condi-
tions there is, he feels, very little or no likelihood of any
tonnage being made available. The Japanese have, however,
some tonnage which might be got.

Mr. Fraser suggests that perhaps the Council as an
International Body could arrange for the charter of the
Yugoslav vessel S.S. "Tonislav" (8,000 tons) lying idle in
the Whangpoo. Mr. Pharis remarks that an endeavour has been
made by the Power Company and other interests to secure
charterage of this ship but there are complications.

Mr. Ohashi states that the Council can work on the
assumption that coal will be released by the Japanese authori-
ties if shipping is made available. The Chairman and Mr.
Hutton remark that if the Japanese will release some ships
it would relieve the situation. Mr. Ohashi suggests that the
Council should invite someone who knows the shipping situation
to assist and Mr. Beesley replies that expert advice was
obtained on the question of chartering ships for the shipment
of rice but under the conditions which still exist nothing
could be done. Mr. Pharis states that in order to bring
35,000 tons of coal per month to Shanghai, about 12,000 tons
of shipping would be required.

In reply to the Chairman, Mr. Ohashi states that
there is very little hope of getting any Japanese tonnage.
Mr. Ohashi, in answer to the Chairman, says that no definite
guarantee can be given that coal will be made available from
Japanese sources.
page_data.zh:
3.
获得吨位的困难，比斯利先生评论说，最近在运进大米供应方面，很难获得任何舱位。大桥先生进一步询问是否可以要求英国航运部为上海释放某些船只，主席回答说，航运部必须决定什么是其认为最重要的，而在现有条件下，他觉得几乎没有或不可能有任何吨位可供使用。然而，日本人有一些可能弄到的吨位。

弗雷泽先生建议，也许工部局作为一个国际机构，可以安排租用停泊在黄浦江上闲置的南斯拉夫船只“Tonislav”号轮船（8,000吨）。法里斯先生评论说，电力公司和其他利益方曾努力争取租用这艘船，但存在复杂情况。

大桥先生表示，工部局可以基于这样的假设开展工作：如果提供航运，日本当局将释放煤炭。主席和赫顿先生评论说，如果日本人释放一些船只，局势将会缓解。大桥先生建议工部局邀请一位了解航运情况的人士协助，比斯利先生回答说，在为大米运输租船的问题上已经获得了专家建议，但在仍然存在的条件下，什么也做不了。法里斯先生表示，为了每月向上海运送35,000吨煤炭，大约需要12,000吨的航运能力。

在回答主席的提问时，大桥先生表示，获得任何日本吨位的希望非常渺茫。大桥先生在回答主席时说，不能给予明确的保证，即能从日本方面获得煤炭供应。

page_data.en:
4.

Mr. Fraser informs members that even if shipping
is available, as things stand, the Kailan Mining Administra-
tion cannot supply any more coal to Shanghai from their mines.
Members unanimously agree that the Council should
be asked to approach the British and Japanese Authorities for
their assistance in securing tonnage to bring supplies of
coal to Shanghai, working on the assumption that this coal
will be made available by Japanese sources.
The meeting terminates at 2.55 p.m.
page_data.zh:
4.

弗雷泽先生告知各位委员，即使有航运可用，就现状而言，开滦矿务总局也无法从其矿井向上海供应更多煤炭。
委员们一致同意，应请工部局接触英国和日本当局，寻求他们在确保将煤炭供应运至上海的航运吨位方面的协助，并基于这些煤炭将由日本方面提供的假设开展工作。
会议于下午2时55分结束。

SECRETARIAT,
28th May, 1941.

To Members of Supplies Committee:

It has been informally conveyed to me that the
Japanese authorities might be willing to assist in bringing
coal supplies to Shanghai provided that the Council was able
to take steps in the direction of distribution and control of
price. The Japanese authorities desire information as to
Shanghai's monthly needs and as to present methods of distribu-
tion, etc.

I would like to suggest that a small Committee be
formed to go into this question. I suggest that it should
be composed of, say, three members of the Supplies Committee,
a representative nominated by the Kailan Mining Administration,
and a representative nominated by the Hongay Sales, Ltd. I also
suggest that Mr. R. Toyokawa be invited to serve on the Committee.
Mr. Toyokawa is conducting the negotiations in regard to coal
for the Shanghai Power Company, and his assistance would probably
be very valuable in order to prevent overlapping.

G. Godfrey Phillips,

Secretary & Commissioner General.

秘书处，
1941年5月28日。

致供应委员会委员：

有人非正式地向我传达，日本当局可能愿意协助将煤炭供应运至上海，前提是工部局能够采取步骤进行分配和控制价格。日本当局希望了解上海的月度需求以及目前的分配方法等信息。

我建议成立一个小型委员会来研究这个问题。我建议该委员会由供应委员会的三名成员、开滦矿务总局提名的一名代表以及宏亚销售有限公司 (Hongay Sales, Ltd.) 提名的一名代表组成。我还建议邀请 R. 丰川先生担任委员会委员。丰川先生正在就上海电力公司的煤炭问题进行谈判，他的协助对于防止工作重叠可能非常有价值。

G. 戈弗雷·菲利普斯，

秘书兼总办。

At the meeting of the Fuel Sub-Committee held on Tuesday, January 16,
1940, at 2.15 p.m., there are:-

Present:
Sir Robert Calder-Marshall, K.B.E. (Chairman)
Mr. J. N. Bates
Mr. L. Handley-Derry
Mr. L. M. Pharis
The Assistant Commissioner of Police (Mr.R. .Yorke)
Mr. J. B. Watson (Public Works Department)
The Deputy Treasurer (Mr.E. P. Oliver), and
The Assistant Secretary (Mr.E. T. Nash).

Coal Situation. The Chairman refers to a report made by Mr. Handley-
Derry at the beginning of this month on the subject of the coal situa-
tion, as also to a Police report which confirms the views expressed by
Mr. Handley-Derry.

The Chairman states that Mr. Handley-Derry's view is that for
the remainder of the winter a fairly acute coal shortage will be felt.
Mr. Handley-Derry states that it is difficult to estimate
accurately the needs of the small domestic users of coal. The K.M.A.
had increased their January supplies, but the February shipment would
be below normal. The position is being aggravated by the increased
demand from factories. On the other hand it is probable that certain
of these factories have been laying in stocks. Mr. Handley-Derry
states that Japanese firms who in the past have supplied coal to the
general market are now concentrating entirely on requirements of
Japanese users and Japanese controlled factories, so that yet one more
source of supply has now been withdrawn from the average consumer.
Moreover, the consumption requirement of the Japanese market in
Shanghai is itself increasing considerably. For the time being,
therefore, the K.M.A. will possibly be the only coal available for the
general foreign and Chinese market, and this demand cannot be met by
the K.M.A. alone.

Mr. Pharis estimates that the K.M.A. cannot meet more than
possibly half the coal requirements. He does not believe that any
relief can be afforded until the coal mines are working up-river and

DA: 18; ' 40 Ju
page_data.zh:
在1940年1月16日（星期二）下午2时15分举行的燃料小组委员会会议上，出席者如下：

出席：
罗伯特·考尔德-马歇尔爵士，K.B.E.（主席）
J. N. 贝茨先生
L. 汉德利-德里先生
L. M. 法里斯先生
警务处助理处长（R. 约克先生）
J. B. 沃森先生（工务处）
副财务长（E. P. 奥利弗先生），以及
助理秘书（E. T. 纳什先生）。

煤炭状况。主席提及汉德利-德里先生在本月初就煤炭状况所作的一份报告，以及一份证实汉德利-德里先生所表达观点的警务处报告。

主席表示，汉德利-德里先生的观点是，在冬季剩余时间里，将会感到相当严重的煤炭短缺。汉德利-德里先生表示，很难准确估计小型家庭用户的煤炭需求。开滦矿务总局 (K.M.A.) 增加了1月份的供应量，但2月份的装运量将低于正常水平。工厂需求的增加加剧了这一局势。另一方面，某些工厂可能一直在储备库存。汉德利-德里先生表示，过去向一般市场供应煤炭的日本公司现在完全专注于日本用户和日本控制的工厂的需求，因此普通消费者又少了一个供应来源。此外，上海日本市场本身的消费需求也在大幅增加。因此，暂时来说，开滦矿务总局可能是面向一般外籍和华人市场的唯一煤炭来源，而这一需求单靠开滦矿务总局无法满足。

法里斯先生估计，开滦矿务总局最多只能满足可能一半的煤炭需求。他不相信在内河上游和北方的煤矿恢复生产之前能提供任何缓解。

DA: 18; ' 40 Ju

page_data.en:
-2-
up North. It does not appear likely, however, that the up-river mines
will be supplying until next Summer. As to the Power Company require-
ments, they are being satisfied from India and the Company is attempting
to build up a three months' stock. Indian coals are also available to
the Gas Company and possibly firms who combine to obtain their own ship-
ments from India. With regard to Indian supplies, Mr. Pharis states
that these also meet with difficulties in view of the increased con-
sumption by the Steel Industry in India. He adds that local cotton
mills are also increasing their demand for coal. Mr. Pharis emphasizes
the difficulty caused by the freightage problem, which is in itself
responsible for greatly increased prices of Indian coal and Hongsay coal.
As regards the ability of dealers to make their own arrangements for the
importation of Indian coal, Mr. Pharis states that such financing would
be beyond the means of most dealers. The cost of importing coal from
South Africa, Australia and the U.S.A. is prohibitive. From Vancouver
Island the recent cost was Canadian Dollars 17 per ton. For U.S. coal
U.S.$18.50 per ton, and Australian coal would cost about C.N.$180 per ton
Mr. Handley-Derry states that he has knowledge that one
firm of considerable size is already making arrangements to import its
own Indian coal and that others are trying to arrange their own imports.
He feels that over the next few weeks certain of the big users would
probably have to get together to obtain coal from India, notwithstanding
the very high price. These big users would appear to be able, in the
last resort, to care for their own needs, but it is the small householder
who is confronted with great difficulty. One supplier for domestic
requirements, (Nee Tai Shing) has however arranged for a supply of Indian
coal at the end of February, at a price from $130 to $140, which he
feels is beyond the capacity of many of the small users to pay.
The Chairman states that whilst many of the larger users and
factories can by combining, probably care for their own needs, the small
user is confronted with considerable difficulty. He enquires as to the
possibility of certain of the supplies available being reserved for the
use of the small householders, but members generally find no means to
make this differentiation in favour of the small householders.
page_data.zh:
-2-
然而，内河上游的煤矿似乎不太可能在明年夏天之前开始供应。至于电力公司的需求，正由印度方面满足，该公司正试图建立三个月的库存。煤气公司也可以使用印度煤炭，或许还有一些联合起来自行从印度装运的公司也可以。关于印度供应，法里斯先生表示，鉴于印度钢铁工业消费量的增加，这些供应也面临困难。他补充说，本地棉纺厂也在增加对煤炭的需求。法里斯先生强调了运费问题造成的困难，这本身导致印度煤炭和洪山煤炭价格大幅上涨。关于经销商自行安排进口印度煤炭的能力，法里斯先生表示，这种融资超出了大多数经销商的能力范围。从南非、澳大利亚和美国进口煤炭的成本高得令人望而却步。从温哥华岛进口的近期成本为每吨17加元。美国煤炭为每吨18.50美元，澳大利亚煤炭约为每吨180中国元 (C.N.$)。
汉德利-德里先生表示，据他所知，一家规模相当大的公司已经在安排自行进口印度煤炭，其他公司也在尝试安排自己的进口。他认为，在接下来的几周内，某些大型用户可能不得不联合起来从印度获取煤炭，尽管价格非常高。这些大型用户似乎最终能够照顾到自己的需求，但面临巨大困难的是小住户。然而，一家家庭用煤供应商（尼泰盛 (Nee Tai Shing)）已安排在2月底供应印度煤炭，价格在130至140元之间，他认为这是许多小用户无力支付的。
主席表示，虽然许多大型用户和工厂可以通过联合可能照顾到自己的需求，但小用户面临着相当大的困难。他询问是否有可能将某些可用供应保留给小住户使用，但委员们普遍发现没有办法做出这种有利于小住户的区分。

page_data.en:
-3-

Mr. Pharis states that little relief can be afforded until
the China coal mines are fully supplying again. He states that repre-
sentations to the Japanese would seem to be precluded by reason of the
fact that Japan itself is short of coal.

Mr. Handley-Derry states that the supplies from Shantung are
monopolised for Japanese users.

The Committee Secretary states that the only point of satis-
faction is that the Committee is not meeting at the insistence of
public representations to the Council as to a coal shortage. He adds
that he believes that the Council's main concern is that the wheels of
Industry should be kept moving and that it is less concerned with the
deprivation of warmth of individual householders, owing to lack of
domestic coal supplies.

Summarizing the discussion, the Chairman states that there
would appear to be little that the Committee can do and no recommenda-
tion that it can frame, in which view he is supported by members.
It is decided that the only thing to be done is to continue to watch
the matter.

Fuel Oil. Mr. Bates states that there is no difficulty in respect of
the supplies and stocks of Fuel oil, which can be made available in
large quantities.

The meeting terminates at 3.15 p.m.

R. CALDER-MARSHALL

CHAIRMAN.

E. T. NASH
COMMITTEE SECRETARY.
page_data.zh:
-3-

法里斯先生（Mr. Pharis）表示，在中国煤矿完全恢复供应之前，很难提供多少救济。他指出，鉴于日本自身煤炭短缺，似乎无法就此事向日本方面提出交涉。

汉德利-德里先生（Mr. Handley-Derry）表示，来自山东的供应品被垄断供日本用户使用。

委员会秘书表示，唯一令人满意的一点是，委员会并非因公众就煤炭短缺问题向工部局提出诉求而被迫召开会议。他补充说，他认为工部局主要关心的是保持工业运转，而对于因家用煤炭供应不足导致个别住户缺乏取暖的问题，则较少关注。

主席在总结讨论时表示，委员会似乎无能为力，也无法提出任何建议，委员们对此表示支持。会议决定，唯一要做的事就是继续监视事态发展。

燃料油。贝茨先生（Mr. Bates）表示，燃料油的供应和库存没有任何困难，可以大量提供。

会议于下午3时15分结束。

R. CALDER-MARSHALL

主席

E. T. NASH
委员会秘书

At the meeting of the Fuel Supplies Sub-Committee held on Tuesday,
October 3, 1939, at 2.15 p.m., there are:-
Present:
Sir Robert Calder-Marshall, K.B.E. (Chairman)
Mr. J.N. Bates

Mr. L.M. Pharis

(Mr. N.W.B. Clarke)
The Deputy Treasurer (Mr. E.P. Oliver) and
The Assistant Secretary (Mr. E.T. Nash).

Coal Situation. The Chairman states that the meeting is convened
with the object of ascertaining whether there has been any change
in the situation since the meeting three weeks ago. Mr. Handley-
Derry states that there does not appear to be much change in the
coal situation. September imports have been normal, approximating
150,000 tons, of which coal from India approximates 50,000 tons.
A new aspect in the matter is the possibility of supplies from
Shantung; a fairly reliable source stating that a supply for use
in Shanghai and the lower Yangtsze of 210,000 tons for the seven
months from September to March is aimed at. Whilst it is not
clear as to how much of this supply is earmarked for special
Japanese needs, it is possible that such needs will absorb two-
thirds, leaving one-third for ordinary domestic needs. Summariz-
ing, he states that it is his belief that domestic supplies will
be sufficient, though prices may be prohibitive.

Mr. Pharis states that there is no export prohibition
of Indian coal, but that there are shipping difficulties and an
increase of shipping rates. However, it is generally believed
that the shipping tonnage position will ease. As to the Power
Company's needs, he states that they are satisfactorily met.
The Company has 170,000 tons in storage, which, with shipments
arranged, will take care of the Company's consumption and render

At the meeting of the Fuel Supplies Sub-Committee held on Wednesday,
September 13, 1939, at 2.15 p.m. there are:

Present:
Sir Robert Calder-Marshall, K.B.E. (Chairman)
Mr. J. N. Bates
Mr. L. Handley-Derry
Mr. L. M. Pharis
The Deputy Commissioner of Police (Mr. T. Robertson)
The Deputy Commissioner of Public Works
(Mr. N.W.B. Clarke)
The Deputy Treasurer (Mr. E.F. Oliver) &
The Assistant Secretary (Mr. E.T. Nash).

Coal Situation. The Chairman explains that the object of the meeting
is to review the situation as regards fuel supplies in Shanghai. A
Police report is submitted giving a survey of the coal situation as
on September 1, from which it is noted that the total stock in
Shanghai comprises 160,000 tons held on the wharves, mostly Japanese
wharves, and 117,000 tons stored elsewhere in the Settlement and the
French Concession.

The Police report states that the coal situation prevailing
in Shanghai on September 1 is somewhat unsettled and coal dealers and
importers are reluctant to voice their opinions as to the likely
state of the coal market in the immediate future. It is estimated
that stocks at present available for general use in Shanghai represent
one month's supply and it is held probable that a shortage will be
felt locally during the next few months. Owing to the unfavourable
exchange conditions Indian coal is only being imported into Shanghai
in quantities sufficient to meet the immediate demand as importers
consider that the risk is too great whilst foreign exchange is in
such an unsettled condition. At present, quantities of Japanese coal
are reaching Shanghai, but should the international situation cause
a stoppage of supplies reaching Shanghai, the shortage will probably
be acute. Japanese coal is said to find more favourable market in
Singapore and Manila than in Shanghai. Considerable quantities of
coal from Shantung are expected in readiness for the coming winter.

在1939年9月13日（星期三）下午2时15分举行的燃料供应小组委员会会议上，出席人员如下：

出席者：
罗伯特·卡尔德-马歇尔爵士（Sir Robert Calder-Marshall），K.B.E.（主席）
J. N. 贝茨先生（Mr. J. N. Bates）
L. 汉德利-德里先生（Mr. L. Handley-Derry）
L. M. 法里斯先生（Mr. L. M. Pharis）
警务处副总监（T. 罗伯逊先生 Mr. T. Robertson）
工务处副总监
（N.W.B. 克拉克先生 Mr. N.W.B. Clarke）
副财务处长（E.F. 奥利弗先生 Mr. E.F. Oliver）及
助理秘书（E.T. 纳什先生 Mr. E.T. Nash）。

煤炭情况。主席解释说，会议的目的是审查上海的燃料供应情况。会上提交了一份警务报告，概述了截至9月1日的煤炭情况，从中注意到，上海的总库存包括堆放在码头（主要是日本码头）的16万吨，以及储存在租界和法租界其他地方的11.7万吨。

警务报告指出，9月1日上海的煤炭局势有些动荡，煤炭经销商和进口商不愿就近期煤炭市场的可能状况发表意见。据估计，目前上海可供一般使用的库存代表一个月的供应量，人们认为在未来几个月内本地将会感到短缺。由于汇率条件不利，进口商认为在外汇如此动荡的情况下风险太大，因此只进口足够满足即时需求的印度煤炭进入上海。目前，有一定数量的日本煤炭运抵上海，但如果国际局势导致运抵上海的供应中断，短缺可能会非常严重。据说日本煤炭在新加坡和马尼拉的市场比在上海更受欢迎。预计将有大量来自山东的煤炭运到，以备即将到来的冬季之需。

page_data.en:
2.

Mr. Handley-Derry submits statistics showing that Shanghai
consumes approximately 2 million tons of coal per year (from 1/7/38
to 30/6/39) the Kailan Mining Administration supplying about 48%/ the
(977,000 tons),
remainder consisting of 30% imported coal (610,000 tons), 20% Japanese
and Formosan coal (418,000 tons), and 2% Shantung coal (38,000 tons).
Of the 610,000 tons of "imported" coal, 292,000 were for the Power and
Gas Companies. He expects that the K.M.A. would continue to supply
as much coal in the coming year as it has in the past, i.e. about
977,000 tons, and points out the possibility that, owing to unfavour-
able exchange, the Shanghai market would not be able to afford the
importation of foreign coal. This might result in a shortage during
the coming year. On the other hand, he feels that consumption in
Shanghai for the coming year may not reach the 2 million ton mark, as
industry and shipping are severely affected by the currency factor.
In his view there is a probability of decreased coal consumption in
Shanghai. Consequently it is possible that the demand could be met
by K.M.A. and Japan with the assistance of Shantung.

In answer to the Chairman, Mr. Handle,-Derry states that
Shantung is an unknown quantity. It is possible to obtain from this
province 400,000 tons during the coming winter, but it is difficult
to say how much will reach Shanghai or will be available for other
than Japanese uses. He adds that he will investigate the possibili-
ties of obtaining increasing supplies from North China.

Mr. Pharis states that the supply to his company (the
Shanghai Power Company) has so far been well maint.ined - roughly
50,000 tons per month from the K.M.A., India and U.S.A. The Company
has built up a storage, the present stock being 110/112,000 tons.
Three shiploads are on their way from Calcutta, so that at the end
of this month the Company will have a total stock of 125,000 tons to
keep it going till the end of November. The Company's supply consists
of 50% imported coals and 50% K.M.A. The chances of obtaining
supplies from Tsingtao under present conditions are remote, as the
stocks are needed in Japan. Indo-China coal is good for household

汉德利-德里先生提交的统计数据显示，上海每年消耗约200万吨煤炭（从1938年7月1日至1939年6月30日），其中开滦矿务总局（Kailan Mining Administration）供应约48%（97.7万吨），其余由30%的进口煤（61万吨）、20%的日本和台湾煤（41.8万吨）以及2%的山东煤（3.8万吨）组成。在61万吨“进口”煤中，有29.2万吨是供给电力公司和煤气公司的。他预计开滦矿务总局在来年将继续供应与过去一样多的煤炭，即约97.7万吨，并指出由于汇率不利，上海市场可能无力负担外国煤炭的进口。这可能导致来年出现短缺。另一方面，他觉得上海来年的消费量可能达不到200万吨的水平，因为工业和航运受到货币因素的严重影响。在他看来，上海煤炭消费量下降的可能性很大。因此，需求有可能由开滦矿务总局和日本方面在山东的协助下得到满足。

回答主席的提问时，汉德利-德里先生表示，山东是一个未知数。在这个冬天有可能从该省获得40万吨煤炭，但很难说有多少能运到上海，或者有多少可用于非日本用途。他补充说，他将调查从华北获得更多供应的可能性。

法里斯先生表示，对其公司（上海电力公司）的供应迄今为止保持良好——每月大约从开滦矿务总局、印度和美国获得5万吨。该公司已建立库存，目前库存为11万至11.2万吨。三船煤炭正从加尔各答运来，因此到本月底，该公司总库存将达到12.5万吨，足以维持运营至11月底。该公司的供应由50%的进口煤和50%的开滦煤组成。在目前条件下，从青岛获得供应的机会渺茫，因为库存需要供应日本。印度支那煤炭适合家庭

3.
use but not suitable for Power purposes. Up-river supplies are non-
existent. The prices of Australian coal at present are prohibitive.
The Company bought some South African coal, which was cheaper than
Australian coal, but has not purchased any more since as it was not
possible to obtain the kind needed. If foreign supplies are cut off,
the solution would be to request the Council to regulate the consump-
tion of power. Mr. Pharis adds that he feels the situation is satis-
factory at present. He would however favour another meeting in two
weeks' time to consider the position. With regard to the Shanghai
Gas Company, it is noted that this Company has made arrangements to
ensure an adequate supply for its own requirements.

Replying to the Chairman, Mr. Handley-Derry states that no
supply has come from up-river but on the contrary some 8/10,000 tons
a month are being transported from Shanghai to places like Soochow
and Wusih for industrial uses.

Mr. Bates enquires whether any coal has come from the Anhwei
mines on the Yangtsze. Mr. Pharis states that there has been no coal
from these mines for at least a year, due to damage caused by the
hostilities.

Gasolene & Fuel Oil. Mr. Bates states that the total stock of
gasolene stored at the main installations of foreign oil companies
is approximately 6 million gallons. In addition there are approxi-
mately 250,000 gallons in underground tanks attached to kerbside pump
outfits (including pumps on private premises). The estimated daily
offtake for the French Concession and the Settlement is approximately
35,000 gallons. There is no danger regarding supplies from abroad,
there being no shortage of tanker ships unless they are affected by
submarine warfare.

With regard to fuel oil, Mr. Bates states that the stocks
at main installations of Diesel and Solar oil are in the vicinity
of 50,000 tons. The estimated daily offtake is approximately 117
tons. This includes the French Tramway Co., which alone accounts
for 75 tons.

使用，但不适合发电用途。上游供应不存在。目前澳大利亚煤炭的价格高得令人望而却步。该公司购买了一些南非煤炭，其价格比澳大利亚煤炭便宜，但此后未再购买，因为无法获得所需种类。如果外国供应被切断，解决办法将是请求工部局管制电力消费。法里斯先生补充说，他觉得目前的局势令人满意。但他倾向于两周后再开一次会以审议局势。关于上海煤气公司，据悉该公司已做出安排，以确保其自身需求得到充足供应。

回答主席的提问时，汉德利-德里先生表示，没有供应来自上游，相反，每月约有8,000至10,000吨煤炭从上海运往苏州和无锡等地用于工业用途。

贝茨先生询问是否有煤炭来自长江沿岸的安徽煤矿。法里斯先生表示，由于战事造成的破坏，至少一年内没有从这些煤矿获得煤炭。

汽油和燃料油。贝茨先生表示，储存在外国石油公司主要设施中的汽油总库存约为600万加仑。此外，路边加油装置（包括私人场所的泵）附带的地下油箱中约有25万加仑。法租界和公共租界的估计每日提取量约为3.5万加仑。来自国外的供应没有危险，除非受到潜艇战的影响，否则油轮船舶并不短缺。

关于燃料油，贝茨先生表示，柴油和太阳能油（Solar oil，一种轻质燃料油）主要设施的库存约为5万吨。估计每日提取量约为117吨。其中包括法国电车公司，仅该公司就占75吨。

Mr. Bates adds that the average stocks of fuel oil held
by important consumers are estimated as follows:-

French Tramways - 2 months' supply
F.M.C. Buses - 3 weeks' "
C.G.O.C. - 2 " "
Bakeries - 3/4 days' "
Heating Installations - 10 days' supply.

Mr. Clarke enquires, in view of the high price of coal, as
to the possibilities of conversion from coal to fuel oil use. Mr.
Bates states that there were some conversions in the past, but that
economically fuel oil cannot compete with coal. Mr. Pharis states
that such conversion at the Power Company's plant would be prohibited
by the costs of boiler plant alterations.

In summing up the Chairman states that the position as
regards gasolene and fuel oil is very satisfactory. He suggests
and members agree that the coal situation be reviewed again a
fortnight hence, on Friday, September 29, at 2.15 p.m.

The meeting adjourns at 3.10 p.m.

克拉克先生鉴于煤炭价格高昂，询问从煤炭转换为使用燃料油的可能性。贝茨先生表示，过去曾有一些转换，但在经济上燃料油无法与煤炭竞争。法里斯先生表示，电力公司工厂进行此类转换将被锅炉设备改造的成本所禁止。

主席在总结时表示，汽油和燃料油的状况非常令人满意。他建议并经委员们同意，于两周后的9月29日（星期五）下午2时15分再次审查煤炭情况。

会议于下午3时10分休会。

September 13, 1939.

PETROLEUM FUEL SITUATION - GASOLENE/FUEL/DIESEL OIL.

(A) GASOLENE:
(1) Stocks in the hands of foreign oil companies as at 7th September were approximately 6,000,000 A.G. These stocks are stored at main installations outside the Settlement area.
(2) The estimated daily offtake for the French Concession and Shanghai Settlement is approximately 35,000 A.G.
(3) Estimated stocks in situ, i.e. in underground tanks attached to kerbside pump outfits (including pumps on private premises) are approximately 250,000 A.G; that is to say approximately one week's normal requirements. In the case of an emergency the major portion of the stocks could, if necessary, be earmarked for essential services. In addition the A.P.C. have emergency storage at Messrs. Price's (China) Ltd, Robison Road, for 19,000 A.G. This storage is empty at the moment. During the last emergency in August 1937 dumps in drums were arranged at certain points, notably on the Race Course.

(B) FUEL OIL:
(1) Stocks at main installations of Diesel and Solar oil are in the vicinity of 50,000 tons.
(2) The estimated daily offtake, all sources and grades of fuel oil, is approximately 117 tons. This includes the French Tramway Co. which alone accounts for 75 tons.
(3) Average stocks held by important consumers are estimated as follows:
French Tramways - 2 months' supply
F. M. C. buses - 3 weeks' "
C.G.O.C. - 2 " "
Bakeries - 3/4 days' "
S. M. C. - 1 week's "
Heating Installations - 10 days' "
(4) The A. P. C. have spare land on Medhurst Road in which they could accommodate 1,000 tons of fuel oil in drums as an emergency reserve. At the moment 50 tons of Solar oil is stored at this point.

1939年9月13日。

石油燃料状况 - 汽油/燃油/柴油。

(A) 汽油：
(1) 截至9月7日，外国石油公司手中的库存约为6,000,000加仑（英制）。这些库存储存在租界区域外的主要设施中。
(2) 估计法租界和上海公共租界的每日消耗量约为35,000加仑（英制）。
(3) 估计现场库存，即附属于路边加油泵装置（包括私人场所的泵）的地下油罐中的库存，约为250,000加仑（英制）；也就是说，大约相当于正常情况下一周的需求量。在紧急情况下，如有必要，大部分库存可指定用于基本服务。此外，亚细亚火油公司（A.P.C.）在罗宾森路（Robison Road）的礼和洋行（Messrs. Price's (China) Ltd）处有19,000加仑（英制）的应急储备。目前该储备为空。在1937年8月的上一次紧急状态期间，曾在某些地点安排了桶装堆存，特别是在跑马厅。

(B) 燃油：

(4) 亚细亚火油公司（A. P. C.）在麦特赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）有空地，可作为应急储备容纳1,000吨桶装燃油。目前该地点储存有50吨太阳牌煤油。

page_data.en:
NOTE

The total consumption of coal in Shanghai from 1st July
1938 to 30th June 1939 amounted to just over two million tons,
of which the Administration supplied about 48% (977,000 tons).
The other 52% was made up of imported coals 30% (610,000 tons),
Japanese, Formosan etc. 20% (418,000 tons), Shantung 2%
(38,000 tons).

It is presumed that the Administration will continue to
supply as much coal in the coming year as it has in the past.
Nothing is known about the Japanese coal policy here, but for
the sake of argument I am assuming that they will also sell a
similar quantity as last year. It therefore remains to consider
only imports of foreign coal. Shantung I am neglecting for
the moment.

Of the 610,000 tons imported, 292,000 tons were imported
by the Shanghai Power Company and Shanghai Gas Company for their
own use. This leaves, say, 320,000 tons, or, if the consumption
of the two public utility companies referred to is excluded, some
24% of the market. (2,000,000 tons less K.M.A. and outside
supplies to S.P.C. and S.G.C. amounting to 648,000 tons equals
1,352,000 tons).

The last quotation of which I have heard for Calcutta
coal was around 16 Rs., which at an exchange of 21/₈ works out
at about $73.00 a ton c.i.f. Shanghai, or, say $78.00 ex-wharf.
The point is, can anybody afford to pay this price, which by
the time delivery charges, profit etc. have been added, would
be well over $80.00, unless very heavy mixing with anthracite
dust is done.

It is not fair to argue that if Hongay can sell at over
$100 per ton others can; as Hongay is purely for domestic supply
and is consumed at the rate of one ton every week or two weeks,
while outside bituminous coals are for industrial use and will
be consumed at the rate of one or two or five tons a day.
page_data.zh:
注

1938年7月1日至1939年6月30日期间，上海的煤炭总消费量略超过两百万吨，其中行政当局供应了约48%（977,000吨）。其余52%由进口煤炭构成，其中30%（610,000吨）为进口煤，20%（418,000吨）为日本、台湾等地煤炭，2%（38,000吨）为山东煤炭。

据推测，行政当局将在来年继续像过去一样供应尽可能多的煤炭。此处对日本的煤炭政策一无所知，但为了讨论起见，我假设他们也将出售与去年相似数量的煤炭。因此，只需考虑外国煤炭的进口。我暂时忽略山东煤炭。

在进口的610,000吨中，有292,000吨是由上海电力公司和上海煤气公司为其自身使用而进口的。这就剩下，比如说，320,000吨，或者，如果排除上述两家公用事业公司的消费量，则约占市场的24%。（2,000,000吨减去开滦矿务局（K.M.A.）以及对上海电力公司和上海煤气公司的外部供应量共计648,000吨，等于1,352,000吨）。

我所听到的加尔各答煤炭的最新报价约为16卢比，按21又1/8便士的汇率计算，折合上海到岸价（c.i.f.）约为每吨73.00美元，或者说，码头交货价（ex-wharf）约为78.00美元。问题是，除非与无烟煤粉进行大量混合，否则在加上交付费用、利润等之后，价格将远超80.00美元，是否有人负担得起这个价格。

认为如果鸿基（Hongay）能以每吨100多美元的价格出售，其他人也能做到，这种论点是不公平的；因为鸿基煤纯粹用于家庭供应，消耗速度为每周一到两吨，而外地烟煤用于工业用途，消耗速度为每天一吨、两吨或五吨。

page_data.en:
2.

If people cannot afford this price it means that the
Shanghai market will be short of coal to the extent of 25% and
possibly more. If the Power Company also finds the price is
too high and manages to come to some arrangement with the
Japanese, Japanese supplies for the general market will
accordingly be reduced.

The position is worse again if the Japanese coal
supplies are studied. At a guess, at least two-thirds of
their imports were for their own use and for stock. If the
non-Japanese market is considered alone therefore, its con-
sumption figure will be seen to have fallen below the figure
of 1,300,000 tons to, say, 1,000,000 tons, in which imported
coals would then bulk to the extent of 33%.

The above figures cannot be absolutely accurate, but
they are the best available for the time being.

The following points must also be taken into considera-
tion:-

(1) Consumption in Shanghai for the coming year will
probably not reach the two million tons mark, as industry and
shipping are very severely affected by the currency and there-
fore import position. Consequently it is possible that the
demand could be met by K.M.A. and Japan with the assistance
of Shantung.

(2) Shantung is an entirely unknown factor which could
easily make up the tonnage previously supplied by foreign coals.
However, no one apart from the Japanese can say what the policy
of these mines will be, and possibly even they cannot, as so
much depends on the railway situation. Recent monthly arrivals
in Shanghai have been:-

January .... 3,000 tons      May     ....20,000 tons
February.... -                June    .... 3,000 "
March     ....17,000 tons     July    .... -
April     ....52,000 "        August  ....19,000 tons
                      September to date.... 5,900 tons
page_data.zh:
2.

如果人们负担不起这个价格，这意味着上海市场将出现25%甚至更多的煤炭短缺。如果电力公司也觉得价格太高，并设法与日本人达成某种安排，那么面向一般市场的日本供应量也将相应减少。

如果研究日本煤炭供应情况，形势会更糟。据猜测，其进口量的至少三分之二是供其自身使用和储备。因此，如果仅考虑非日本市场，其消费数字将从1,300,000吨降至，比如说，1,000,000吨，在这种情况下，进口煤炭的比例将增至33%。

上述数字不可能绝对准确，但它们是目前可用的最佳数据。

还必须考虑以下几点：-

(1) 上海来年的消费量可能达不到两百万吨的水平，因为工业和航运受到货币及因此导致的进口状况的严重影响。因此，需求有可能由开滦矿务局（K.M.A.）和日本方面在山东煤炭的协助下得到满足。

(2) 山东是一个完全未知的因素，很容易弥补此前由外国煤炭提供的吨位。然而，除了日本人之外，没有人能说清这些煤矿的政策是什么，也许连他们自己也不能，因为这很大程度上取决于铁路状况。近期每月抵达上海的情况如下：-

一月 .... 3,000吨      五月     ....20,000吨
二月.... -                六月    .... 3,000 "
三月     ....17,000吨     七月    .... -
四月     ....52,000 "        八月  ....19,000吨
                      九月至今.... 5,900吨

page_data.en:
3.

(3) The attached statement gives a summary of the
stock position at the beginning of last year, at 1st January
1939, and for the last three months, excluding Kailan coal.
It will be seen that there has been a very considerable increase
in Japanese controlled coals and a decrease in others. At
present 85% of the stocks in Pootung are in Japanese hands as
against 62% on 1st January. Actually the coal on Japanese
wharves is by no means all for commercial use; a part of it,
(how much I do not know), is the property of Japanese Naval
and Military authorities.

In addition to these figures there is a certain amount
in stock in the Settlement and Concession, but this amount all
told cannot be more than 30,000 tons, including small dealers
and coal shops.

It is difficult to know what conclusions to draw from
the above, as there are so many unknown factors. I personally
do not believe that the situation, with the exception of that
of the public utility companies, is immediately serious, but
it does, without doubt, require careful watching: the main
points being:-

(a) The position in Shantung.
(b) the probable decrease in consumption in Shanghai.
(c) Indian coal prices, Calcutta freight rates and
the general availability of supplies from this
source.
page_data.zh:
3.

(3) 附件报表总结了去年年初、1939年1月1日以及最近三个月的库存状况，不包括开滦煤炭。可以看出，日本控制的煤炭大幅增加，而其他煤炭减少。目前，浦东库存的85%掌握在日本人手中，而1月1日时为62%。实际上，日本码头上的煤炭并非全部用于商业目的；其中一部分（多少我不清楚）是日本海军和军事当局的财产。

除了这些数字外，租界和法租界内也有一定数量的库存，但包括小商贩和煤店在内，总量不超过30,000吨。

很难从上述情况得出什么结论，因为未知因素太多。我个人认为，除公用事业公司外，局势并不立即严重，但这无疑需要密切关注：主要点在于：-

(a) 山东的局势。
(b) 上海消费量可能的下降。
(c) 印度煤炭价格、加尔各答运费率以及来自该来源的供应总体可用性。

Sir Robert Calder-Marshall,

Shanghai.

Dear Sir Robert,

In connection with the Fuel Sub-Committee activities I think you might be interested to know what the imports of coal to Shanghai during the past four months have been. I therefore give below this information, which I think is reasonably correct:-

| | June Tons | July Tons | August Tons | September Tons |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Formosan Coal | 2,350 | 3,415 | 17,837 | 10,305 |
| Kaiping Coal | 73,903 | 75,658 | 71,514 | 71,510 |
| Hongay Coal | 10,565 | 30,072 | 37,130 | 40,229 |
| Other French Indo-China Coal | 6,000 | 9,050 | 7,628 | 10,410 |
| Indian Coal | 4,418 | 5,721 | 47,042 | 63,176 |
| Newcastle Coal (Australia) | - | 7,270 | 14,743 | 21,616 |
| Witbank Coal | - | 6,359 | - | - |
| Fushun Coal | - | 2,340 | 1,620 | - |
| Others | 2,600 | 200 | 4,984 | 600 |
| Samarinda Coal | - | - | 3,800 | 2,500 |
| Miike Coal | - | - | - | 9,021 |
| | 100,836 | 140,085 | 206,298 | 229,367 |

You will note that during these four months the importations have increased over 128% .

These figures include Shanghai Power Company's coal, whose stocks have not increased to any extent during this period. I am not in a position to give you figures regarding the total stocks of coal in Shanghai during this period, and therefore cannot form any definite opinion as to whether Shanghai's needs are fully taken care of for the coming Winter. However, it would appear that unless some unforeseen circumstances arise, such as cessation of supplies or an abnormal increase in demand a serious shortage would not seem probable.

Yours sincerely,
(Sgd.) C.R. WARD
Shanghai Power Company.

10月19日

罗伯特·卡尔德-马歇尔爵士，

CONFIDENTIAL
POLICE FORCE

REPORT ON THE COAL SITUATION

The possibility of a serious shortage this coming
Winter in coal supplies for the needs of the city was brought
to the attention of the Council in a memorandum from Mr. P.
S. Hopkins of the Shanghai Power Company.

This memorandum states that:-

"Previous to the Sino-Japanese hostilities which
commenced in August, 1937, the total cost con-
sumption for the Shanghai area was at the rate of
over 3,000,000 tons per annum. The major portion
of this requirement was for bituminous coal
obtained from the following districts:-

1. Kailan
2. Shantung
3. Anhwei
4. Manchuria and Japan
5. Chihli and Jehol

The quantities supplied from each area are approxi-
mately in the order given but the Kailan collieries
are by far the largest suppliers, since they supply
approximately 50% of Shanghai's requirements.

Anthracite coals are obtained from Honan and French
Indo-China, Anthracite, both in respect to price
and burning characteristics, is not satisfactory for
Shanghai's industrial load. It is also questionable
as to whether adequate stocks of anthracite can be
obtained.

Coal heretofore available from Japan and Manchuria
has for the past 4 years been virtually all consumed
in Japan.

Under normal conditions, the stock of coal in Shanghai
varied between 300,000 and 400,000 tons. However, at
the commencement of hostilities in August, 1937, the
Shanghai stocks were abnormally low, due mainly to
the rapid improvement in industrial conditions during
the first half of 1937, and to the fact that Japan was
a heavy importer of Chinese coals. Subsequent to the
commencement of hostilities the demand for coal fell
away very rapidly, which temporarily eased the situa-
tion. Between the middle of August and the end of
October, 1937 very little coal was shipped to Shanghai.
A certain amount, however, was obtained from Tsingtao
and some anthracite was received from French Indo-
China. From November 1937 onwards, with the exception
of anthracite coal, practically the whole of the
supplies have been obtained from the Kailan collieries
and it would appear that these conditions will remain
for some considerable time owing to the fact that
hostilities will continue to prevent the shipment of
coal from other quarters. Should, therefore, any
interference occur in the supply of Kailan coal,
Shanghai would at the present time be faced with a very
serious coal shortage.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH -8 JULY 1938）
（批：1 JULY 1938 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）
（批：HEADQUARTERS CENTRAL REGISTRY P 2500 146 2/7/38）
page_data.zh:
机密
警务处

关于煤炭情况的报告

上海电力公司 P. S. Hopkins 先生在一备忘录中提请公董局注意：今冬本市所需煤炭供应可能出现严重短缺。

该备忘录称：-

“在1937年8月爆发的中日敌对行动之前，上海地区的总消费量每年超过300万吨。这一需求的大部分是烟煤，取自以下地区：-

1. 开滦
2. 山东
3. 安徽
4. 满洲和日本
5. 直隶和热河

各地区的供应量大致按上述顺序排列，但开滦煤矿是最大的供应商，因为其供应量约占上海需求的50%。

无烟煤取自河南和法属印度支那。就价格和燃烧特性而言，无烟煤并不适合上海的工业负荷。此外，能否获得充足的无烟煤库存也成问题。

过去四年，以往可从日本和满洲获得的煤炭几乎全部在日本国内消耗。

在正常条件下，上海的煤炭库存量在30万至40万吨之间波动。然而，1937年8月敌对行动开始时，上海的库存异常低，这主要是由于1937年上半年工业状况迅速改善，以及日本大量进口中国煤炭所致。敌对行动开始后，煤炭需求迅速下降，暂时缓解了局势。1937年8月中旬至10月底，运往上海的煤炭极少。不过，从青岛获得了一定数量的煤炭，并从法属印度支那收到了一些无烟煤。自1937年11月起，除无烟煤外，几乎所有供应均来自开滦煤矿，而且由于敌对行动将继续阻碍从其他地区装运煤炭，这种情况似乎将持续相当长一段时间。因此，如果开滦煤炭的供应受到任何干扰，上海目前将面临非常严重的煤炭短缺。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科 - 1938年7月8日）
（批：1938年7月1日 总办办公室）
（批：总部中央档案室 P 2500 146 1938年7月2日）

page_data.en:
-2-

It is estimated that there is about 130,000 tons of
coal in Shanghai, mainly above the barrier in the
Whangpoo river and on the Pootung side. This coal
is practically unavailable at the moment owing to the
fact that the authorities will not permit its removal
in any quantity. On what small quantities that have
been obtained from this stock an excessive charge for
taxes and lightorage has been levied and therefore,
should stoppage of the Kailan supply occur a serious
interference to industry would take place within a week
or two.

If the steady increase of industrial activity continues
as it has during the past three months, the coal require-
ments of Shanghai during the Winter of 1938/39 will be
at least 200,000 tons per month.

The problem therefore arises as to where this coal can
be obtained. It is doubtful whether the Kailan collier-
ies can meet such a demand in view of the claims of con-
sumers in other districts and Japan.

The next largest source of supply which is at present
unavailable, i.e. Shantung, may be able to supply a
certain quantity, provided that the damaged collieries
and railway are repaired and also provided that the
authorities in that area will permit the export of coal
to Shanghai. The present status in Shantung is obscure,
both in respect to ability to produce and availability
for consumption in China.

The probabilities of obtaining any coal from Anhwei or
Yangtsze ports would appear at the moment to be very
doubtful. The import of coal from Manchuria and Japan,
and Formosa does not offer much relief owing to the
fact that the demand in Japan and Manchuria is greater
than the supply.

It would appear, therefore, that during the coming
Winter Shanghai can look only to Kailan as its main
source of supply, with possibly small quantities from
Shantung, and, of course, Indo-China for anthracite
coal.

The situation so far as Shanghai is concerned is extremely
serious, unless influence can be brought to bear in the
right quarters. This threat to the activity of Shanghai
is particularly acute now in view of the fact that the
unemployed are just beginning to find employment in the
reopened mills."

The matter was referred to the undersigned who were
appointed Members of a Fuel Sub-Committee formed to investigate
and report to the Council.

It was decided that the situation should first be
surveyed by the Police Department and that the Council should
ascertain from Messrs. N.C Tai Shing and the Societe Francaise
des Charbonnages du Tonkin (Hongay Sales Agency) the two largest
importers of coal outside the Kailan Mining Administration whether
page_data.zh:
-2-

据估计，上海约有13万吨煤炭，主要位于黄浦江拦路坝以上及浦东一侧。由于当局不允许大量移走这些煤炭，目前实际上无法动用。从该库存中获得的少量煤炭被征收了过高的税费和驳船费，因此，如果开滦供应中断，一两周内工业将受到严重干扰。

如果工业活动的稳步增长像过去三个月那样持续下去，1938/39年冬季上海的煤炭需求量将至少达到每月20万吨。

因此，问题在于从哪里获得这些煤炭。鉴于其他地区和日本消费者的需求，开滦煤矿能否满足如此大的需求令人怀疑。

下一个最大的供应来源是山东，目前无法获得，但如果受损的煤矿和铁路得到修复，且该地区当局允许向上海出口煤炭，或许能供应一定数量。山东目前的状况不明，无论是在生产能力方面，还是在中国境内的可供应性方面。

目前看来，从安徽或长江沿岸港口获得任何煤炭的可能性都非常渺茫。从满洲、日本和台湾进口煤炭并不能带来多少缓解，因为日本和满洲的需求大于供应。

因此，看来在今冬，上海只能指望开滦作为其主要供应来源，可能还有来自山东的少量煤炭，当然还有来自印度支那的无烟煤。

就上海而言，局势极其严峻，除非能在有关方面施加影响。鉴于失业者刚刚开始在重新开工的工厂中找到工作，这种对上海活动的威胁现在尤为紧迫。”

此事已转交下文签署人处理，他们被任命为一个燃料小组委员会的成员，该委员会负责调查并向公董局报告。

会议决定，首先由警务处对局势进行调查，公董局应向开滦矿务管理局以外的两大煤炭进口商——大新公司（N.C. Tai Shing）和东京炭矿株式会社（Societe Francaise des Charbonnages du Tonkin，鸿基销售代理行）查明，

page_data.en:
-3-

they are and will be able to assure normal supplies of coal for
industrial and household purposes and as to what steps if any are
being taken to assure normal supplies during the coming Winter by
import from abroad.

The Police survey undertaken on June 1, 1938 states that:-

"there are approximately 50,000 tons of anthracite
coal and 11,000 tons of bituminous coal (including
coal dust) at present in Shanghai, and they are dis-
tributed as follows:-

| Name of Owner | Anthracite | Bituminous Coal |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Nyl Tai Shing Coal Co. Sinza Road | 17,000 tons | -- |
| Dah Loong Shing Coal Co., Rue Pere Froc | 13,000 " | -- |
| Shops and hongs in the Settlement and French Concession | 20,000 " (roughly) | 10,000 tons (roughly) |
| Kailan Mining Administration, Route de Sioyes | -- | 1,000 tons |
| | 50,000 tons | 11,000 tons |

In addition to the above quantity, there are approxi-
mately 50,000 tons of coal stored in coal yards in
Pootung and Nantao, mostly bituminous coal, the
removal of which, it is said, has been prohibited for
the time being by the Japanese authorities. 26,000
tons of this quantity belong to the Kailan Mining
Administration, while the remainder belong to various
coal dealers.

The importation of bituminous coal amounted to 80,000
and 70,000 tons during April and May, respectively.
The major portion of these quantities was supplied to
the Shanghai Power Company and the Japanese authorities,
the remainder being used to supply the local needs. The
approximate consumption of bituminous coal during May
was roughly 15,000 tons, exclusive of that used by
utility concerns.

The recent strike at the Kailan Mining Administration
Mines was responsible for a shortage of approximately
one month's output of coal and this combined with the
demands of the Japanese that Kailan Mining Coal be
directed to Japan, plus the coal which the Railways
in North China are claiming, renders it difficult for
the Kailan Mining Administration to adequately supply
local demands. To offset the shortage of Kailan
Mining Administration bituminous coal, certain of the
utility concerns such as the Shanghai Power Company,
are using a small percentage of anthracite coal but
page_data.zh:
-3-

他们是否以及能否保证工业和家庭用途的正常煤炭供应，并查明为确保今冬通过从国外进口实现正常供应正在采取何种措施（如有）。

警务处于1938年6月1日进行的调查显示：-

“目前上海约有5万吨无烟煤和1.1万吨烟煤（包括煤粉），分布如下：-

| 所有者名称 | 无烟煤 | 烟煤 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 新闸路 倪大新煤炭公司 (Nyl Tai Shing Coal Co.) | 17,000吨 | -- |
| 神父路 (Rue Pere Froc) 大隆兴煤炭公司 (Dah Loong Shing Coal Co.) | 13,000 " | -- |
| 公共租界和法租界的商店和洋行 | 约20,000 " | 约10,000吨 |
| 西爱咸斯路 (Route de Sioyes) 开滦矿务管理局 | -- | 1,000吨 |
| | 50,000吨 | 11,000吨 |

除上述数量外，浦东和南市煤栈还储存着约5万吨煤炭，大多为烟煤，据说日本当局暂时禁止移走这些煤炭。其中2.6万吨属于开滦矿务管理局，其余属于各类煤商。

4月和5月的烟煤进口量分别为8万吨和7万吨。这些大部分供应给了上海电力公司和日本当局，其余用于满足本地需求。5月份烟煤的大致消费量约为1.5万吨，不包括公用事业公司的用量。

最近开滦矿务管理局煤矿的罢工导致煤炭产量短缺约一个月，加上日本人要求将开滦煤矿的煤炭运往日本，以及华北铁路部门所需的煤炭，使得开滦矿务管理局难以充分满足本地需求。为了弥补开滦矿务管理局烟煤的短缺，上海电力公司等一些公用事业公司正在使用少量百分比的无烟煤，但

page_data.en:
-4-
owing to the unsuitability of the present machinery in
use it is impossible to use sufficient quantities of
anthracite coal to balance the shortage of Kailan
Mining Administration coal.

The Shanghai Power Company has approximately 80,000 tons
of coal in stock. 25,000 tons are due to arrive during
June. The present average monthly consumption of the
Shanghai Power Company is 36,000 tons; it is anticipated
that during the next six months this amount will be
increased to 50,000 tons monthly.

Approximately 35,000 tons of anthracite coal was imported
during the month of May, and it is expected that 10,000
tons monthly will be imported during June, July and
August. The total estimated consumption of anthracite
for May was approximately 20,000 tons, of which 10,000
were in briquettes, 2,000 tons were used by the heating
plants of buildings and the remaining 8,000 tons for
household and small industrial concerns.

The consumption of coal will increase in proportion to
the resumption of operations of the various industrial
concerns at present idle and unless stocks are obtained
from abroad considerable shortage will be felt.

At present the only coal reaching Shanghai is bituminous
coal from the Kailan Mining Administration mines, and
anthracite coal from Hongay Sales mines in Indo-China.

The prices of coal on June 1, 1938 are as follows:-
Anthracite Coal: Wholesale price - $39.00 per ton
                 Retail price   - $41.00 " "
Bituminous Coal: Wholesale price - $30.00 " "
                 Retail price   - $32.00 " "

To assist the Council in arriving at an accurate estimate
of Shanghai's total monthly consumption of coal, the Police Depart-
ment will undertake a survey on the first of every month.

Messrs. Neo Tai Shing informed the Council that they
depend to a very large extent on obtaining supplies from the Kailan
and Hongay Mines and if present deliveries continue, they will be
able to meet their customers' requirements. A representative of the
Company stated that his firm has the matter of importation of stocks
from Australia and elsewhere under consideration but there are
various factors against importation from sources other than the
usual. Apart from the investment required and exchange risks
involved there is no surety of profit. Though at present remote
there is the possibility of normal supplies being resumed. Your
Committee decided that Messrs. Neo Tai Shing should be further
approached.
page_data.zh:
-4-
由于现有机器设备不适用，不可能使用足够数量的无烟煤来平衡开滦矿务管理局煤炭的短缺。

上海电力公司现有煤炭库存约8万吨。6月份将有2.5万吨到货。上海电力公司目前的月平均消费量为3.6万吨；预计在未来六个月内，这一数字将增加到每月5万吨。

5月份进口了约3.5万吨无烟煤，预计6月、7月和8月每月将进口1万吨。5月份无烟煤的估计总消费量约为2万吨，其中1万吨为煤球，2,000吨用于建筑物的供暖设施，其余8,000吨用于家庭和小型工业企业。

随着目前闲置的各种工业企业恢复运营，煤炭消耗量将成比例增加，除非从国外获得库存，否则将出现严重短缺。

目前运抵上海的煤炭只有来自开滦矿务管理局煤矿的烟煤，以及来自印度支那鸿基销售代理行（Hongay Sales）煤矿的无烟煤。

1938年6月1日的煤炭价格如下：-
无烟煤：批发价 - 每吨39.00元
       零售价 - 每吨41.00元
烟煤：   批发价 - 每吨30.00元

Utility Companies were informed that the Council is
most anxious that all possible steps should be taken to ensure
that there will be an adequate supply of coal for the require-
ments of this port and especially for the maintenance of their
undertakings, and they were asked what steps had been taken or

the current year.

The Shanghai Gas Company replied that they are relying
entirely on the Kailan Mining Administration to supply them
(under contract) with about 4,000 tons of slack coal per month,
and the Shanghai Waterworks Company reported that the Company
is maintaining in its yards a minimum stock of coal sufficient
for three months' requirements; that the coal is being obtained
through the usual channels and there appears no reason to suppose
that this cannot be maintained. The Company stated that in the
event of a real emergency arising oil fuel can be used in the
place of coal but at considerably increased pumping costs.

The larger industrial consumers were also approached
and it was found that the majority are entirely dependent on
the Kailan Mining Administration. In furnishing particulars of
their daily requirements, they stated that they were not able to

上海煤气公司回复称，他们完全依赖开滦矿务局根据合同每月向其供应约 4,000 吨粉煤；上海自来水公司报告称，该公司在其堆场保持至少满足三个月需求的最低煤炭库存；煤炭正通过常规渠道获取，似乎没有理由认为这无法维持。该公司表示，若出现真正的紧急情况，可以使用燃油代替煤炭，但抽水成本将大幅增加。

大型工业用户也受到了接洽，发现大多数用户完全依赖开滦矿务局。在提供其每日需求详情时，他们表示，如果开滦矿务局无法满足需求，他们无法提出任何替代供应方案。据两家公司透露，经销商代表已被派往华北，调查恢复从山东煤矿供货的可能性。
