缓解困境

在昨日于此处举行的、由上海总商会主持的会议上，决定自今日起，在由商会15名执行委员及煤商组成的委员会监督下，开始廉价销售中式烹饪所需的煤球。每人允许在廉价销售中购买价值30美分的煤球。廉价销售中每担价格为5美元，比普通煤店提供的价格便宜约80美分。

会议由虞洽卿先生主持，经过长时间讨论，决定组织一个委员会来监督廉价销售业务。廉价销售自今日起持续30天。关于一般煤炭销售问题未达成任何决定。据悉，商会致函上海公共租界工部局，要求后者与航运界举行会议以降低运费，但尚未收到任何回复。据说，降低运费是降低煤价的前提条件。

会议还决定，所有已从工厂购买煤球但尚未提货的人，必须在3月15日前提货。换言之，这些被怀疑囤积货物的商人被给予额外15天的时间，在此期间他们必须提取煤球并向公众出售。

page_data.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.

FEB 28 1940

The Coal Racket:
Plenty Near Shanghai

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"

SIR,—I have read with interest your
various articles and notes on the
subject of the so-called coal shortage
in Shanghai. That a shortage does
to a certain extent exist I do not
deny, although I do maintain that
this should not be, as there is suffi-
cient coal within a radius of thirty
miles or so of Shanghai to supply the
whole China coast, as well as Japan,
for many years to come. Shanghai
is the centre of huge coal fields.
There is a great seam of soft coal of
good quality, already mined in places,
running diagonally across Anhwei
and Kiangsu right up to the Yangtze
River; it traverses the Tai-hu lake
which is one big coal bed, and before
the Japanese war coal from this field
used to be brought down the Soochow
Creek and the Whangpoo River in
shallow boats. There is a good seam
of semi-anthracite coal almost out-
side the gates of Nanking, and another
not far from Hangchow. Chekiang
and Fokien are also rich in coal.
Why don't the Japanese work these
fields? They profess to be in full
control of Shanghai and for many
miles round, and yet they are content
to import coal at ruinous cost rather
than work seams which are right un-
der their noses, and which have al-
ready been tapped at various points.
One is tempted to ask whether the
Japanese control is so very effective
after all? If they want particulars
of these coal fields I can supply them
—for a consideration, of course—but
I am inclined to think that they
already know of their existence. As
for the high prices charged on the
local market, this is nothing less than
a disgraceful ramp, and the people
engaged in it, mostly big British firms
I am grieved to say, ought to be
ashamed of themselves.

ANCIENT BRITON.
Shanghai, Feb. 27.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。

1940年2月28日

煤炭垄断集团：
上海附近储量丰富

致《字林西报》编辑

先生，——我饶有兴致地阅读了贵报关于上海所谓煤炭短缺问题的各类文章和短评。我不否认在一定程度上确实存在短缺，但我坚持认为这种情况本不该发生，因为在上海周围约三十英里半径范围内，有足够的煤炭供应整个中国沿海地区以及日本，足以维持多年。上海是巨大煤田的中心。有一条优质的软煤层，部分地区已开采，斜穿安徽和江苏直达长江；它穿过太湖，那里是一个巨大的煤床，在战前，该煤田的煤炭曾通过浅水船经苏州河和黄浦江运抵上海。在南京城门外几乎就有一条优质的半无烟煤层，另一条离杭州不远。浙江和福建也富含煤炭。日本人为什么不开发这些煤田？他们声称完全控制上海及周边广大地区，却宁愿以毁灭性的高成本进口煤炭，也不愿开采近在咫尺且已在多处动工的煤层。人们不禁要问，日本的统治究竟是否如此有效？如果他们需要这些煤田的详细资料，我可以提供——当然，需付报酬——但我倾向于认为他们已经知道这些煤田的存在。至于本地市场的高昂价格，这简直是一种可耻的哄抬物价行为，从事此道者多为大型英资公司，说来令人痛心，他们应当感到羞耻。

一位老英国人
上海，2月27日。

page_data.en:
FEB 28 1940

Summer-Time:
Cure for Coal Prices
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—It was announced in the
"North-China Daily News" a few
days ago that summer-time would be
made effective in England on
February 25, about two months
earlier than usual.
Summer-time it may be explained
for those who have never lived in
the many countries where it is now
enforced, is merely the act of putting
this clock one hour ahead (in the
middle of the night) every spring
and likewise putting it back an hour
in the autumn. Its original purpose
was to give an hour's extra daylight
for work and play, instead of spend-
ing an hour more in bed in the
morning more often than not long
after the sun had risen.
Many arguments were raised
against it in the beginning, principally
by the agricultural community, who
are in the habit of getting up early
and retiring early in any case, and to
whom it admittedly is of less value
than to the industrial population. It
was, however, tentatively tried out
and, to let facts speak for them-
selves, during the past twenty years
it has become almost a world-wide
practice.
The British Islands, the United
States and Canada, New Zealand,
France, the Argentine and many
other countries have adopted sum-
mer-time and are convinced of its
practicability and value. In India,
China and other Oriental countries
where, generally speaking, the sun is
the clock, its need has been less
evident.
As already remarked, Britain has
adopted it earlier this year than
usual and for a very cogent reason.
It saves coal. An hour's extra day-
light means an hour's less electric
light—and this means that coal which
is now used for lighting may be used
for heating, or reduced in price
owing to diminished demand.
In Shanghai, coal costs now about
ten cents a pound and there is every
reason to expect it will go higher.
It is widely used for heating and
cooking, either in its natural state or
in the form of electricity and gas.
Whatever tends to reduce its use will
reduce its cost. The introduction of
summer-time would unquestionably
lead to this result, as it is doing in
Britain at the present time.
An excellent short editorial in to-
day's paper advocates cooperation
between the International, French
and adjacent areas in the matter of
Price Control. Here is an instance
where such cooperation could be
effectively practised. French, Amer-
icans and British, in whose home
countries summer-time is now opera-
tive, predominate in authority in the
French and International areas, and
in adjacent areas both Japanese and
Chinese are modern and wide-awake
enough to appreciate the advantages
of a scheme which has worked for
the common good elsewhere for more
than twenty years.
Now is the time to do it and to
relieve thereby to no small extent
privations which both foreigners and
Chinese experience by the unneces-
sary waste of black diamonds.
CARLOWE.
Shanghai, Feb. 28.

1940年2月28日

夏令时：
煤炭价格的良方
致《字林西报》编辑
先生，——数日前，《字林西报》宣布英国将于2月25日实行夏令时，比往常提前约两个月。
对于那些从未生活在目前强制实行夏令时的许多国家的人来说，或许需要解释一下，夏令时仅仅是在每年春季（在午夜时分）将时钟拨快一小时，并在秋季同样拨回一小时的做法。其最初目的是为工作和娱乐提供额外的一小时日光，而不是在早晨往往太阳已升起很久后还多睡一小时。
起初，人们提出了许多反对意见，主要来自农业界，他们无论如何都习惯早起早睡，而且公认夏令时对他们的价值不如对工业人口那么大。然而，经过试探性试行，让事实说话，在过去二十年里，它几乎已成为一种世界性的惯例。
不列颠群岛、美国和加拿大、新西兰、法国、阿根廷以及许多其他国家已采用夏令时，并确信其可行性和价值。在印度、中国和其他东方国家，一般来说以太阳为钟，其必要性就不那么明显了。
如前所述，英国今年比往常更早采用了夏令时，理由非常充分。这能节省煤炭。额外一小时的日光意味着少用一小时的电灯——这意味着原本用于照明的煤炭可以用于取暖，或者因需求减少而降低价格。
在上海，煤炭现在每斤约需一角钱，且有充分理由预期价格还会走高。煤炭无论是以天然状态还是以电力和煤气的形式，都被广泛用于取暖和烹饪。任何倾向于减少其使用的措施都将降低其成本。引入夏令时无疑会导致这一结果，正如目前在英国发生的那样。
今天报纸上一篇优秀的简短社论主张在价格管制问题上，公共租界、法租界及周边地区之间进行合作。这是一个可以有效实践此类合作的实例。法国人、美国人和英国人在其本国目前已实行夏令时，他们在法租界和公共租界的管理层中占主导地位；而在周边地区，日本人和中国人都足够现代和敏锐，能够领会这一已在其他地方为公共利益运作了二十多年的方案的优势。
现在是采取行动的时候了，从而在很大程度上缓解外国人和中国人因不必要地浪费“黑钻石”（煤炭）而遭受的困苦。
CARLOWE.
上海，2月28日。

CHINA PRESS.
FEB 29 1940

F.M.C. Committee Meets
Proposals Made To Extend,
Continue Cheap Sales Here

On the eve of the first meeting of
the F.M.C. Price-Fixing Com-
mittee, called for this morning, pro-
posals were made by Chinese busi-
ness leaders here that the "cheap
sale" campaign of essential com-
modities be continued and extend-
ed as a measure of relieving the
hardship of the poor.

At a meeting at the offices of
the Chinese Chamber of Com-
merce on Hongkong Road, offi-
cials of the Chamber and re-
presentatives of the Coal Bri-
quette Dealers Guild and Fire
Wood Sellers' Guild yesterday
agreed that "cheap sale" of
fuel be carried on a larger
scale.

It was decided that beginning to-
morrow, and continuing for 20 days,
coal briquette dealers would place
1,000 tons of briquette on sale.

Sales Start Tomorrow

The coal will be sold at $5 per
100 chin, although each buyer will
be allowed to buy at most 20 cents'
worth. The sale will continue from
2 p.m. to 5 p.m. each day.

Each of the briquette shops
participating in the sale will be
allowed 100,000 chin for the en-
tire period of the sale. The
sale will come to an end when
the shop has exhausted its allot-
ment.

A representative of the "Cheap
Rice Sale" Committee yesterday
stated that the sale would continue
"so long as the stock lasts." He
added that contributions to the
sales fund had been coming in
slowly.

$1,000,000 Goal

It was pointed out that the Com-
mittee needed to continue financial
support of the public. "We are
still $400,000 away from our $1,-
000,000 goal," he added.

The "cheap flour sale" was
still being continued yesterday.
Participating dealers reported
to the committee yesterday
that the entire allotment of 7,500
bags, as on previous days, was
sold on Tuesday.

Officials of the Chamber were
believed to have recommended
that the National Government
grant foreign exchange to the
several cheap sale committees
here so that they may obtain
commodities for cheap sales at
lower cost.

It could not be ascertained last
night whether the proposal would
be put into effect by the concerned
organizations.

Rice Price Goes Up

Regarding the Frenchtown Price-
Fixing Committee, it was stated
that reports would be read by the
chairman at the first meeting. The
reports were expected to reveal re-
sults of consultations already con-
ducted between the chairman and
business leaders here.

Despite the arrival of 20,000
bags of rice from Saigon aboard
the Nowegian coaster Mui Hok
on Tuesday, the price of Saigon
rice rose by about 50 cents per
picul. The quotations yesterday
ranged between $45.30 and $43
per picul.

Prices of domestic rice dropped
slightly. Secret sales were reported
to have been made by dealers at
$50 per picul.

1940年2月29日

平价委员会召开会议
提议在此延续并扩大廉价销售

在今晨召开的平价委员会（F.M.C.）定价委员会首次会议前夕，在沪华商领袖提出建议，作为缓解穷人困苦的一项措施，应继续并扩大生活必需品的“廉价销售”运动。

昨日，在香港路（Hongkong Road）上海市商会办公室举行的一次会议上，商会官员以及煤球业同业公会和柴行公会的代表同意，更大规模地开展燃料“廉价销售”。

会议决定，从明天开始，持续20天，煤球商将投放1,000吨煤球进行销售。

明日开始销售

煤炭将以每百斤5美元的价格出售，尽管每位买家最多只允许购买价值20美分的货物。销售时间为每天下午2点至5点。

参与销售的每家煤球店在整个销售期间将被分配10万斤额度。当店铺耗尽配额时，销售即告结束。

“平价米销售”委员会的一位代表昨日表示，只要库存充足，销售将继续进行。他补充说，对销售基金的捐款流入缓慢。

100万美元目标

有人指出，委员会需要公众继续提供财政支持。“我们距离100万美元的目标仍差40万美元，”他补充道。

“平价面粉销售”昨日仍在继续。参与交易的经销商昨日向委员会报告，周二的7,500袋全部分配额已售罄，与此前几日情况相同。

据信，商会官员已建议国民政府向在沪的几个平价销售委员会提供外汇，以便它们能以较低成本获取用于廉价销售的商品。

昨晚尚无法确定相关组织是否会实施该提议。

米价上涨

关于法租界定价委员会，据悉主席将在第一次会议上宣读报告。预计这些报告将揭示主席与在沪商界领袖之间已进行的磋商结果。

尽管周二有20,000袋西贡大米由挪威沿海货轮“Mui Hok”号运抵，但西贡米的价格每担仍上涨了约50美分。昨日报价在每担45.30美元至43美元之间。

国产米价格略有下跌。据报道，经销商以每担50美元的价格进行了秘密交易。

Firewood Exportation

Since April or May, 1941, the following ground
product hongs :-
(1) Tsung Tei (正泰), No. 571 Fokien Road,
(2) Doong Zung (同成), No. 573 Fokien Road, and
(3) Hoong Fah (洪发), No. 576 Fokien Road
have been the sole agencies for the exportation of
firewood from Shanghai to Swatow and Amoy. However,
due to the drop in the price of firewood in those areas,
these ground product hongs have, since the middle part
of September, this year, ceased exporting firewood to
those areas. The price of firewood in Swatow and Amoy
is at present below $20 per picul.

FILE
20.10.41.
It is learned that the decrease in the price of
firewood in Swatow and Amoy is due to the fact that
Fokien has recently been opened for traffic between these
two areas. Fokien itself is a firewood producing area,
and is able to supply a large quantity to these two areas
with the result, that the price there has naturally decreased.
Consequently the price of firewood exported from Shanghai
to Swatow and Amoy must be reduced to meet the market
price in those areas.

In view of the above and due to the high cost in
freight charges and other expenses incurred in transportation
from Shanghai to these two areas, the dealers have ceased
exporting firewood to outports, there being no profits
gained therefrom.

木柴出口

自1941年4月或5月以来，下列土产行：
(1) 正泰（Tsung Tei），福建路571号，
(2) 同成（Doong Zung），福建路573号，以及
(3) 洪发（Hoong Fah），福建路576号
一直是上海向汕头和厦门出口木柴的唯一代理机构。然而，由于这些地区木柴价格下跌，这些土产行自今年9月中旬以来已停止向这些地区出口木柴。目前汕头和厦门的木柴价格低于每担20美元。

存档
1941年10月20日。
据悉，汕头和厦门木柴价格下跌是由于福建最近开通了这两个地区之间的交通。福建本身是木柴产区，能够向这两个地区供应大量木柴，导致当地价格自然下降。因此，从上海出口到汕头和厦门的木柴价格必须降低，以适应当地的市场价格。

鉴于上述情况，以及由于从上海运输到这两个地区的运费和其他费用高昂，经销商已停止向外埠出口木柴，因为从中无利可图。

S.1., Special Branch. Sld/dd. File No.................... Date...September 19, 1941.

SUBJECT: Firewood Exportation.

At the present time the amount of firewood exported from Shanghai does not exceed five thousand piculs per month, which is approximately five per cent of the monthly imports into Shanghai. This firewood is consigned to Swatow and Amoy which are both under Japanese control. No interference has been experienced whilst en route to or upon arrival at these ports but it is doubtful whether the Japanese authorities would permit uninterrupted passage to outports not under their control.

There appears to be only one method of controlling the export of firewood from Shanghai and that is by the permit system in the same manner as the exportation of rice. Little or no difficulty is expected in the enforcement of this system. Although there are some forty firewood hongs in the Settlement only two, the Yah Dah Ground Product Hong, 572 Fokien Road and the Yoong Chong Ground Product Hong, 603 Fokien Road, are of large scale. The others, a complete list of which is attached, are merely small dealers who purchase supplies from the main hongs.

In considering the proposed control of firewood exports it should be remembered that although supplies are regular the quantity is limited and Shanghai is dependent on Japanese occupied areas for this commodity. Should the authorities in those areas suddenly take restrictive measures or cause transportation problems, Shanghai would find itself faced with a firewood short-

主题：木柴出口。

目前，从上海出口的木柴数量每月不超过五千担，约占上海每月进口量的百分之五。这些木柴运往汕头和厦门，两地均处于日本控制之下。在运往这些港口或抵达时未受到干扰，但日本当局是否允许 uninterrupted passage（不间断通行）至非其控制的通商口岸，则令人怀疑。

控制从上海出口木柴似乎只有一种方法，即实行与大米出口相同的许可证制度。预计执行该制度不会遇到什么困难。虽然租界内约有四十家木柴行，但只有两家规模较大，即福建路572号的亚达土产行（Yah Dah Ground Product Hong）和福建路603号的永昌土产行（Yoong Chong Ground Product Hong）。其余各行（附完整清单） merely small dealers（仅为小商贩），他们从大行进货。

Scl. Special Branch. 8/didd. File No.................... Date August 26, 1941.
SUBJECT: Firewood Situation
Prior to the Sino-Japanese hostilities the greater part of firewood used by Shanghai residents came from Ningpo, the Chusan Archipelago, Sung Ka Meng(沈家門) and localities in the vicinity. Since the fall of these areas to the Japanese Military, supplies have been interrupted. In April of this year, however, a Japanese named Maoki established a company called "Shinmin Yoko" (新民洋行) at the corner of North Szechuen and Jukong Roads, with the express purpose of undertaking the transportation of firewood from Ningpo to Shanghai. It is understood that this concern regularly imports 5,000 to 6,000 piculs of firewood every month. The retailing of the fuel is entrusted by the "Shinmin Yoko" to one Chen Yung Kong(陳永康) of the "Yung Lee Company (永利)" who receives a commission of 10 per cent on the sales. Chen Yung Kong is reported to be the proprietor of the Yung Dah Firewood and Charcoal Shop (永大), 81 Kashing Road. This Ningpo firewood is sold in Shanghai for about $12 per picul although it is purchased at its source for only $3. per picul. As all shipping between Ningpo and Shanghai is under Japanese control, Chinese merchants are precluded from participating in the firewood business insofar as transportation is concerned.
The five to six thousand piculs of firewood imported from Ningpo every month is far from sufficient to meet the local demands. The fuel is therefore brought into

主题：木柴状况
在中日敌对行动之前，上海居民使用的大部分木柴来自宁波、舟山群岛、沈家門（Sung Ka Meng）及周边地区。自这些地区沦陷于日军以来，供应中断。然而，今年四月，一名叫Maoki（音译）的日本人在北四川路与虬江路转角处成立了一家名为“新民洋行”（Shinmin Yoko）的公司，明确旨在从事从宁波到上海的木柴运输。据悉，该公司每月定期进口5,000至6,000担木柴。“新民洋行”将燃料的零售业务委托给“永利公司”（Yung Lee Company）的陈永康（Chen Yung Kong），他获得销售额10%的佣金。据报道，陈永康是嘉兴路81号永大木炭店（Yung Dah Firewood and Charcoal Shop）的店主。这种宁波木柴在上海的售价约为每担12美元，而在源头的采购价仅为每担3美元。由于宁波与上海之间的所有航运均受日本控制，中国商人在运输方面被排除在木柴生意之外。
每月从宁波进口的五六千担木柴远不足以满足当地需求。因此，燃料通过

work of itinerant boatmen and villagers who, knowing
full well the demand, take every opportunity to bring
firewood to Shanghai whenever space is available on
boats bound for this port. The firewood is sent to
two markets, the ground product hongs on the French
Bund for fuel arriving by the Whangpoo and the ground
product hongs in the vicinity of Fokien Road Bridge
for fuel arriving by the Soochow Creek. The retail
price for the ground product hong firewood is
approximately $10. per picul.
The other sources of supply are Tazang,
Pei-sing-kying, Tse-pao and other suburbs of Shanghai.
Firewood from these places is imported by villagers
on handcarts and wheelbarrows and is usually sold
direct to local residents for about $9 per picul.
Some 300 to 500 piculs are brought to Shanghai daily
by this method. The villagers, in order to avoid
Japanese sentries in the western district, make a
detour by going through Chapei and then into the
Settlement. Should they be stopped by Chinese Self-
Defence Corps soldiers, they usually gain a passage by
paying the soldiers from $5 to $10 for every handcart
of firewood.
As no Chinese merchants are at present
importing firewood direct from the producing areas,
local firewood shops in the Foreign Settlements

It will be seen from the foregoing that the
total amount of firewood arriving in Shanghai is
approximately 100,000 to 140,000 piculs monthly.
According to calculations made before the Sino-Japanese
hostilities, the monthly Shanghai consumption of fire-
wood was approximately 1,200,000 piculs. Therefore
the present supply is about ten per cent of normal
demand. The paucity of firewood as a means of fuel
is largely offset by the use of coal briquettes. In
fact there is a definite preference on the part of
Chinese to use the latter fuel in place of firewood.
Although a picul of briquettes costs morethan a picul
of firewood it must be remembered that firewood is always
sold in a wet condition and after exposure to the sun
for a few days, 100 catties of firewood are reduced to
70 cattiesin consequence of the evaporation of the
moisture. As a result of this, the heat produced
by two piculs of firewood is less than that emanating
from one picul of briquettes. This shows that
firewood is, in the long run, a more expensive fuel
than briquettes.

It is difficult to make an exact estimate of
firewood stocks in Shanghai. Even members of the
trade are unable to calculate this correctly because
it is stored largely by residents as well as the
small shops. Generally speaking, however, the stocks
in Shanghai would be sufficient to last a month if
circumstances arose which would cause the cessation

从前文可以看出，抵达上海的木柴
总量每月约为10万至14万担。根据中日
敌对行动前的计算，上海每月的木柴消
耗量约为120万担。因此，目前的供应量
约为正常需求的百分之十。作为燃料的木
柴短缺在很大程度上通过使用煤球得到
弥补。事实上，中国人确实更倾向于使用
后者代替木柴。虽然一担煤球的成本高于
一担木柴，但必须记住，木柴总是以潮湿
状态出售，经过几天日晒后，由于水分蒸
发，100斤木柴会减少到70斤。因此，两
担木柴产生的热量少于一担煤球发出的热
量。这表明，从长远来看，木柴是一种比
煤球更昂贵的燃料。

很难对上海的木柴库存做出准确估
计。即使是行业成员也无法正确计算，因
为库存主要由居民以及小商店储存。一般
而言，如果发生导致供应停止的情况，上
海的库存足以维持一个月

        Taking into view the existing conditions in
Shanghai, it may be safe to assume that no serious
effect will be caused by any interruption of firewood
imports so long as coal briquettes can be produced
continually. The present precarious coal situation,
however, is a factor which would have to be considered
in its relation to coal dust.
        In reviewing the present firewood situation
in all its aspects, it would appear that Shanghai is
in need of all the supplies that are able, with some
difficulty, to arrive here. It is considered that
Shanghai's present stocks and possible future supplies
do not allow any margin for export and it is
suggested that our needs are greater than the outports
whose proximity to country districts should enable
them to receive a steady supply of the fuel.

Shanghai, October 22, 1941.

The Secretary,
Briquette Price Fixing Committee,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:-

In reply to your letter of the 16th inst., and in confirming our conversation with you this morning, we beg to request the Committee to authorize an increase in the price of briquettes at the earliest possible date.

We forward you herewith an amended cost statement, which applies to most factories, together with the price suggested for local retailers. When fixing the new price for briquettes, the Committee is also requested to grant a reasonable profit for the manufacturers.

It is to be noted that the cost price as contained in our statement is not the replacement value in future, but is the actual cost for coal already arrived. Regarding the composition of briquettes, it is found that the proposed 60% of Hongay or Courbet coal from Indo-China and 40% of inferior dust is not practical, as a sufficient quantity of inferior dust of a suitable quality is not available on the market and that the briquettes thus composed will not ensure free burning and will arouse dissatisfaction of consumers. It is therefore proposed that the composition should be 70% Hongay or Courbet and 30% of Inferior dust.

Yours faithfully,

Dear Sir:-

Since we submitted to you our cost price for briquettes requesting you to permit us to increase our selling prices, we have received no reply from you and we are continuing to sell at a loss.

On the other hand, for us to receive the coal, we must charter steamers, order the coal, have the consent of the Mines who deliver the coal to us and, finally, have same transported. Generally, a delay of one month to 6 weeks is necessary between the moment we order and the time we receive the coal.

We cannot consider chartering new steamers carrying coal, unless the Committee will give us definite assurance that we will not be obliged to sell same at a loss.

Our request should therefore be examined immediately in order to permit us to continue supplying the local market.

另一方面，为了接收煤炭，我们必须租赁轮船、订购煤炭、获得向我们供煤的矿方同意，并最终安排运输。通常，从我们下单到收到煤炭之间需要一个月至六周的延迟。

因此，应立即审查我们的请求，以便使我们能够继续向本地市场供货。

他还提交了一封已由现已解散的上海总商会于1940年4月24日发给该公会的信，大意是根据《同业公会法》，没有理由召开各工厂代表的联合会议，而应举行委员会会议。

值得注意的是，公会主席曾于9月22日接受助理总监（特别支部）的约谈，当时向他传达了上述三项指令。他承诺在咨询小工厂管理层后召开会员和制造商大会，并于9月29日将预定会议的日期和地点告知警务处。

10月2日，在特别支部代表煤球定价委员会召集的小工厂主会议上，获悉主席并未向他们通报警方指令，也未召开任何会议。他们非常渴望举行大小工厂主会议，目的是在贸易中进行合作（前一份报告中已概述）。

It is therefore apparent that the big owners have severed their connections with the Association and the small owners know nothing about the Association. The Association is still controlled by the unqualified "committee members".

When questioned as to his opinion, the Chairman stated that "if the Association be allowed to carry on, the old 'committee members' be permitted to stand and the big factory owners continue to pay membership fees, and there will be no trouble". He also said that he could not follow the Police instructions for the reasons given above.

The Chairman further mentioned that he was not in a position to control the "committee members" and that his relay of Police instructions to them had proved abortive and suggested that the Police gave instructions direct to the "committee members".

In view of this, he was instructed to notify all "committee members" to attend Police Headquarters at 2 p.m. October 13, when Police instructions as requested by the Chairman would be repeated to them. He was, however, warned that as the "committee members" were adopting an attitude of non-cooperation, all must attend, failing which they would be considered to have lost their qualifications as committee members and the Municipal Police would take drastic action against the Association.

S. 1, Special Branch.
September 9, 1941.

Dispute in the Coal Briquette
Trade Association.
------------------------------------

On August 10, nine large coal briquette
factories in Shanghai addressed a joint letter to the
S.M.C. (Appendix "A"). It states that by taking
advantage of disorganization in the association,
certain minor officers of the association fabricated
rumours detrimental to the reputation of the writers
and brought about disaffection among member factories.
It further mentions that they requested the association
in writing to convene a general meeting of factory
owners, but the request was rejected by the association.
The writers therefore resigned their membership of
the association on August 16. The letter finally
requested the Council to order the publishers of
local Chinese newspapers not to publish any further
reports detrimental to the writers' reputation and
business.

On August 26, these nine factories addressed a
further letter (Appendix "B") to the S.M.C. In this
letter the writers requested the Council to sponsor
the formation of a coal briquette price-fixing
committee to be composed of representatives appointed
by

1. S.M.C.
2. C.M.F.
3. firms interested in the briquette business :-
(a) Shanghai Office of the Societe Francaise des
Charbonnages du Tonkin, 2nd floor, A.P.C.
building, 9 The Bund.
page_data.zh:
S. 1, 特科。
1941年9月9日。

煤球同业公会纠纷。
------------------------------------

8月10日，上海的九家大型煤球厂联名致信工部局（附录“A”）。信中指出，某些公会低级职员利用公会的混乱局面，捏造损害写信人声誉的谣言，并在成员工厂间引起不满。信中还提到，他们曾书面要求公会召集工厂主大会，但该要求被公会拒绝。因此，写信人于8月16日退出了公会会员资格。信末请求理事会命令本地中文报纸出版商不再刊登任何损害写信人声誉和业务的报道。

8月26日，这九家工厂又致信工部局（附录“B”）。在这封信中，写信人请求理事会赞助成立一个煤球价格制定委员会，该委员会由以下各方指派的代表组成：

1. 工部局。
2. 法公董局。
3. 对煤球业务感兴趣的公司：-
(a) 东京湾法国煤矿公司上海办事处，外滩9号亚细亚火油公司大楼二楼。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

(b) Compagnie Optorg, importers of Hongay Coal
Dust, 39 Avenue Edward VII.

(c) Zeh Zeng Company, importers of "Ku Pah"
Coal Dust, 22 Avenue Debail.

They announced that they were willing to submit to
any reasonable control and to send representatives
to attend any meetings to furnish particulars.

Appendix "C" is a letter dated August 29
addressed by the Coal Briquette Trade Association to
the S.M.C. It states that a meeting of members of
its Executive and Supervisory Committees was held
on August 18 when it was decided to request the
S.M.C. to prohibit the coal briquette factories
from raising the wholesale prices without formal
notice given in writing by the Association (according
to the translator of the letter, the sentence in
original text was clumsily worded).

With reference to the above, enquiries
were made into the conditions in the present trade
association; and the following facts brought to
light :-

The trade association was formed in
October, 1936 and was registered with the now defunct
local Kuomintang and Bureau of Social Affairs and
was a member of the now defunct Chinese Chamber of
Commerce. It had an office at 39 Avenue Edward VII
and following the hostilities was removed to Room 3,
2nd floor, 405 Tientsin Road. This association
is, however, not registered with the Municipal
Police.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

(b) 奥托格公司 (Compagnie Optorg)，鸿基煤屑进口商，爱德华七世路39号。

(c) 泽增公司 (Zeh Zeng Company)，“古巴”煤屑进口商，德拜尔路22号。

他们宣布愿意接受任何合理的管制，并派遣代表参加任何会议以提供详情。

附录“C”是煤球同业公会于8月29日致工部局的一封信。信中指出，其执行委员会和监督委员会成员于8月18日举行会议，决定请求工部局禁止煤球厂在未由公会发出正式书面通知的情况下提高批发价格（据该信的译者称，原文中的这句话措辞笨拙）。

鉴于上述情况，对当前同业公会的状况进行了调查；查明以下事实：-

该同业公会成立于1936年10月，曾在现已解散的本地国民党和社会局注册，并曾是现已解散的上海总商会的会员。其办公地点原设在爱德华七世路39号，战事后迁至天津路405号二楼3室。然而，该公会并未在警务处注册。

- 4 -

The present position is that the first eight members
withdrew their membership on August 16. The 9th
factory denies being a member of the association,
while the 22nd and 23rd closed down and are not
paying membership fees to the association. Actually
11 factories are not members and only twelve retain
their membership. In respect to the daily production
of coal briquettes, the first eight are the largest
factories, being responsible for the 90% of the
production. The 12 present members of the association
are only responsible for some 10% of the production.
It is to be noted that one of the members listed No.13
was recently taken to the Shanghai Special District
Court by the Municipal Police and charged with
"fraud" for making inferior quality briquettes and
fined $400.00. The production of the large
factories is better than that of the small ones.
In connection with the dispute between
members, Yeu Tsung-shing (尤春欣), Manager of the
Nyi Tai Shing Coal Briquette Factory, 352 Markham
Road, and Z.S. Bourne (龐潤生), Manager of the
Tung Fang Coal Briquette Factory, 29 Penang Road,
have been interviewed. They stated that the
association was monopolized by committees of
unqualified members, backed up by a so-called
Secretary named Chang Dah-foo (張達夫) and they
have tried to enforce resolutions on the genuine
manufacturers. They further stated that they
requested the convention of a general meeting of
members to discuss various affairs as hitherto,
but the Chairman refused to convene same. He only
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

目前的情况是，前八家成员于8月16日退出了会员资格。第九家工厂否认是该协会的成员，而第二十二家和第二十三家工厂已停业，并未向协会缴纳会费。实际上，有11家工厂不是会员，只有十二家保留了会员资格。就煤球的日产量而言，前八家是最大的工厂，占总产量的90%。协会现有的12家成员仅占产量的约10%。值得注意的是，名单中列为第13号的一家成员最近被市警察带至上海特区法院，因制造劣质煤球被控“欺诈”，并被罚款400.00元。大工厂的生产质量优于小工厂。

关于成员之间的纠纷，已约谈了位于马克姆路（Markham Road）352号的义泰盛煤球厂经理尤春欣（Yeu Tsung-shing），以及位于槟榔路（Penang Road）29号的东方煤球厂经理龐潤生（Z.S. Bourne）。他们表示，该协会被不合格的委员所垄断，并由一名所谓的秘书张达夫（Chang Dah-foo）在背后支持，他们试图对真正的制造商强制执行决议。他们进一步表示，他们曾要求像以往一样召开全体成员大会讨论各项事务，但主席拒绝召开。他只

page_data.en:
- 5 -

allowed "committee meetings". The situation has
become such that the present association wishes
to dictate to the large establishments, in view of
which the seven large factories decided to withdraw
their membership. They further explained that the
prices of coal briquette now are below cost, but
the association conducted propaganda in the press
that the owners had recklessly increased the prices
thus throwing a heavy burden on the public. This
propaganda was intended to camouflage the internal
dispute over the monopoly by the "Secretary" or the
clerk and on the other hand to arouse the feelings
of the public against the large factory owners.
The large factory owners, however, declared that
they wished the Council to form a price-fixing
committee and they were willing to abide by its
decisions. They further said that if the association
be properly reorganized, they were also prepared to
rejoin it.

On the other hand, enquiries were made
from the Chairman of the association, Chen Zuan-fang
(陈華芳), proprietor of the Hwa Shun Zuan Kee
Coal Briquette Factory, 409 Lay Road off Whasning
Road and he was asked why he had refused the factory
owners' request for a general meeting of members
and only allow the convention of committee meetings.
He could not give a satisfactory reply and finally
admitted that he should have accepted the request
for a general meeting. He was also questioned as
to why the owners of large factories had withdrawn
their membership. He at last explained that they
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

允许召开“委员会会议”。局势已发展到协会企图对大型商号发号施令的地步，鉴于此，七家大工厂决定退出会员资格。他们进一步解释说，目前煤球的价格低于成本，但协会在报纸上进行宣传，称业主们肆意提高价格，从而给公众带来沉重负担。这种宣传旨在掩盖由“秘书”或职员垄断引发的内部纠纷，另一方面激起公众对大工厂业主的反感。然而，大工厂业主声明，他们希望工部局组建一个定价委员会，并愿意遵守其决定。他们进一步表示，如果协会得到适当改组，他们也准备重新加入。

另一方面，已向协会主席、位于华胜路（Whasning Road）旁雷路（Lay Road）409号的华顺钻记煤球厂业主陈華芳（Chen Zuan-fang）进行了查询，问他为何拒绝工厂业主召开全体成员大会的请求，而只允许召开委员会会议。他无法给出令人满意的答复，最后承认他本应接受召开全体大会的请求。他还被问及为何大工厂业主退出会员资格。他最后解释说，他们

page_data.en:
- 6 -

were dissatisfied with the clerk of the association
named Chang Dah-foo, who was suspected of having the
intention of monopolizing the affairs of the
association. Chang was, prior to the hostilities,
an employee of the 2nd Department (in charge of trade
associations) of the now defunct Bureau of Social
Affairs of the Shanghai City Government and an
executive committee member of the 3rd District
Kuomintang in Shanghai. Prior to the hostilities,
Sung Ming-chi (孫鳴岐), now chief of the Shanghai
Branch, Social Movement Direct Committee, was working
under him. Chang is still pro-Chungking and refused
repeated requests of the Nanking Government for his
services.

Enquiries made into the present conditions
of the so-called "committees" of the association
show that they are no longer qualified to function
in the association. A list of the "committee"
members together with particulars is given hereunder:-
Executive Committee
Chen Zuan-fang (陳萃芳), proprietor of the
Hwa Shun Zuan Kee Coal Briquette Factory, 407
Ley Road off Washing Road (Chairman)
Huang Tseng-sz (黃振世), formerly owner of
the Hwa Nan Coal Briquette Factory, Chapei off
Karkham Road Bridge, now residing at 400 Rue
Frelupt. He is a "tutee" of Hwang Ching-yoong
and tries to meddle in various spheres and affairs
in Shanghai. It is known that he was behind
the agitation of workers in various cotton weaving
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

对协会名为张达夫的职员不满，此人涉嫌意图垄断协会事务。在战事爆发前，张曾是现已解散的上海市政府社会局第二科（负责同业公会）的雇员，也是国民党上海第三区执行委员会委员。在战事爆发前，现任社会运动指导委员会上海办事处主任的孫鳴岐（Sung Ming-chi）曾在他手下工作。张仍然倾向重庆方面，并多次拒绝了南京政府对其服务的征召。

对协会所谓“委员会”现状的调查表明，它们已不再具备在协会中运作的资格。“委员会”成员名单及其详情如下：-
执行委员会
陈萃芳（Chen Zuan-fang），华顺钻记煤球厂业主，地址为华胜路（Washing Road）旁雷路（Ley Road）407号（主席）
黃振世（Huang Tseng-sz），原为闸北卡克汉姆路桥（Karkham Road Bridge）附近华南煤球厂业主，现居住于弗雷吕普路（Rue Frelupt）400号。他是黄庆荣（Hwang Ching-yoong）的门徒，试图插手上海的各个领域和事务。众所周知，他在1941年初煽动了多家棉纺织厂工人的骚动。他是一个臭名昭著的游手好闲之徒。未向协会缴纳任何会费，因此不再是会员。
邱國楨（Chiu Kuo-Tseng），原为浦东中华煤球厂业主，现为戈登路（Gordon Road）35号896弄华东煤球厂的雇员，该厂管理层已退出协会会员资格。目前他没有煤球厂。
韓丕豪（Han Bei-hao），口华煤球厂经理，地址为马克姆路（Markham Road）668号，已退出协会会员资格。
張賚泰（Chang Lai-tai），光华煤球厂经理，地址为西安路（Sian Road）90号，已退出协会会员资格。
周長春（Chow Chang-tsung），华顺泰记煤球厂经理，地址为康纳特路（Connaught Road）698号。
陸享通（Loh Hang-tung），原为狄思威路（Dixwell Road）中国煤球厂经理。他已不再是煤球厂业主。
监察委员会
李幼華（Li Yeu-hwa），元华煤球厂业主，地址为槟榔路（Penang Road）25号。
毛春圃（Mao Tsung-foo），原为南市南码头胡宗煤球厂业主。他已不再是煤球制造商。他拥有位于曼达莱路（Mandalay Road）105号的清崇煤号。

page_data.en:
- 7 -

factories during the early part of 1941. He is
a notorious loafer. Not paying any membership
fees to the Association, therefore no longer a
member.
Chiu Kuo-Tseng (邱國楨), formerly owner of
the Chung Hwa Coal Briquette Factory, Pootung,
now working as an employee in the Hwa Tung Coal
Briquette Factory, Lane 896, 35 Gordon Road, the
management of which has withdrawn its membership
from the association. At present he has no coal
briquette factory.
Han Bei-hao (韓丕豪), Manager of the Kou Hwa
Coal Briquette Factory, 668 Markham Road, who
has withdrawn his membership from the association.
Chang Lai-tai (張賚泰), Manager of the Kuang
Hwa Coal Briquette Factory, 90 Sian Road, who has
withdrawn his membership from the association.
Chow Chang-tsung (周長春), Manager of the Hwa
Shun Tai Kee Coal Briquette Factory, 698 Connaught
Road.
Loh Hang-tung (陸享通), formerly Manager of
Chung Kou Coal Briquette Factory, Dixwell Road.
He is no longer a coal briquette factory owner.
Supervisory Committee
Li Yeu-hwa (李幼華), owner of the Yuan Hwa
Coal Briquette Factory, 25 Penang Road.
Mao Tsung-foo (毛春圃), formerly owner of the
Huh Tsoong Coal Briquette Factory, Nan Ma Teu,
Nantao. He is no longer a coal briquette
manufacturer. He owns the Tsing Chong Coal Shop,
105 Mandalay Road.
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

吴晓卿（Woo Shiao-ching），原为平凉路华通煤球厂业主，该厂现已关闭。他已不再是煤球制造商。

从上述情况可以看出，在执行委员会的七名成员中，只有两名是煤球制造商；在监察委员会的三名成员中，只有一名具备资格。在1938年、1939年和1940年，所有事务均在不时召开的业主全体大会上讨论。在1941年初，协会基本上处于停滞状态。主席生病，实际上所有事务都交由职员处理。至于会费，退出会员资格的大工厂缴纳300元，而目前剩余的成员每月缴纳68元。为了维持职员的生计以应对当前高昂的生活成本，义泰盛煤球厂每月为该职员支付0.75“扎”大米和2担煤球。由于怀疑该职员不仅不领情大工厂给予的待遇，反而通过在报纸上发表针对他们的文章来使他们难堪，七家大工厂停止向该职员提供进一步的好处，随后该职员开始煽动反对他们。

page_data.en:
- 8 -

Woo Shiao-ching (吴晓卿), formerly owner
of the Hwa Tung Coal Briquette Factory, Pingliang
Road, which is now closed. He is no longer a coal
briquette manufacturer.

It can be seen from the above that out of the seven
members of the executive committee, only two are
coal briquette manufacturers and out of the three
members of the supervisory committee, only one is
qualified. In 1938, 1939 and 1940, all affairs
were discussed during general meetings of owners
convened from time to time. During the early part
of 1941, the association was more or less idle.
The chairman was sick and practically speaking, all
affairs were put in the hands of the clerk. As to
membership fees, the large factories who withdrew
their membership paid $300, while the present remain-
ing members pay $68 a month. For maintaining the
livelihood of the clerk to cope with the present
high cost of living, Nyi Tai Shing Coal Briquette
Factory paid for the clerk 0.75 "zar" of rice and
2 piculs of coal briquettes a month. On suspecting
that the clerk not only failed to appreciate the
treatment extended by the large factories, but
tried to embarrass them by causing articles to be
published in the press against them, the seven large
factories stopped further issues of benefits to the
clerk, who then began to agitate against them.
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

回到协会只允许召开委员会会议这一点，值得注意的是，这些不合格的委员会在七家大工厂退出会员资格后，于8月18日举行了“第一次”会议。

在这次会议上，决议授权借款2,000元以支付协会费用，并要求退出的工厂缴纳会费。利用这笔贷款，约400元用于在8月20日的报纸上刊登广告，谴责七家大工厂（见附件“D”）。在该通知中，协会承认拒绝了七位业主召开全体大会的请求。当被问及为何由无关人员和不合格成员组成的委员会仍应运作并对真诚且利害相关的商人强制推行事物时，职员张达夫辩称，重庆政府在大约三年前发布了一项命令，规定所有组织的委员会在当前战事期间不得改组，而是继续运作而不进行重选。从协会在战事后从未召开过“委员会”会议，以及协会将从8月18日起才召开“委员会”会议的事实来看，显然有一伙外人希望在重庆政府命令的幌子下垄断事务，并将由不合格“委员”通过的决议强加于其他真诚的商人身上。

page_data.en:
- 9 -

Returning to the point that the association
only permitted committee meetings, it is to be noted
that these unqualified committees held their "first"
meeting on August 18, following the withdrawal from
membership of the seven large factories.

During this meeting it was resolved that a
loan of $2,000 be authorized to defray expenses of
the association and that the withdrawing factories
should pay membership fees. With the loan, some
$400 was spent to put an advertisement in the press
dated August 20, denouncing the seven big factories
(attached as Appendix "D"). In the notice the
association admitted having refused the request of
the seven owners to convene a general meeting.
When questioned as to why the committees which are
composed of disinterested persons and unqualified mem-
bers, should still function and enforce things on
bona fide and interested merchants, Chang Dah-foo,
the clerk, argued that the Chungking Government
issued a mandate about 3 years ago that committees
of all organizations be not reorganized during the
present period of hostilities, but continued to
function without re-election. From the facts
that the association never held "committee" meetings
following the hostilities and the association will
only hold "committee" meetings as from August 18, it
seems apparent that a clique of outsiders wished
to monopolize affairs under the cloak of the
mandate of the Chungking Government and to enforce
resolutions passed by unqualified "committee members"
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

同样值得注意的是，协会打算于9月1日举行第二次“委员会”会议，据收到的消息，会议计划通过一项决议，成立一个定价委员会，并将每担煤球的价格定为15或16元，而非17.20元，从而扰乱市场并向大工厂施加压力。由于未获得警方许可，会议被取消。

关于协会的现有组织，主席陈萃芳承认协会未按适当和合法的方式运作。他解释说，这场纠纷事实上是由大工厂业主与协会职员之间的误解引起的，成员之间实际上并不存在纠纷，而且该职员已主动宣布辞职，并于9月6日正式获准。据悉，该职员倾向重庆方面，而在上海秘密活动的当地党部已调查此事，并命令他离职前往香港。党部认为他篡夺了由党部委任的职位的职能。主席声明，协会将进行改组，他将向市警察申请注册，并希望

page_data.en:
- 10 -

on the other bona fide merchants. It is also
interesting to note that the association intended
to hold its second "committee" meeting on September 1,
and according to information received the meeting
planned to pass a resolution to form a price-fixing
committee and fix a price of $15 or $16 per picul
of briquettes against $17.20 and thus disturb the
market and bring pressure to bear on the large
factories. Owing to permission not having been
obtained from the Police, the meeting was abandoned.
In connection with the present organization
of the association, Cheng Zuan-fang, the Chairman,
admitted that the association is not operating in
a proper and legal way. He explained that the
dispute was as a matter of fact started through a
misunderstanding between the owners of the large
factories and the clerk of the association and there
was no dispute in reality existing between members
and that the clerk had announced his resignation of
his own accord, which was duly accepted on September 6th.
It is learned that the clerk is pro-Chungking and the
local Tangpu, which is functioning secretly in Shanghai,
has investigated the matter and given orders for
him to leave the position and go to Hongkong. The
Tangpu considered him to be usurping his functions,
in a position to which he was appointed by the
Tangpu. The Chairman declared that the association
would be reorganized and he would apply to the
Municipal Police for registration and wished the bene-
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

在改组协会方面得到警方的意见指导。然而，截至目前尚未收到任何申请。

9月3日，在新闸路（Sinza Road）182-184号义泰盛公司总部发现一枚未爆炸的手榴弹。9月6日，一枚炸弹被扔进位于通肯路（Tonquin Road）1028号的南洋煤球厂。炸弹爆炸，三名员工受伤。对此事的调查目前显示，这些行为是由极司菲尔路（Jessfield road）76号的人员所为。据说，极司菲尔路76号收到了约700封信件，谴责大工厂提高煤球价格，因此使用炸弹作为警告。截至目前，无法确认这些行为是由协会成员实施或唆使的。

------------------

鉴于上述报告，谨建议在以下条件下考虑注册：-

1. 警告主席确保暂停协会的进一步活动，特别是不合格“委员”的活动，直至由市警察进行适当改组和注册。

2. 与当地煤球制造业不再有关联的人员退出协会。

page_data.en:
- 11 -

fit of Police views in reorganizing the association.
No application has so far been received, however.
On September 3, a hand grenade was found
unexploded in the Head office of the Nyi Tai Shing
Company, 182-184 Sinza Road. On September 6, a
bomb was thrown into the Nanyang Coal Briquette
Factory, 1028 Tonquin Road. It exploded and three
employees were injured. Enquiries in this connection
so far show that these acts were perpetrated by
persons from 76 Jessfield road. It is said that
some 700 letters were received at 76 Jessfield Road
denouncing the large factories for raising the
prices of coal briquettes, and as a result bombs
were used in order to serve as warnings. Up to
the present no confirmation can be obtained that
these acts were committed or instigated by members
of the association.

------------------

In connection with the above report, it is
respectfully suggested that registration be
considered on the following conditions :-

1. That the Chairman be warned to ensure that
further activities of the association,
especially by unqualified "committee
members" be suspended pending proper
reorganization and registration by the
Municipal Police.

2. That persons no longer connected with the
local briquette manufacturing trade
withdraw from the association.
page_data.zh:
- 11 -

3. 为了改组目的，召开真诚成员和制造商的全体大会，在会上组建新的委员会接管事务。

此外，为了公众利益，应由工部局（S.M.C.）、法公董局（C.M.F.）、煤屑经销商和煤球制造商的代表组成一个“煤球定价委员会”，以研究并执行合理的价格。定价权不能留在同业公会手中，因为同业公会要么完全站在制造商一边，要么完全反对他们。

经核证无误副本。
------------------
csc/:

page_data.en:
- 12 -

3. That for the purpose of reorganization, a
general meeting of bona fide members and
manufacturers be convened, at which new
committees be formed to take over charge
of affairs.

It will also be to the interest of the
general public that a "coal briquette price-fixing
committee" be formed by members of the S.M.C.,
C.M.F., dealers in coal dust, and representatives
of coal briquette manufacturers to study and
enforce reasonable prices. The price-fixing cannot
be left in the hands of the trade association, which
will be either entirely on the side of the manufacturers
or absolutely opposed to them.

Certified true copy.
------------------
csc/:
page_data.zh:
- 12 -

3. 为重组之目的，应召开由正式会员及制造商参加的全体会议，并在会上组建新的委员会以接管事务。

此外，为了公众利益，应由工部局（S.M.C.）、法公董局（C.M.F.）成员、煤屑经销商以及煤球制造商代表组成一个“煤球价格核定委员会”，以研究并执行合理的价格。价格核定工作不能交由同业公会负责，因为该公会要么完全站在制造商一边，要么与他们彻底对立。

经核证无误之副本。
------------------

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
CONFIDENTIAL
S. 1, Special Branch Station File No.
Date September 9, 1941.

SUBJECT: Dispute in the Coal Briquette Trade Association.

On August 10, nine large coal briquette factories in Shanghai addressed a joint letter to the S.M.C. (Appendix "A"). It states that by taking advantage of disorganization in the association, certain minor officers of the association fabricated rumours detrimental to the reputation of the writers and brought about disaffection among member factories. It further mentions that they requested the association in writing to convene a general meeting of factory owners, but the request was rejected by the association. The writers therefore resigned their membership of the association on August 16. The letter finally requested the Council to order the publishers of local Chinese newspapers not to publish any further reports detrimental to the writers' reputation and business.

On August 26, these nine factories addressed a further letter (Appendix "B") to the S.M.C. In this letter the writers requested the Council to sponsor the formation of a coal briquette price-fixing committee to be composed of representatives appointed by
1. S.M.C.
2. C.M.F.
3. firms interested in the briquette business :-
(a) Shanghai Office of the Societe Francaise des Charbonnages du Tonkin, 2nd floor, A.P.C. building, 9 The Bund.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
机密
S. 1，特科分局档案号。
日期：1941年9月9日。

主题：煤球同业公会纠纷。

8月10日，上海九家大型煤球厂联名致函工部局（附录“A”）。信中称，某些公会低级职员利用公会内部混乱局面，捏造有损写信人声誉的谣言，并在会员工厂间制造不和。信中还提到，他们曾书面请求公会召开厂主大会，但遭到公会拒绝。因此，写信人于8月16日退出了该公会。信件最后请求公董局命令本地中文报纸出版商不再刊登任何有损写信人声誉及业务的报道。

8月26日，这九家工厂再次致函工部局（附录“B”）。在此信中，写信人请求公董局赞助成立一个煤球价格核定委员会，成员由以下各方指派的代表组成：
1. 工部局。
2. 法公董局。
3. 与煤球业务有关的商行：-
(a) 东京湾法国煤矿公司上海办事处，外滩9号亚细亚火油公司大楼二楼。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Station. File No. ...... Date ......

SUBJECT: - 2 -

(b) Compagnie Optorg, importers of Hongay Coal
Dust, 39 Avenue Edward VII.

(c) Zeh Zeng Company, importers of "Ku Pah"
Coal Dust, 22 Avenue Dubail.

They announced that they were willing to submit to
any reasonable control and to send representatives
to attend any meetings to furnish particulars.

Appendix "C" is a letter dated August 29
addressed by the Coal Briquette Trade Association to
the S.M.C. It states that a meeting of members of
its Executive and Supervisory Committees was held
on August 18 when it was decided to request the
S.M.C. to prohibit the coal briquette factories
from raising the wholesale prices without formal
notice given in writing by the Association (according
to the translator of the letter, the sentence in
original text was clumsily worded).

With reference to the above, enquiries
were made into the conditions in the present trade
association; and the following facts brought to
light :-

The trade association was formed in
October, 1936 and was registered with the now defunct
local Koumintang and Bureau of Social Affairs and

“委员会”会议，且直到 8 月 18 日才举行“委员会”
会议，显然有一伙外人希望借重庆政府命令之名垄断
事务，并将由不具备资格的“委员”通过的决议强加
给其他真诚的商人。另外值得注意的是，该协会计划
于 9 月 1 日举行第二次“委员会”会议，据收到的
消息，该会议计划通过一项决议，成立一个价格固定
委员会，将每担煤球的价格定为 15 或 16 美元，以
对抗 17.20 美元的价格，从而扰乱市场并向大工厂
施加压力。由于未获得警方许可，该会议被取消。

关于该协会目前的组织情况，主席陈萃芳
（Cheng Zuan-fang）承认协会的运作方式不当且不合法。
他解释说，这场纠纷实际上是由大工厂业主与协会
职员之间的误解引起的，其成员之间实际上并不存在
纠纷，且该职员已宣布辞职 /

In connection with the above report, it is respectfully suggested that registration be considered on the following conditions :-

1. That the Chairman be warned to ensure that further activities of the association, especially by unqualified "committee members" be suspended pending proper reorganization and registration by the Municipal Police.

2. That persons no longer connected with the local briquette manufacturing trade withdraw from the association.

3. That for the purpose of reorganization, a general meeting of bona fide members and manufacturers be convened, at which new committees be formed to take over charge of affairs.

It will also be to the interest of the general public that a "coal briquette price-fixing committee" be formed by members of the S.M.C., C.M.F., dealers in coal dust, and representatives of coal briquette manufacturers to study and enforce reasonable prices. The price-fixing cannot be left in the hands of the trade association, which will be either entirely on the side of the manufacturers or absolutely opposed to them.

Kuo Min Daily News, New China Daily News, Central China
Daily News and Bing Pao :-

BOMBING CASE IN THE NYI TAI SHING COAL SHOP ON SINZA ROAD

As the Nyi Tai Shing, Nanyang, Kuo Hwa,
Tsing Hwa and several other coal factories have withdrawn
from the Coal Trade Guild and jointly announced an
increase in the price of coal briquettes, the general
public are criticising their activities.
At 8 a.m. yesterday, some persons
threw a hand grenade into the Nyi Tai Shing Shop at
No. 184 Sinza Road, but fortunately the grenade did not
explode.
Sinza Police Station was informed
and a large party of policemen and detectives were detailed
to the scene. Later the grenade was removed to the
Station. Whether the case is connected with the
withdrawal of the Nyi Tai Shing from the guild is unknown,
but the Police regard the affair as a very serious matter.

Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition published the following letter
on September 2 :-

THE BUYING OF PAWNED ARTICLES

To the Editor,
At present, there exists a kind of
business which deals with the buying of pawned articles.
The persons engaged in this business display large
signboards bearing the character "Tang" (meaning "pawn"),
so as to mislead the illiterate. They also accept
clothing and ornaments on pledge. Many people have
suffered through them. Interest at the rate of 30 cents
per dollar for ten days is charged. This means an
interest of 100% per mensem. Last year, the authorities
suppressed the business but it was resumed shortly
afterwards. At present, the number of such people
doing this business has increased, yet the authorities
have taken no steps to suppress them.
It is hoped that you will publish
this letter so that the authorities concerned may take
action. Unless this business be thoroughly suppressed,
the poor people will suffer heavily.
Sien Chao Sz( 仙 乔 氏 ),
1190 Gordon Road.

SUBJECT: Shanghai Municipality Coal Briquettes Factory
Owners' Guild - committee meeting postponed.

With reference to the attached report in the
Chinese press dated September 1 to the effect that the
Shanghai Municipality Coal Briquettes Factory Owners'
Guild intended holding a meeting in its office at
office at 405 Tientsin Road, at 3 p.m. September 1, it
is to be noted that there is a dispute among the
members of the guild, who have divided into two cliques.
One clique consists of large coal briquettes factory
owners, who have withdrawn from the guild, while the
other consists of small factory owners representing 4%
of the local production. It is strongly suspected
that the latter clique by dint of its influence on the
committee of the association, which has not been re-
elected since 1937, intends controlling and embarrassing
the other. The large coal briquettes factory owners
have written to the Shanghai Municipal Council
complaining against the guild. The matter is under
investigation and results will form the subject of a
detailed report in due course.

The guild is not registered with the Municipal
Police, nor did it apply to the Police for permission
to hold the meeting. Furthermore it was discovered
that some of the committee members due to attend the
meeting were not qualified to take part in the guild
affairs owing to their having given up the coal

further investigation, Chang Dah-foo (张达夫),

August 20, 1941. Afternoon Translation.
National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao,
Shun Pao and Sin Wen Pao :-

NOTICE OF SHANGHAI MUNICIPALITY COAL BRIQUETTES TRADE
GUILD DENOUNCING A STATEMENT OF SEVEN COAL BRIQUETTE
FACTORIES

"With reference to the advertisements of the
Nyí Tai Shing, the Nanyang, the Tung Fang, the Kwang Hwa,
the Yu Tung and the Tsing Hwa Coal Briquettes Factories,
published in the August 18th issue of various newspapers
declaring their withdrawal from the guild, the content
of which was of a defamatory nature, the guild explains
as follows :-
Since the establishment of the guild, it has
worked much for the welfare of the member factories and
for the benefit of the society. Both large and small
factories are fairly treated by the guild, but these
seven factories announced that no person is now responsible
for the guild and therefore the work has long been
suspended. As a matter of fact, the work of our guild
has never been interrupted. As for the news of the coal
briquette business published by various papers, the seven
factories did not know how to keep confidential matter,
but blamed the staffs of our guild for making use of
opportunity to circulate false news. In regard to the
complaint of the seven factories that various factories
have jointly requested the guild to convene a joint meeting
of supervisory and executive committees on several
occasions, the guild not only refused to do so but also
made no reply. There are no definite regulations
governing the opening of joint meetings of the Executive
and Supervisory Committees. In the past, such meetings
were held occasionally at the request of the seven
factories and also at times for the purpose of persuading
these seven factories to cooperate in the cheap sale of
coal briquettes. After July, last year, these seven
factories firmly refused to continue the cheap sales
and privately increased the price of coal briquettes.
Up to July 25, this year, the price has reached a very
high point, and this has aroused the indignation and
public opinion of the citizens. The seven factories
then requested the guild to call a meeting, but the guild
knew their motive and refused to do so. It is
reasonable to refuse them as they have refused to pay off
their overdue membership fees. Furthermore the guild
is not in need of more members of the Executive and
Supervisory Committees. A joint meeting held on
August 18 was attended by almost all the members, with
exception of two members named Chang and Heng. So the
action taken by these factories to withdraw from the guild
is unreasonable and illegitimate. For fear that the
public will be deceived by these seven factories, the
guild therefore publishes this notice.

F. T. O.

上海市煤球业同业公会谴责七家煤球厂声明之公告

“鉴于尼泰盛（Nyí Tai Shing）、南洋（Nanyang）、东方（Tung Fang）、光华（Kwang Hwa）、裕通（Yu Tung）及清华（Tsing Hwa）等煤球厂在8月18日各报刊登广告，宣称退出本公会，其内容具有诽谤性质，本公会特此说明如下：-
自公会成立以来，为本会会员工厂之福利及社会利益做了大量工作。无论大厂小厂，公会均公平对待，但这七家工厂声称目前无人对公会负责，因此工作早已停顿。事实上，本公会的工作从未中断。至于各报刊登的关于煤球行业的消息，这七家工厂不知如何保守机密，反而指责本公会工作人员利用机会散布虚假消息。关于这七家工厂投诉称，多家工厂曾多次联合请求公会召开监理委员会与执行委员会联席会议，而公会不仅拒绝，且未予答复一事。召开执行委员会与监理委员会联席会议并无明确规章。过去，此类会议偶尔应这七家工厂的要求召开，有时也是为了说服这七家工厂配合廉价销售煤球。去年七月后，这七家工厂坚决拒绝继续廉价销售，并私下提高煤球价格。截至今年7月25日，价格已涨至极高水准，激起市民愤慨及舆论不满。随后这七家工厂请求公会召开会议，但公会知晓其动机，故予拒绝。鉴于他们拒绝缴纳逾期会费，拒绝他们的要求是合理的。此外，公会并不需要增加执行委员会和监理委员会的成员。8月18日举行的联席会议，除张（Chang）和恒（Heng）两名成员外，几乎所有成员均出席。因此，这些工厂采取退出公会的行动是不合理且不合法的。为防止公众被这七家工厂欺骗，本公会特此发布本公告。

F. T. O.

Briquette Factories and their grievances.

The Shanghai Machine-made Coal Briquette Manufacturers'
Association has been established for a number of years, and
has spared no pains in adjusting fuel supply and stabilizing
the price of briquettes. In 1938, as most of the members of
its executive and supervisory committees were absent from
this city, a general meeting of the various briquette factories
was held under the leadership of the Association's Chairman
Mr. Tang Tsi-fong (唐 梓 芳) in lieu of the regular committee
meeting. Since the outbreak of the local hostilities more than
forty general meetings have been called by the chairman; all
these meetings were conducted smoothly.

Of late Mr. Tang, on account of illness, has been
unable to attend office for a long time. As a result the
Association has been without a responsible officer and its
affairs are at a standstill. Taking advantage of this
opportunity, certain minor officers of the Association have
fabricated rumours detrimental to our reputation, and done
their utmost to injure us materially as well as to bring
about disaffection among member factories. In our capacity
as members we have on several occasions requested the
Association in writing to convene a general meeting of
factory owners, but all our requests have been rejected.
Up to the present the Association has held no meeting for
eight months. In these circumstances the Association now
exists only in name; practically it has already been
disorganized. Having no alternative we addressed a joint
letter to the Association on the 16th instant, requesting
permission to temporarily relinquish our membership, with
page_data.zh:
档案号 F 30/12
广沃煤球有限公司及其他9家煤球厂
致工部局请愿书译文。
日期：1941年8月10日。

煤球厂及其不满之处。

上海机制煤球制造同业公会成立已有数年，为调节燃料供应及稳定煤球价格不遗余力。1938年，由于其执行委员会和监理委员会多数成员不在本市，在公会主席唐梓芳先生领导下，召开了各煤球厂大会，以代替常规委员会会议。自本地战事爆发以来，主席已召集四十余次大会；所有会议均顺利进行。

近期，唐先生因病长期无法办公。结果导致公会缺乏负责人，事务陷入停滞。某些公会下级职员利用此机会，编造损害我方声誉的谣言，并极力在物质上损害我们，并在会员工厂间制造不和。作为会员，我们曾多次书面请求公会召开厂主大会，但所有请求均被拒绝。截至目前，公会已有八个月未召开会议。在此情况下，公会现在仅存其名；实际上已处于解散状态。别无选择之下，我们于本月16日联名致函公会，请求允许暂时放弃会员资格，并

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the reservation that we may apply to rejoin in accordance
with regulations when the Association's affairs are again
in the hands of a responsible officer and are managed properly.
We beg hereby to report to the Council our reasons for withdrawing
from the Association as above. Please place this matter on
record.

With regard to the price of briquettes we wish to state
that our cost has greatly advanced owing to the rapid rise of
freight charges and the sudden fall in the exchange value of
the Chinese dollar. Our difficulties have daily increased
and our capital has dwindled. There have been frequent reports
of briquette factories being compelled to close down. The
present moment is one of extreme distress to us. Certain
unscrupulous persons, however, have circulated malicious
reports through the vernacular press calculated to damage
our reputation. Our factories have always endeavoured to serve
the public by maintaining an adequate fuel supply. At present,
when the entire nation is passing through a crisis, no one
who is not wholly void of conscience will take the opportunity
to enrich himself at the expense of others. Though we dare
not call ourselves the most loyal servants of the community
in the present period of emergency, we are quite willing to
silently bear our own onerous burdens. Our hardships are
perhaps appreciated by the Council. A copy of a statement
showing the cost price of coal briquettes as manufactured
by the various undersigned factories is hereby submitted
for record. Should the Council desire any further information
regarding the briquette business, the same will be promptly
supplied when a direct enquiry is made to any of our factories.
Will the Council kindly take note of our petition and order
the publishers of the various local Chinese newspapers not to
publish any further reports detrimental to our reputation and
business; we shall be very grateful for this favour. A similar
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

保留一项权利，即当公会事务再次由负责人掌管并得到妥善管理时，我们可以按规定申请重新加入。兹将上述退出公会之理由呈报工部局备案。恳请予以记录。

关于煤球价格，我们要指出，由于运费迅速上涨及法币汇率突然下跌，我们的成本大幅上升。我们的困难日益增加，资本逐渐耗尽。经常有关于煤球厂被迫关闭的报道。目前时刻对我们而言极度艰难。然而，某些无良之人通过中文报刊散布恶意报道，意在损害我们的声誉。我厂一直努力维持充足的燃料供应以服务公众。目前，当整个国家正处于危机之中时，任何尚存良心的人都不会趁机损人利己。虽然我们在目前的紧急时期不敢自称为社区最忠诚的服务者，但我们完全愿意默默承受自身的沉重负担。工部局或许能体谅我们的艰辛。现附上由各署名工厂生产的煤球成本价说明书一份，以备查考。如工部局希望了解有关煤球行业的进一步信息，只要直接向我们要任何一家工厂查询，我们将迅速提供。恳请工部局留意我们的请愿，并命令上海各中文报纸出版商不再刊登任何损害我们声誉和业务的报道；我们将对此恩惠感激不尽。类似的

Coal Ball Hoarders
Denounced

Price Reaches New High
Record; Official Control
Urged by Chinese Press

During the past few days the
price of coal balls needed by the
Chinese for cooking has been quoted
at $12 per picul, which has created
another record in the price-increas-
ing campaign launched by manipulat-
ing merchants in Shanghai. It is
now twelve times the price quoted
the pre-war days, and most Chinese
cannot afford to pay. The sudden
increase of price of this necessary
has caused a great stir among Chin-
ese housewives, and hope is expres-
sed again that the authorities will
pay attention to the alleged hoarding
indulged in by coal merchants.
Chinese circles find evidence of
hoarding in advertisements appearing
in the leading Chinese dailies pub-
lished by big coal ball manufactur-
ing firms urging their customers to
remove large quantities of coal balls
they ordered long ago. These cus-
tomers who have ample means at
their disposal have bought the coal,
which is apparently much more than
they can consume, and the advertis-
ers urge the hoarders to take out the
cargo, threatening to sell it to other
customers who need it for immediate
use. The advertisers promise to re-
fund deposits from big customers,
giving a time-limit for the latter to
remove the cargo they ordered.
Small coal ball manufacturing firms
admit that they are also hard hit by
the strange situation, alleging that
big factories have been hoarding
large quantities of coal needed for
making coal balls. They have sent a
petition to the Shanghai Machine-
made Coal Ball Manufacturers As-
sociation, urging that big factories
sell their coal to small firms. The
firms hoarding the material for mak-
ing coal balls are mentioned in
the petition. These charges and
counter charges between coal ball
factories and their customers and be-
tween coal ball merchants themselves
provide valuable data for official
action against hoarding.
page_data.zh:
囤积煤球者
遭谴责

价格创历史新高；
中文报刊呼吁官方管制

过去几天，中国人做饭所需的煤球报价为每担12美元，这在上海操纵市场的商人发起的涨价运动中又创下了新纪录。现在是战前报价的十二倍，大多数中国人无力支付。这种必需品的价格突然上涨在中国家庭主妇中引起了巨大骚动，人们再次表示希望当局关注据称煤商进行的囤积行为。中文界人士从主要中文日报上刊登的大型煤球制造公司的广告中找到了囤积的证据，这些广告敦促客户提走很久以前订购的大量煤球。这些拥有充足资金的客户购买的煤炭显然远超其消耗量，广告商敦促囤积者提货，威胁将其出售给其他需要立即使用的客户。广告商承诺退还大客户的定金，并规定了后者提走所订货物的时限。小型煤球制造厂承认他们也受到这种奇怪情况的严重打击，声称大型工厂一直囤积大量用于制造煤球的煤炭。他们已向上海机制煤球制造商协会提交请愿书，敦促大型工厂将煤炭出售给小型工厂。请愿书中提到了囤积煤球原料的工厂。煤球厂与其客户之间以及煤球商相互之间的这些指控和反指控，为官方采取反囤积行动提供了有价值的数据。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTER
S. B. D. 7555/6
Date 3 / 4

March 26, 1941. Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao, National Herald,
Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao :-

Rise in price of coal briquettes due to activities of
unscrupulous merchants

Without any regard for the livelihood of poor
people or for peace and good order, coal worms are raising
the price of coal. They hold large stocks of coal dust
and refuse to sell under the pretext that the transportation
of coal is faced with great difficulties and coal stocks are
not ample. At the same time, they fabricate rumours at
the mart to mislead the general public.
The Nanyang (南洋), the Kuo Hwa (國華)
and other coal briquette factories yesterday raised the price
of coal briquettes from $186 a ton to $226 a ton, an increase
of $40, on the ground of increased cost of coal dust. The
retail price of coal briquettes has increased to $12 for one
hundred catties.
Coal briquettes are indispensable to poor
people and the sharp increase in price will prove a heavy
burden to them.
A certain prominent coal merchant, in an
interview with our reporter, said that there are about
60,000 tons of coal dust in Shanghai for the manufacture
of coal briquettes and that large quantities of coal dust
have been boarded by the Nanyang, the Nyi Tai Shing, the
Tung Chen (通成), the Kuo Hwa and other coal companies.
These companies will make an additional profit of several
million dollars from the present sharp increase in the price
of coal briquettes.
In a few days the Shanghai Municipality Coal
Briquette Factory Owners Guild will hold a meeting of
representatives of coal briquette factories to discuss the
price of coal briquettes.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别巡捕房登记册
S. B. D. 7555/6
日期 3 / 4

1941年3月26日。上午译件

《中美日报》、《诚言报》、《国民新闻》、
《申报》及《新闻晚报》：-

煤球价格上涨系无良商人活动所致

不顾贫民生计或和平秩序，煤蛀虫正在抬高煤价。他们持有大量煤粉库存，并以煤炭运输面临巨大困难及煤炭库存不足为借口拒绝出售。同时，他们在市场上编造谣言以误导公众。
南洋（Nanyang）、国华（Kuo Hwa）及其他煤球厂昨日以煤粉成本增加为由，将煤球价格从每吨186美元提高至226美元，上涨了40美元。煤球的零售价格已涨至每百斤12美元。
煤球对穷人来说是不可或缺的，价格的急剧上涨将成为他们的沉重负担。
某知名煤商在接受本报记者采访时称，上海约有6万吨用于制造煤球的煤粉，大量煤粉被南洋、尼泰盛（Nyi Tai Shing）、通成（Tung Chen）、国华（Kuo Hwa）及其他煤业公司囤积。这些公司将从目前煤球价格的急剧上涨中额外获利数百万美元。
数日后，上海市煤球厂业主公会将举行煤球厂代表会议，讨论煤球价格问题。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
S.I, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date....Feb....18,....1941.

Subject............Increase in the price of coal briquettes.

Made by............and....................Forwarded by............C.D.I.. Tabrum

With reference to the attached translation
of a newspaper report which appeared in the Central
China Daily News of February 10, 1941 in regard to
an increase in the price of coal briquettes, enquiries
show that the Coal Briquette Factory Owners'
Association, 405 Tientsin Road, hitherto fixed the
price of coal briquettes from time to time and this
ruling was observed by the briquette manufacturers.
But since July 31, 1940, the association has failed
to fix prices with the result that the factory owners
decided to fix the prices of briquettes in accordance
with the fluctuation of the price of coal slack.
It has been ascertained that the coal
briquette factory owners are not making much profit
from the briquettes manufactured from coal dust at
the prevailing price of coal. Some factories, it
is reported, are mixing coke dust in the manufacture
of briquettes so as to keep the cost at a low level.
The present wholesale price of briquettes is $168.00
per ton excluding delivery charge and the retail price
is $9.00 per picul or $180.00 per ton.
There is a decrease in the supply of coal
dust at Shanghai owing to but few ships arriving in
Port. The supply however is sufficient for local
needs at present. The situation will be watched
and further particulars included in the next monthly
report on the coal situation.

R. S. Tabrum
C. D. I.
A.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期....1941年2月....18日....

主题............煤球价格上涨。

制作人............及.................... 转呈人............C.D.I.. Tabrum

关于附上的1941年2月10日《华中日报》刊登的关于煤球价格上涨的新闻报道译文，经查询显示，位于天津路405号的煤球厂主协会此前不时规定煤球价格，各煤球制造商均遵守此规定。但自1940年7月31日以来，该协会未能制定价格，导致各厂主决定根据煤屑价格的波动来确定煤球价格。
经查实，在目前的煤炭价格下，煤球厂主从用煤粉制造的煤球中获利不多。据报道，一些工厂在制造煤球时混合焦粉，以保持低成本。目前煤球的批发价为每吨168.00元（不含运费），零售价为每担9.00元或每吨180.00元。
由于抵达港口的船只寥寥无几，上海的煤粉供应有所减少。然而，目前的供应足以满足本地需求。我们将密切关注事态发展，并在下一份关于煤炭情况的月度报告中列入更多详情。

R. S. Tabrum
C. D. I.
助理总监（特务科）

page_data.en:
Central China Daily News of February 10 :-
PRICE OF COAL BRIQUETTES RAISED UNDER PRETEXT OF INSUFFICIENT
SUPPLIES OF COAL DUST

The Shanghai Municipality Coal Briquette
Factory Owners' Guild has fixed the price of coal briquettes
at $140 per ton or $7 per hundred catties excluding delivery
charges. When the supply of coal dust was more or less
affected by the situation in Annam, the leading coal briquette
factories took advantage of the situation and raised the
price, contrary to the resolution of the Guild.
As the various coal briquette factories
are members of the Shanghai Municipality Coal Briquette
Factory Owners' Guild, they should, therefore, carry on their
business in accordance with the resolutions of the Guild.
However, some coal merchants are so bold that they ignore
the Guild and have repeatedly raised the price.
The representatives of the Nyi Tai Shing
(美泰兴), Nanyang (南洋), Kuo Hwa (国华) and other leading
coal briquette factories have never attended any meeting
called by the Guild, consequently, they refuse to observe
the resolutions of the Guild on the ground that they were
not present when the resolutions were passed. When the
supply of coal dust was obstructed, these black-hearted
merchants would immediately fix the price themselves. As
they are owners of the local coal dust and coal briquette
factories, the smaller coal briquette factories are not in
a position to oppose them and the price of coal briquettes
has thus been increasing continuously.
The residents are hoping that the persons
who are working for the stabilization of commodity prices
will check the activities of these unscrupulous and conscience-
less merchants and, at the same time, quickly devise effective
measures to stabilize the fuel question.
The leading coal briquette factories are
always raising the price of coal briquettes under the pretext
of interruption of supplies of coal dust. Actually, coal dust
is being transported here without interruption.
page_data.zh:
2月10日《华中日报》：
以煤粉供应不足为借口提高煤球价格

上海市煤球厂主公会已将煤球价格定为每吨140元或每百斤7元，不含运费。当安南局势或多或少影响煤粉供应时，主要煤球厂利用这一局势提高了价格，这与公会的决议相悖。
由于各家煤球厂均为上海市煤球厂主公会的成员，因此它们应按照公会的决议开展业务。然而，一些煤商胆大妄为，无视公会，多次提高价格。
美泰兴 (Nyi Tai Shing)、南洋 (Nanyang)、国华 (Kuo Hwa) 等主要煤球厂的代表从未参加过公会召集的任何会议，因此，他们以通过决议时不在场为由，拒绝遵守公会决议。当煤粉供应受阻时，这些黑心商人便立即自行定价。由于他们是本地煤粉和煤球厂的业主，小型煤球厂无力反对他们，因此煤球价格持续上涨。
居民希望致力于稳定物价的人员能遏制这些无良且丧尽天良的商人的活动，同时迅速制定有效措施以稳定燃料问题。
主要煤球厂总是以煤粉供应中断为借口提高煤球价格。实际上，煤粉正源源不断地运抵此处。

February, 21, 1940.
Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following letter:-

COAL BRIQUETTE FACTORIES REFUTE CHARGES BY CORRESPONDENT

To the Editor,
We have to inform you that Item 3 of the article appearing in your paper on February 20 on the subject of coal briquettes is contrary to facts.
The Dah Mou Coal Briquette Factory (大茂) was established in November last year. As it was located in Pootung, the difficulties in transportation increased the cost of the goods and in consequence the factory sustained some loss and had to suspend operations for the time being.
Following the establishment of the Dah Mou Coal Briquette Factory, Mr. Nyi (倪), manager of the Western District Branch of the factory, held several discussions with fellow traders here and the relations between him and others were friendly. The allegation that there had been strong competition among them is not true.
All the godown warrants issued by our factories are recorded in our books. At present all our factories have a sufficient stock of materials. We have repeatedly notified our customers to take delivery of their goods. The present rise in the price of coal briquettes is due to increased transportation charges and costs and also to the hoarding by the holders of godown warrants; it is not the fault of the coal briquette factories. We have now accepted the suggestion of the Chamber of Commerce and our Guild to keep down as much as possible the transportation charges and the costs and at the same time to expedite the delivery of goods by the holders of godown warrants. In this manner the price of coal briquettes will soon return to normal. It is deeply hoped that the public will not believe in unfounded rumours and thus worry themselves unnecessarily.
We request your paper to public this letter for public information.

Nyi Tai Shing (義泰兴) Coal Briquette Factory,

PURCHASE OF PRIVATELY OWNED COAL STOCKS
FOR RE-DISTRIBUTION.

In helping to meet the immediate requirements of
consumers who are urgently and essentially in need of
coal, it would be of great assistance if the Coal Control
Office were authorized to purchase certain available privately
owned stocks for re-distribution.

Accounting procedure may be arranged with the Treasurer
who would be consulted in regard to any particular transaction.
Cash operations, which it is expected would be of very short
duration, would not involve the Council in any loss since a
reasonable but sufficient handling charge (10% minimum) would be
imposed. Furthermore, there are coal experts on the Coal Control
Office staff who are familiar with this type of work.

The approval of the Coal Control Committee has already been
obtained and authority is now requested to operate on the above
basis.

guild to supply food to committee members, but

13 NOV 1940
POLICE FORCE

Translation of Petition to Chinese Deputy
Secretary from the Shanghai Hot Water
Dealers' Association.
Dated 11th November, 1940.

Coal prices.

More than 500 members of this association have called at
our office to enquire why the price of coal dust, intended to
be sold cheap to us, has been suddenly raised by twenty dollars
per ton as recently announced by the Coal Dealers' Association.
They state as follows:-

"Some time ago the Kailan Mining Administration
discontinued selling to us the coal allotted by
registration. As a result, coal merchants took the
opportunity to profiteer; the price of coal rapidly
advanced, and many of us who were unable to carry on
had perforce to close our shops. A petition, setting
forth four points which have a serious bearing on the
community, was then addressed to a General Meeting
of the members of this Association, asking that
negotiations be instituted with the Mining Administration
for permission to purchase coal direct. The
Administration agreed to sell to us, through the Hyi
T'a Hsing, Yuan T'a and Fo Tsung Coal Companies, two
tons of coal monthly at the cheap price of $50 per
ton. We were thus enabled to resume business.

Last June when coal was sold at reduced price for
the 8th time, the commission charged by the Coal
Dealers' Association was raised by $5 per ton and
consequently the expenditure of each of us increased
by ten dollars per mensem. This extra burden was
already too heavy for us, but fortunately the
page_data.zh:

上海热水经销商协会致华籍副秘书的请愿书译文。
日期 1940 年 11 月 11 日。

煤炭价格。

本协会五百余名会员曾来到本会办公室询问，为何正如煤商公会最近宣布的那样，原本打算廉价出售给我们的煤末价格突然每吨上涨了二十美元。他们陈述如下：-

“前一段时间，开滦矿务局停止向我们按登记配额出售煤炭。结果，煤商趁机牟取暴利；煤价迅速上涨，我们中许多无法维持经营的人被迫关闭店铺。随后，一份阐述了四点严重关乎社区利益内容的请愿书递交给本协会会员大会，要求与矿务局谈判，获准直接购买煤炭。矿务局同意通过义泰兴、源泰和福总煤炭公司，每月以每吨 50 美元的廉价价格向我们出售两吨煤炭。我们因此得以恢复营业。

去年六月，第八次降价售煤时，煤商公会收取的佣金每吨增加了 5 美元，因此我们每人的每月支出增加了十美元。这一额外负担对我们来说已经过于沉重，但幸运的是

page_data.en:
- 2 -

was summer, and business was good so that we were
able to carry on. Business in autumn and winter is
slack while the reduced price of coal was raised by
$50.00 per ton. As our capital is small and our
profit insignificant, we shall sooner or later be
obliged to suspend business one after the other; we
beg the General Meeting of your Association to
request the Kailan Mining Administration to refrain
from increasing the price, and to revert to the
previous direct purchasing and registration methods
so that profiteering may be suppressed. Please
solicit on our behalf the assistance of the Settlement
Authorities and prominent persons."

Accordingly we made enquiries at the Coal Dealers'
Association which replied that the increase was necessary to
conform with the written notice of the Kailan Mining Administration.
We then verbally asked the Mining Administration about the matter;
it stated that the price was raised because of increase in freight
charges. Later, we wrote to the Administration on the subject,
but so far no definite reply has been received. At the beginning
of last month the Administration sold 2nd grade coal dust to its
customers at $97.00 per ton; this dropped to $83.00 per ton at
the beginning of this month. The coal dust sold to us is of the
3rd grade; its quality and calorie value is far inferior, never-
theless its price has now been raised from $50.00 to $75.00. The
market price of coal is dropping while the "reduced price" coal is
increasing by leaps and bounds. Such exorbitant increase can
never be justified by any increase in freight. It is incomprehen-
sible why hot water shops should alone be required to bear
increased freight, and not be permitted to make direct purchases,
thus enabling coal merchants to reap undue profit.

The Council has always protected the local citizens and
given sympathetic consideration to our business and to the
livelihood of the poor. That we were able to purchase cheap coal
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

当时正值夏季，生意良好，所以我们能够维持下去。秋冬季节生意清淡，而‘降价’煤炭的价格却每吨上涨了 50.00 美元。由于我们资本微薄，利润微薄，我们迟早将被迫相继停业；我们恳请贵会大会请求开滦矿务局 refrain from increasing the price（不要提高价格），并恢复以前的直接购买和登记方法，以便抑制投机倒把。请代表我们向租界当局和社会名流寻求帮助。”

为此，我们向煤商公会进行了查询，对方回复称，涨价是为了符合开滦矿务局的书面通知。随后我们就此事口头询问了矿务局；该局表示，涨价是因为运费增加。后来，我们就此致函矿务局，但至今未收到明确答复。上个月初，该局向其客户出售二级煤末，价格为每吨 97.00 美元；本月月初降至每吨 83.00 美元。出售给我们的煤末为三级；其质量和卡路里值远逊于前者，尽管如此，其价格现在已从 50.00 美元涨至 75.00 美元。市场煤价正在下跌，而‘降价’煤的价格却在飞涨。如此过分的涨幅绝不能由任何运费增加来证明其合理性。令人费解的是，为何唯独要求热水店承担增加的运费，而不允许直接购买，从而使煤商获取不当利润。

工部局一直保护本地市民，并对我们的生意以及穷人的生计给予同情的考虑。我们之所以能够购买到廉价煤炭

page_data.en:
- 3 -
and carry on our business this spring was all due to the Council's
generous efforts. For this favour we are very grateful. The
Council's action has also proved to be a great boon to the poorer
classes.
Owing to the recent rise in the price of coal we are really
finding it very difficult to continue our business; presumably
the Council is quite aware of this fact. Though the Kailan
Mining Administration can easily sell to us direct, and at the
same time maintain its prices at their present figure, it will
not grant our request. This is unaccountable. Will the Council
please instruct the Mining Administration not to increase the
price of coal dust and revert to the former registration
arrangement as soon as possible so that we may make direct
purchases and the business not be monopolized by coal dealers.
We as well as many other local residents will be very grateful
if this request could be granted.
(Signed and chopped) Tsang Teh-lung (龍德張).
Chairman.

(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 11th November, 1940).
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
今春得以继续营业，全赖公董局之慷慨努力。对此厚意，我们深表感激。公董局之举亦被证明是对贫苦阶层的一大恩惠。
鉴于近期煤价上涨，我们确实发现难以维持营业；想必公董局对此事实甚为清楚。虽然开滦矿务总局（Kailan Mining Administration）可以轻易直接向我们出售，同时保持其价格维持在当前水平，但它拒绝我们的请求。此点令人费解。恳请公董局指示矿务总局不要提高煤屑价格，并尽快恢复以前的登记安排，以便我们可以直接购买，且生意不被煤商垄断。若此请求获准，我们及许多当地居民将不胜感激。
（签名并盖章）张德龙（Tsang Teh-lung）。
主席。

（注：1940年11月11日下午晚些时候收到以作翻译）。

With reference to the attached translation of

Szechuen Road.

The retail price for coal has so far not been
fixed, but is expected to be about Yen 94 per ton.

MAINICHI

COAL RETAIL SELLERS' ASSOCIATION FORMED IN HONGKEW

It is reported that a Coal Retail
Sellers' Association has been formed in Hongkew to check
profiteering.
Eighty-one coal dealers (65 Chinese
and 16 Japanese) have joined the Association. There are 21
more coal dealers, who have not yet joined the Association,
but it has been decided to include them in the Association.
All member shops must use membership signboards and exhibit
price lists. These shops will deal in coal at a uniform
price which is 33% to 50% cheaper than the price on the south
side of the Creek.
The office of the Association is
located at No.245 corner of West Sz Ching Road (西士慶路)
and North Szechuen Road.

S.B. D.7555/1

April 2, 1940.

Letter from Kailen Mining Administration to Shanghai
Municipal Council re cheap sale of cola to local Hot
Water Shops
------------------------------------

With reference to the attached communication dated March
26 from Mr. T.F. Wei, Agent for the Kailan Mining Administration,
addressed to the Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Council
regarding possible irregularities in the distribution of the
recent shipment of 3,300 tons of Kailan No. 3 Slack among local
hot water shops through the Coal Merchants Association, I
have to report that discreet enquiries elicit the following:-

During the month of March, 1940, the Kailan Mining
Administration supplied only 2,900 tons of the aforementioned
grade of coal (instead of 3,300 as stated in the letter) to
its three distributing agents, viz. Messrs. Nyi Tai Shing, Hwa
Tung and Yuen Tai Coal Dealers, who, in turn, entrusted the
Coal Merchants Association, 405 Tientsin Road, with the task
of the distribution of this coal among the local hot water
shops.

The price of this grade of Kailan Slack, as arranged
between the Kailan Mining Administration and its distributing
agents, is $50 per ton ex-ship and allows the sum of $10
for miscellaneous overhead expenses which are incurred in
transportation. There are other expenses and losses however
in this distribution to be met by the distributing agents:-

a) The three distributors must make an advance
payment on their share of the supply from
the Kailan Mining Administration.
