1940年4月2日。

开滦矿务总局致上海公共租界工部局关于向本地热水店廉价出售煤炭的信函
------------------------------------

关于附件中开滦矿务总局代理人魏特夫（T.F. Wei，音译）先生于3月26日致上海公共租界工部局秘书长的信函，该信函涉及最近一批3,300吨开滦三号煤屑通过煤业公会向本地热水店分配过程中可能存在的不规范行为，本人经审慎查询后获悉以下情况：-

在1940年3月期间，开滦矿务总局仅向其三家分销代理商，即义泰盛、华通和源泰煤号，供应了上述等级的煤炭2,900吨（而非信中所述的3,300吨），这些代理商随后委托天津路405号的煤业公会负责将这些煤炭分配给本地热水店。

根据开滦矿务总局与其分销代理商之间的安排，该等级开滦煤屑的价格为离岸价每吨50美元，并允许预留10美元用于支付运输过程中产生的杂项间接费用。然而，在此分配过程中还有其它费用和损失需由分销代理商承担：-

a) 三家分销商必须就其从开滦矿务总局获得的供应份额预付货款。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

b) The transportation charges per ton
ex-ship which includes the ultimate
delivery to the different consumers,
minus storing charges, amount to more
than $11 per ton instead of $10 as
stipulated by the Kailan Mining
Administration.

c) The shortage in weight through shipment
from Chinwangtao and the subsequent
delivery to consumers is approximately
2% which is almost equivalent to $4 or $5
per ton.

The Coal Merchants Association during the
period from March 23 to 30 distributed one ton
of this coal to each local hot water shop and this
distribution amounted to 500 tons. The remaining
2,400 tons will be delivered on two different
occasions in April, viz. "Between April 8 and 13"
and "Between April 22 and 27" and in this way each
hot water shop will get two tons during the month
of April.

This cheap sale movement has caused a great
amount of dissatisfaction in the Coal Merchants
Association over the monopolizing attitude of the
Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade Guild, 202,
Kiukiang Road, claiming that they were solely
responsible for the distribution of this cheap
coal and has exhorted its members to pay the
following charges :-

a) "Special Subscription" (ranging from $2
to $30) (a cloak for remuneration fee
to the staff of the Guild).
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

b) 每吨离岸价的运输费用，包括最终交付给不同消费者的费用，减去仓储费，金额超过11美元，而非开滦矿务总局规定的10美元。

c) 从秦皇岛装运及随后交付给消费者过程中的重量短缺约为2%，几乎相当于每吨4或5美元。

煤业公会在3月23日至30日期间，向每家本地热水店分配了一吨此类煤炭，此次分配总量为500吨。剩余的2,400吨将在4月份分两次交付，即“4月8日至13日之间”和“4月22日至27日之间”，以此方式，每家热水店在4月份将获得两吨煤炭。

这次廉价销售运动引起了煤业公会对上海市热水业同业公会（地址：九江路202号）垄断态度的极大不满，该公会声称其对这批廉价煤炭的分配负有唯一责任，并敦促其会员支付以下费用：-

a) “特别捐”（范围从2美元到30美元不等）（作为支付给公会职员的酬金的外衣）。

page_data.en:

b) "Benevolent Subscription" ($10 per member;
voluntary payment)
c) "Legal Adviser's Fee" ($5 per member)
d) "Membership Badge Fee" ($1 per member)
e) "Membership Fee" ($1 per month for each member)

Water Trade Guild, the total membership including
those shops in C.C.L. Western District, French
Concession and International Settlement (North of
Soochow Creek) is 597, exclusive of those situated
in Nantao and Chapei, and on March 31st had raised
$1,450 from 145 members from those charges. $900
of this amount was on March 28 handed over to the
following bodies:-

Federation of Shanghai Charity Bodies:
$300 against Receipts 7333-7361

$300 against Receipts 2155-2183
A further sum of $1,337 was also raised from
223 shop members towards the upkeep of the Guild
at inaugural meeting of members of the Shanghai
Municipality Hot Water Trade Guild held on March 5
on the premises of the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's
Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road.

28 MAR 1940
POLICE FORCE
FOR COMMENT

The Kailan Mining Administration,
30 Foochow Road,
Shanghai, 26th March 1940.

The Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir,

I would inform you that, following an appeal from the
Shanghai Hot Water Shows Guild, I arranged to bring to Shanghai
one shipment of 3,300 tons of Kailan No. 3 Slack. This is a
poor grade of coal and one not commonly sold by us; however
it is quite useable and is, in fact, burnt by us in our own
boilers at the Mines.

I have arranged to distribute this coal through three
Chinese dealers with whom we have done business for many years,
and I enclose herewith a copy of my letter to them setting out
the procedure to be followed. I have kept our price to them
as low as possible, and in my opinion the figure of $10 which
they have allowed for their own out-of-pocket expenses is a
perfectly reasonable one.

You will see that I have included a stipulation that
should you desire to oversee this distribution, they are to
give you every facility to do so.

I should be grateful if you would let me know privately
should you find any irregularities, as I have a further 2,000/
3,000 tons of this grade which can be brought to Shanghai once
this first shipment has been finished, which at present I pro-
pose to distribute through the same channels. However, I
have not published this fact and should you consider that any
modification or change in my arrangements desirable, they can
easily be made as and when necessary.

I am writing a similar letter to the French Municipal
Council, and I have also informed the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of the
above arrangements.

Yours faithfully,

T.F. Wei
AGENT.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 28 MAR 1940）

尊敬的先生：

谨告知阁下，应上海热水业同业公会的请求，我安排向上海运送一批3,300吨的开滦三号粉煤。这是一种劣质煤炭，并非我们通常销售的品种；但它完全可用，事实上，我们在矿区的锅炉中燃烧的就是这种煤。

我已安排通过三家与我们有多年来业务往来的中国经销商来分发这批煤炭，随函附上我致他们的信件副本，其中列明了需遵循的程序。我给他们的价格尽可能低，在我看来，他们预留的10元作为自身垫付费用是完全合理的。

您可以看到，我已列入一项条款，即如果贵方希望监督此次分发过程，他们应提供一切便利予以配合。

若阁下发现任何不规范之处，恳请私下告知，因为我还有2,000至3,000吨同等级别的煤炭，待首批货物售罄后可运抵上海，目前我计划通过相同渠道进行分发。然而，我尚未公布这一事实，若阁下认为对我的安排有任何修改或变更的必要，可随时按需进行调整。

我正致函法国公董局类似内容的信件，并已将上述安排通知华人纳税会和华商总会。

此致
敬礼，

T.F. Wei
代理人

THE KAILAN MINING ADMINISTRATION
Shanghai, 18th March 1940.

Messrs. Nee Tai Shing,
Hwa Chung,
Yuen Tai,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sirs,

I would like to take this opportunity to confirm the
following arrangements that have been made between us.

The s.s. "Isabel Moller" is due to arrive in Shanghai
on or about March 18th with a full cargo, say 3,300 tons,
of No. 3 Slack.

You have been good enough to take upon yourselves the
trouble of distributing this coal to certain sections of
the community which are at present having very great diffi-
culty in maintaining their existence owing to the shortage of
coal supplies. In order that the benefit of this work may be
felt as widely as possible, the following arrangements were
made between us:

1. The price of this coal to yourself will be $40.00 per
metric ton ex-ship. The delivered price to the consumer
will be $50.00 per metric ton, the difference of $10.00
it is assumed will cover you for handling, storing and
delivery charges together with a small allowance for
supervisory work and profit.

2. For the time being this coal will only be supplied to
hot water shops and small tea houses, but should it
later be found advisable to extend the scope of your
distribution, other sections of the community will be
supplied.

3. No individual consumer will receive more than one ton in
March and two tons in each succeeding month, and the coal
will in all cases be delivered.

4. It will be announced as widely as is necessary that the
coal is Kailan No. 3 Slack and of an inferior quality to
No. 2 Slack to which this market has been previously
accustomed.

5. The coal will be held in each of the three dealers'
yards in order to facilitate distribution.

6. Detailed statements giving consumers' names addresses
and tonnage involved will be given to the Administra-
tion each fortnight for deliveries made up to that
time.

7. You should consult with the Coal Merchants' Association
as to distribution.

8. That both for your own and our protection, facilities
should be given to representatives of the Shanghai
Municipal Council and the French Municipal Council
to obtain any information they may require about the
various selling arrangements.

致：
尼泰盛（Nee Tai Shing）先生，
华中（Hwa Chung）先生，
元泰（Yuen Tai）先生，
上海。

敬启者：

谨借此机会确认我们之间已达成的下列安排。

“伊莎贝尔·莫勒”号（s.s. "Isabel Moller"）轮船预计于3月18日左右抵达上海，满载3,300吨三号末煤（No. 3 Slack）。

承蒙诸位不辞辛劳，负责将这批煤炭分配给目前因煤炭供应短缺而难以维持生计的某些社会群体。为了使这项工作的惠益尽可能广泛地惠及大众，我们之间达成了以下安排：

1. 该批煤炭对诸位的船边交货价为每公吨40.00美元。向消费者交付的价格为每公吨50.00美元，其中10.00美元的差额假定足以覆盖诸位的搬运、储存和交付费用，并包含少量的监管工作津贴及利润。

2. 暂时该批煤炭仅供应给热水店和小茶馆，但若日后认为有必要扩大分配范围，则将向其他社会群体供应。

3. 任何单个消费者在3月份获得的煤炭不得超过一吨，此后每个月不得超过两吨，且在所有情况下均实行送货上门。

4. 将在必要范围内广泛公告，该煤炭为开滦三号末煤，其质量低于本市场此前惯用的二号末煤。

5. 为方便分配，该批煤炭将存放于三家经销商的堆场中。

6. 每两周应向总局提交一份详细清单，列明截至当时的交付情况，包括消费者姓名、地址及涉及吨数。

7. 诸位应就分配事宜与煤炭同业公会协商。

8. 为了诸位及我方的利益，应为上海公共租界工部局和法公董局的代表提供便利，使其能够获取有关各种销售安排所需的任何信息。

page_data.en:
2.

9.  That it should be made clear to everyone concerned
    that there is only a limited quantity of this coal
    available and that we are taking these steps as a
    purely temporary measure to relieve the present
    situation.

    I should like again to express my thanks to you
for the assistance which you have so willingly given in
facilitating the distribution of supplies of coal to those
sections of the community who are most unable to pay the
present high prices and with whom we are unfortunately
unable to keep in touch.

                        Yours faithfully,

                    (Sgd.)  T.F. Wei

                                AGENT.

2.

9. 应向所有相关方明确说明，该批煤炭数量有限，我们采取这些步骤纯粹是为了缓解当前局势的临时措施。

    我谨再次感谢诸位慷慨协助，促进向那些最无力支付当前高昂煤价、且不幸地我们无法直接保持联系的社会群体分配煤炭供应。

                        此致

日期：1940年3月30日。

廉价煤炭供应不足且不规律。
我们收到来自邱维道（Ch'in Vi-tao (道維邱)）及本公会其他587名会员的联合请愿书如下：
“自当前战事爆发后，我们接公用事业管理局通知，需向其注册并直接从该局购买煤炭。据此，数百家热水店店主进行了注册；并发放了编号注册证作为凭证。这种消除中间商牟利的直接交易安排是一项极好的措施。然而，注册后，出售给我们的煤炭数量逐渐减少，直到最近，管理局完全拒绝向我们供应任何部分已注册的所需煤炭。
煤炭经销商见矿业公司停止向我们供货，便趁机牟取暴利。他们将煤炭价格从以前由管理局规定的每吨40.00美元多一点，提高到前所未有的200.00美元以上的高位。
为弥补成本上涨，我们略微提高了开水价格；这一涨价已引起公众不满，因为开水是所有居民的日常必需品。此外，煤球现在的售价相对

page_data.en:
- 2 -

reasonable price. Should the price of boiled water
be further increased, we would be charged with
excessively exploiting the public. Because of this,
several boiled water shops, which have found it
impossible to carry on business, are closing down
daily. Should this state of affairs be allowed to
continue, all members of this association will soon
be compelled to suspend business. In that case, the
following four grave social problems will arise:
1. Owing to the closure of boiled water shops or the
rise in the price of boiled water, people will
have to boil water themselves. As the population in
this isolated city is extremely dense and every
dwelling house is crowded to capacity, the burning
of briquettes in stoves day and night will easily
cause a fire.
2. The incessant burning of briquettes not only will
easily cause a fire, but will also result in increased
number of deaths from asphyxiation due to the effect
of coal fumes.
3. People of the working class who cannot afford to
boil water themselves will be compelled to drink raw
water. This will affect their health because many
diseases are caused through the drinking of unboiled
water.
4. About ten thousand people in Shanghai make their
living through the boiled water business. If the shops
are closed their livelihood will be seriously endangered.
These four matters will sooner or later become serious
social problems. The unfavourable situation is entirely
caused by the mining administration's refusal to sell
coal to us. Our trade requires more than 3000 tons of
coal per mensem; this is quite a large quantity. Moreover,
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

合理。如果开水价格进一步上涨，我们将被指控过度剥削公众。因此，几家发现无法继续经营的热水店每天都在关门。如果允许这种状况持续下去，本公会所有成员很快将被迫停业。那样的话，将产生以下四个严重的社会问题：
1. 由于热水店关闭或开水价格上涨，人们将不得不自行烧水。由于这座孤立城市的人口极其稠密，每栋住宅都拥挤不堪，日夜在炉灶中燃烧煤球极易引发火灾。
2. 不间断地燃烧煤球不仅极易引发火灾，还会因煤气影响导致窒息死亡人数增加。
3. 负担不起自行烧水的工人阶级将被迫饮用生水。这将影响他们的健康，因为许多疾病是由饮用未煮沸的水引起的。
4. 上海约有万人依靠热水生意谋生。如果店铺关闭，他们的生计将受到严重威胁。
这四件事迟早会成为严重的社会问题。不利局面完全是由矿业管理局拒绝向我们出售煤炭造成的。我们的行业每月需要3000多吨煤炭；这是一个相当大的数量。而且，

page_data.en:
we have already registered with the Administration.
In spite of this fact it has refused to supply
us and has placed its entire output in the hands of
coal merchants to enable them to monopolize the
market. We cannot understand what is the object of
that mining concern. Last month we asked your
Association to apply to it for the supply of coal.
As a result three coal companies, the Hsin T'ai I
(興泰義), Hua Chung (華中) and Yuan Ta (泰元),
were appointed to sell coal to us at reduced prices.
Later the companies instructed the Coal Dealers'
Association to sell only one ton of coal to each of
our shops at $98.00 per ton. As the result of a further
appeal made by your Association the Administration
agreed to supply to us another ton each; but as the
quantity was only sufficient for the use of a few days,
it was not of much help. Although the price was lower
than the market price, our losses were still considerable
as we had to sell boiled water at the usual rate. At
present the price of coal has further risen. Should
cheap coal not be regularly available to us, and the
Mining Administration continue to refuse to sell coal
to us direct, we shall be unable to carry on and shall
be compelled to suspend business. Moreover, the above
mentioned four problems will arise. For this reason
we are very anxious about the matter. Will your
Association please request the Authorities concerned to
devise some effective measures to force down the price
and to strictly order dealers to regularly sell to us
at the prices fixed by the Mining Administration. At
the same time the Administration must also be instructed
page_data.zh:
我们已经向管理局注册。
尽管有此事实，它仍拒绝向我们供货，并将其全部产量交由煤炭商人手中，使他们能够垄断市场。我们无法理解该矿业公司的目的何在。上个月，我们请求贵公会向其申请煤炭供应。结果是，兴泰义（Hsin T'ai I (興泰義)）、华中（Hua Chung (華中)）和元泰（Yuan Ta (泰元)）三家煤炭公司被指定以降价向我们出售煤炭。后来，这些公司指示煤炭同业公会以每吨98.00美元的价格向我们每家店铺仅出售一吨煤炭。经贵公会进一步呼吁，管理局同意再向我们每家供应一吨；但由于数量仅够使用几天，帮助不大。虽然价格低于市场价，但由于我们必须按 usual rate（常规价格）出售开水，我们的损失仍然相当大。目前煤炭价格进一步上涨。如果我们无法定期获得廉价煤炭，且矿业管理局继续拒绝直接向我们出售煤炭，我们将无法继续经营，并将被迫停业。此外，上述四个问题将会出现。鉴于此，我们对此事非常焦虑。恳请贵公会请求有关当局制定有效措施以压低价格，并严格命令经销商按照矿业管理局规定的价格定期向我们出售。同时，还必须指示管理局

page_data.en:
- 4 -

to supply clean coal directly to us as in accordance
with the registration arrangement. This measure will
benefit us as well as the public. Decision is anxiously
awaited."

The representations made by our members are in accord with
facts. Boiled water shops are labouring under extreme difficulties.
Although the three companies, Kyi T'a Hsing, Yunnan and Yuan
T'a, have recently for the second time sold one ton of coal dust
to each shop at the original price of $6.00, thereby slightly
easing the situation, the supply is of inferior quality and
sometimes little use. Moreover, there has been no present
stocks are exhausted. The Council has always attached serious
importance to the livelihood of residents, and is endeavouring to
keep down the prices of foodstuffs, and fuels. The original
petition is enclosed herewith. On behalf of all the boiled
water shops in the whole city, we respectfully request
the Council to strictly enjoin all coal dealers to supply the
second grade Tai Sing coal dust, which is an essential fuel, to
boiled water shops according to the original allocation.
At the same time the Civil Affairs Administration should be
advised to supply coal direct to these shops at a moderate price
under the same registration arrangements as before. Thus coal
merchants will be prevented from profiteering, and the price will
naturally return to the normal level. Please comply with our
request so that our difficulties may be relieved and no serious
social problem may arise.

(Chopped) Shanghai Boiled Water Shops Association.
(Signed & chopped) Tsang Teh-lung (龍 德 張)
Chairman.

Encl.: A Petition (same as quoted in the petition translated above).

(Note: Received for translation late a.m. 1st April, 1940).

本会会员所陈述的情况符合事实。热水店正面临极大困难。虽然近期奇泰兴（Kyi T'a Hsing）、云南（Yunnan）和元泰（Yuan T'a）三家公司第二次以原价6.00美元向每家店铺出售了一吨煤屑，从而稍微缓解了局势，但供应质量低劣，有时几乎无用。此外，目前库存已耗尽。工部局一贯重视居民的生计，并致力于压低食品和燃料价格。原请愿书随函附上。谨代表全市所有热水店，恳请工部局严格责令所有煤炭经销商按照原始配额，向热水店供应作为必需燃料的二等泰盛（Tai Sing）煤屑。同时，应建议民政管理局按照之前的相同注册安排，以适中价格直接向这些店铺供应煤炭。从而防止煤炭商人牟取暴利，价格自然回归正常水平。请满足我们的请求，以便缓解我们的困难，避免发生严重的社会问题。

The practice by a section of unscrupulous
traders of taking advantage of exceptional
circumstances to hold up the public as is to be
common knowledge although concrete evidence which
would justify the authorities taking action is not
easily available. The procedure, for instance,
is thus: "A" buys say 5,000 tons of coal from a
certain foreign concern. Before taking actual
delivery of the cargo, he, owing to financial
reasons, gradually sells portions of his order
(say, 500 tons, 1,000 tons etc.) at prices favourable
to him, leaving 1,000 tons to meet his own needs.
The shares thus sold are, however, covered by bills
of lading which are invariably purchased by
speculators who habitually buy up large stocks of
various merchandise, store same in godowns and
release supplies when the prices have been forced up.

The present stocks of coal in Shanghai do
not differ to a considerable extent from the
figures mentioned in the Monthly Return for January,

Coal prices.

The prices of commodities in Shanghai have been greatly increased especially that of coal. Before the local hostilities coal was sold at some ten dollars odd per ton, but now the price has reached the height of between $160.00 -170.00. Coal is necessary in daily life and it supplies the motive power in all industrial enterprises. Consequent upon the rise in the price of coal the Shanghai Waterworks Company, the Shanghai Power Company, various hotels, restaurants, bath houses, hot water shops, etc. all increased their charges. The livelihood of the people has been seriously affected. Many factories have been forced to reduce the number of their employees owing to the high price of coal. Some factories have raised the prices of their products to balance the rise in the cost of production; hence the abnormal conditions in Shanghai.

In view of the above we consider it of first importance to force down the price of coal as in the case of rice. We beg the Council to set a limit to the price of coal, to instruct the various coal shops to strictly observe the fixed price, to ascertain the present stocks in Shanghai, to prosecute profiteers and to facilitate the importation of coal. As this matter has a very serious bearing on the livelihood of the people, and the peace and safety of the city, we earnestly beg the Council to take prompt action.

(Chopped) Secretariat, Shanghai First Special District
Citizens' Federation
(Note: Received for translation a.m. 12th February 1940)
（印：FEB 12 1940）

日期 1940年2月7日。

煤炭价格。

上海的商品价格大幅上涨，尤其是煤炭。在当地战事发生前，煤炭售价约为每吨十余元，但现在价格已高达$160.00 - $170.00。煤炭是日常生活所需，也是所有工业企业的动力来源。由于煤炭价格上涨，上海自来水公司、上海电力公司、各家酒店、餐馆、浴室、热水店等均提高了收费。民众生计受到严重影响。许多工厂因煤炭价格高昂而被迫减少雇员数量。一些工厂提高了产品价格以平衡生产成本的上升；因此造成了上海的异常状况。

鉴于上述情况，我们认为压低煤炭价格如同大米价格一样至关重要。我们恳请工部局限定煤炭价格，指令各煤号严格遵守规定价格，查明上海目前的库存，起诉牟取暴利者，并促进煤炭进口。由于此事关系到民众生计以及城市的和平与安全，我们恳请工部局迅速采取行动。

（盖章）上海第一特区市民联合会秘书处

EVENING POST & MERCURY.

FEB 1 6 1940

Rice, Briquette
Prices Soaring

Bean Curd Rates Hiked
Again; Hot Water
Shops Aided

Prices of essential commodities registered another rise this morning as a result of the resumption of manipulations by speculators and the decline in the value of the Chinese dollar during the last few days.

The price of Saigon rice broke through the $50 mark yesterday, registering an advance of more than $2 in two days. While this is generally attributed to the decline of the value of Chinese dollars in terms of U.S. currency, activities by hoarders are also partly blamed for the sharp hike. The price of domestic rice advanced accordingly and the unofficial prices quoted outside the rice exchange were $56 for the first grade, and $51 for the lower grade.

Affecting the general public as seriously as the higher price of rice is the soaring price of coal on the local market. The quotations for coal briquettes, chief fuel in all Chinese households since the rise of firewood prices to exorbitant levels, hiked three times from $5.20 per unit of two baskets up to $6.80. Even at this price, which represents a 300 percent rise from pre-war rates, little cargo was available on the market.

Operation of many hot water shops is still suspended owing to the high price of coal. A complete suspension, however, was averted when, through the good offices of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, an arrangement was reached with the Coal Merchants' Guild to sell 600 tons of coal to the hot water shops at the greatly reduced rate of $98 per ton, although the market price is $170 per ton.

The price of bean curd, an essential food for the poorer people, has also soared, as the price of soy beans shot up after the Spring holidays. A single piece of dried bean curd is now priced at 10 cents as compared to two coppers before the war.

《晚邮报》与《水星报》。

1940年2月16日

米价、煤球价格
飞涨

豆腐价格再次
上调；热水店
获得援助

由于投机商恢复操纵以及近几日中国货币贬值，今晨基本商品的价格再次上涨。

昨日，西贡米的价格突破了50美元大关，两天内上涨了2美元以上。虽然这通常归因于中国货币兑美元汇率的下跌，但囤积者的活动也被部分指责为导致价格急剧上涨的原因。国产米的价格也随之上涨，米交所外报价的非官方价格为：一级米56美元，次级米51美元。

对公众影响与米价上涨同样严重的是本地市场煤价的飙升。自柴火价格涨至离谱水平以来，煤球成为所有中国家庭的主要燃料，其报价从每两筐5.20美元三次上调至6.80美元。即使在这个价格下——比战前价格高出300%——市场上可供交易的货物也寥寥无几。

由于煤价高昂，许多热水店的运营仍处于暂停状态。然而，在中国总商会的斡旋下，通过与煤炭同业公会达成协议，以每吨98美元的极大优惠价格向热水店出售600吨煤炭（尽管市场价格为每吨170美元），从而避免了全面停业。

作为穷人基本食品的豆腐价格也大幅上涨，因为春节后大豆价格飙升。现在一块干豆腐的价格是10分，而战前仅为2个铜板。

URGENT K 1/9
J. D. CHEN & COMPANY
Room 231, Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange Building
260 Avenue Edward VII
Shanghai, February 14th 1940

G.Godfrey Phillips, Esq.,
Secretary General,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Re: Small shops supplying hot water to the poors
in this Settlement.

With regards to the above, I have received many reports
stating that, up to this moment, they are still not in a position
to reopen for business due to the abnormally high of coal price.
Under such circumstance, the great number of the poors in this
Settlement, who are usually using hot water by purchasing from
small hot water shops, are meeting a great difficulty; and
consequently it would effect their health condition badly.

Of course, this might be a minor important problem among
the problems of importance. But for the sake of public health as
well as charity, I believe our Council must be able to do some-
thing against the coal dealers who are quoting the irrational
price towards those small poor hot water shops.

I am responsible to give you the following facts for your
reference, 1- that the original selling price of Kaiping dust No.2
(the particular kind of coal desirable to the hot water shops)
was fixed by Tailan Sales office for Messrs. Yuan-Tai, Ye Tai
Shing, and Hwa Jung. the three authorized distributors of the said
coal, at $47.50, local dollars, per ton and
2- that not long ago the Guild of the hot water shops has
approached the said three distributors, with a moral support of
Mr. Yu Ya-Ching, requesting them to take this business partially
on the basis of public welfare and to sell that dust coal at the
price not over $95.00 per ton, but that was unaffectionately
declined.

Judging from these facts, the three distributors seem to be
very unfair and thus they drive the small hot water shops into
compulsory wind-up. Thereafter a great number of poors have to
run out of this daily necessity of hot water. Now the only hope
for the poors to cure the pending situation is OUR COUNCIL'S
PROPER MEASURES.

Yours faithfully,

J.D. Chen

上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

先生：

事由：本租界内向穷人供应热水的小店铺。

关于上述事项，我收到许多报告称，截至目前，由于煤价异常高昂，这些店铺仍无法重新开业。在这种情况下，本租界内大量通常通过从小型热水店购买来获取热水的贫困居民正面临巨大困难；因此，这将严重损害他们的健康状况。

当然，在众多重要问题中，这可能是一个次要问题。但为了公共卫生以及慈善事业着想，我相信我们工部局必须能够针对那些向贫困小热水店报出不合理价格的煤炭商采取一些措施。

我有责任向您提供以下事实供参考：1- 开平二号粉煤（热水店所需的特定种类煤炭）的原售价由泰来销售处为元泰、叶泰兴和华荣这三家该煤炭的授权分销商定为每吨47.50元本地货币；
2- 不久前，热水业同业公会在虞洽卿先生的道义支持下，接洽了上述三家分销商，请求他们基于公益部分承担此项业务，以不超过每吨95.00元的价格出售该粉煤，但遭到了冷漠拒绝。

鉴于这些事实，这三家分销商似乎非常不公平，从而迫使小型热水店被迫停业。此后，大量穷人不得不失去热水这一日常必需品。现在，穷人解决当前困境的唯一希望在于**我们工部局的适当措施**。

此致，

J.D. Chen

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7555/1
Date 29 2 40
ort,
February 21, 1940.

Communication addressed to Shanghai Municipal Council - re growing prices of Coal & Coal Briquette.

Reference the attached letter dated February 7 from the Shanghai First Special District Citizens Federation on the present soaring prices of coal which has contributed to the abnormal conditions existing in Shanghai. e.g., industrial concerns have either curtailed their working staff or raised the prices of their products in order to balance the rise in the cost of their production, I beg to report that the statement is generally correct in principle. The rise in the price of this essential commodity is principally due to the following causes:-

a) The increase in cost through the fluctuation of foreign gold currency.

b) The increase in freight and transportation charges.

c) The hoarding, speculation and profiteering by unscrupulous merchants.

as will be shown in the subsequent paragraphs

Comparison in Coal prices since China New Year (February 8).

| Quality | Prices prior to February 8. | Present Prices |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Indian Bitumious Coal | $156 per ton | $230 per ton |
| F. lan Bitumious Coal | $130 " " | $250 " " |
| Hongay Anthracite Coal | $120/30 per ton | $160/80 per ton |

Cost of Indian Bitumious Coal per ton (February 16/7).

Total cost including increased freight, etc.; equivalent to $225 local currency per ton.

Cost of Hongay Anthracite Coal per ton (February 16/7).

Total cost including increased freight equivalent to $149.80 local currency per ton.

The practice by a section of unscrupulous traders of taking advantage of exceptional circumstances to hold up the public seems to be common knowledge although concrete evidence which would justify the Authorities taking action is not easily available. The procedure, for instance, is thus. "A" orders 5,000 tons of coal from a certain foreign concern. Before taking actual delivery of the cargo, he, owing to financial reasons, gradually sells portions of his order (say 500 tons, 1,000 tons etc.) at prices favourable to him, leaving 1,000 tons to meet his own needs. The shares thus sold are, however, covered by bills of lading which are invariably purchased by speculators who habitually buy up large stocks of various merchandise, store same in godowns and release supplies when the prices have been forced up.

The present stocks of coal in Shanghai do not differ to a considerable extent from the figures mentioned in the Monthly Return for January, 1940, i.e. Bitumious Coal approximately 88,700 tons; Anthracite Coal approximately 12,000 tons.

上海公共租界警务处
S. B. 登记室
编号 S. B. D. 7555/1
日期 1940年2月29日

报告，
1940年2月21日。

致上海公共租界工部局的函件 - 关于煤炭及煤球价格上涨事宜。

参照附件中上海第一特区市民联合会于2月7日来信，提及目前煤炭价格飙升，导致上海出现异常情况，例如工业企业要么削减员工，要么提高产品价格以平衡生产成本的上升。谨此报告，该陈述在原则上大体正确。这种基本商品价格的上涨主要归因于以下原因：-

a) 受外国金本位货币波动导致的成本增加。

b) 运费和运输费用的增加。

c) 不法商人的囤积、投机和牟取暴利。

如下文所述

春节（2月8日）以来煤炭价格对比。

| 质量 | 2月8日前价格 | 目前价格 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 印度烟煤 | 每吨156美元 | 每吨230美元 |
| F. lan 烟煤 | 每吨130美元 | 每吨250美元 |
| 洪崖无烟煤 | 每吨120.30美元 | 每吨160.80美元 |

印度烟煤每吨成本（2月16/7日）。

总成本包括增加的运费等；相当于每吨225元本地货币。

洪崖无烟煤每吨成本（2月16/7日）。

总成本包括增加的运费，相当于每吨149.80元本地货币。

一部分不法商人利用特殊情况挟持公众的做法似乎是众所周知的，尽管当局难以获得足以采取行动的 concrete evidence（具体证据）。例如，其操作手法如下。“A”向某外商订购5,000吨煤炭。在实际提货之前，由于资金原因，他逐渐以对自己有利的价格出售部分订单（如500吨、1,000吨等），留下1,000吨以满足自身需求。然而，这些售出的份额由提单覆盖，而这些提单 invariably（总是）被习惯性大量收购各种商品并储存在仓库中、待价格被推高后才释放供应的投机商购买。

上海目前的煤炭库存与1940年1月月报中提到的数字没有显著差异，即：烟煤约88,700吨；无烟煤约12,000吨。

page_data.en:
2.

As regards the attached communication dated February 14
from Messrs. J.D. Chen & Company commenting on the unfair status
of the three authorized distributors of the Kailan Mining
Administration which has driven local hot water shops to
compulsorily suspend business, I have to state that the writer
has failed to obtain a thorough conception of the situation and
a survey of the actual circumstances reveals the following.-

There are some 10 large and 15 small Machine-made
Coal Briquette Factories in the International Settlement and
French Concession, producing a daily average of 1,200 tons of
briquettes. At ordinary times, the daily average sale in
the two Settlements amounted to 800 tons, whereas the present
daily discharge is approximately 1,600 tons. The increase in
the daily sales is apparently due to hoarding by wealthy
traders and residents. The price of briquettes per picul
prior to the Spring Festival (February 8) was $5, whereas the
present rate ranges between $7 and $7.20 per picul.

The Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade Guild,
Room 301, 202 Kiukiang Road which was inaugurated on August 26,
1939, has 550 shop-members comprising those in International
Settlement and French Concession. On January 23, 1940 the
Guild detailed four representatives to call on Messrs. Yu Ya
Ching and Yuan Li Tung requesting them to render assistance
in their appeal to the Kailan Mining Administration, 30 Foochow
Road, to supply Kaiping dust No. 2 (particular kind of coal
used by hot-water shops) direct to Hot-water Shops instead of
through their authorized distributors. On January 25, a reply
was received from the Kailan Mining Administration to the effect
that the appeal of the Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade
Guild has to be referred to the three authorized distributors
of the Administration, as the Administration itself was
experiencing a shortage of supplies to cope with the demands
of its regular customers.

On January 27 the Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade
Guild again detailed the same four delegates to make an appeal
to the Coal Shop Owners Association, 405 Tientsin Road demanding
supplies of coal for its member-shops. A reply was sent on
January 28 requesting the Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade
Guild to supply an up-to-date membership list together with
their respective addresses. A list of 450 hot water shop-
members, duly sealed, was accordingly forwarded to the Coal
Shop Owners Association on February 5.

According to a recent survey completed on February 17,
by the Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Trade Guild, the number
of its shop-members having suspended business operations is
300. On February 14 the Coal Shop Owners Association decided
to distribute application-forms to all hot water owners
whereby each of them is authorized to purchase from the
Kailan distributors one ton of Coal Dust No.2 at the rate of
$98 and that such privilege could be exercised once only.
The actual distribution of the commodity will take place
following an announcement to be inserted by the Coal Shop
Owners Association in the local Chinese press.

It is learnt from an authentic source that the monthly
supplies of the Kailan Mining Administration to its authorized
distributors amount to approximately 4,000 tons, including
slabs and dust, at an average rate of over $60 per ton. The
management of the Administration upon being confidentially
approached, are reluctant to disclose particulars regarding
their agreements with the authorized distributors.
page_data.zh:
2.

关于附件中 J.D. Chen & Company（陈记公司）于2月14日来信，评论开滦矿务局三家授权分销商的不公平状况导致本地热水店被迫停业一事，我必须指出，写信人未能全面了解情况，对实际情况的调查揭示了以下内容。-

公共租界和法租界内约有10家大型和15家小型机制煤球厂，日均生产煤球1,200吨。平时，两租界的日均销量为800吨，而目前的日出货量约为1,600吨。日销量的增加显然是由于富商和居民的囤积所致。春节（2月8日）前，每担煤球的价格为5美元，而目前的价格在每担7美元至7.20美元之间。

上海市热水业同业公会，位于九江路202号301室，于1939年8月26日成立，拥有550家会员店铺，涵盖公共租界和法租界。1940年1月23日，该公会指派四名代表拜访虞洽卿先生和袁履登先生，请求他们协助向福州路30号的开滦矿务局提出呼吁，直接向热水店供应开平二号粉煤（热水店使用的特定种类煤炭），而不是通过其授权分销商。1月25日，收到开滦矿务局的回复，称上海市热水业同业公会的呼吁必须转交该局的三家授权分销商处理，因为该局本身正面临供应短缺，难以应对其常规客户的需求。

1月27日，上海市热水业同业公会再次指派相同的四名代表前往天津路405号的煤炭店主协会，为其会员店铺争取煤炭供应。1月28日发出回复，要求上海市热水业同业公会提供最新的会员名单及其各自地址。因此，一份 duly sealed（正式盖章）的450家热水店会员名单于2月5日送交煤炭店主协会。

根据上海市热水业同业公会于2月17日完成的最近一次调查，其会员店铺中停业的数量为300家。2月14日，煤炭店主协会决定向所有热水店业主分发申请表，授权每家业主以98美元的价格从开滦分销商处购买一吨二号粉煤，且此特权仅限行使一次。商品的实际分发将在煤炭店主协会于本地中文报刊刊登公告后进行。

据可靠消息来源获悉，开滦矿务局每月向其授权分销商供应的煤炭量约为4,000吨，包括块煤和粉煤，平均价格为每吨60美元以上。经私下接触，该局管理层不愿披露其与授权分销商协议的具体细节。

page_data.en:
3.

At a meeting held on February 18 by representatives
of 18 Coal Briquette Manufacturing Factories in the offices
of their Owners Association, 405 Tientsin Road, the following
resolutions were passed.

1. That commencing from February 20 a cheap
sale of Coal Briquette at $5.80 per 100
catties be conducted through the local coal
briquette retail shops and that the wholesale
price be fixed at $110 per ton plus a
transportation fee of $2.

2. That an advertisement be published in the
local press urging the holders of orders to
take delivery within 10 days, failing which
orders will be cancelled and money refunded.

In conclusion, in order to cope with the growing
increase in the prices of coal and coal briquettes, it is the
opinion of the people concerned that the matter be dealt with
in the same manner as the rice and flour problems, so that
the prices of these essential commodities may be kept within
reasonable bounds, and rigid precautionary measures enforced
against hoarding and profiteering.
page_data.zh:
3.

2月18日，18家煤球制造厂的代表在其业主协会办公室（天津路405号）举行会议，通过了以下决议。

1. 自2月20日起，通过本地煤球零售店进行煤球廉价销售，价格为每100斤5.80美元，批发价格定为每吨110美元，另加2美元运输费。

2. 在本地报刊刊登广告，敦促订单持有者在10天内提货，否则订单将取消并退款。

总之，为了应对煤炭和煤球价格日益上涨的情况，相关人士认为，此事应以与大米和面粉问题相同的方式处理，以便将这些基本商品的价格保持在合理范围内，并对囤积和牟取暴利行为执行严格的预防措施。

page_data.en:
F 30/12.

Translation of letter to Council from
the Shanghai First Special District
Citizens' Federation.

Dated 7th February, 1940.

Coal Prices.

The prices of commodities in Shanghai have been greatly
increased especially that of coal. Before the local hostilities
coal was sold at some ten dollars odd per ton, but now the price
has reached the height of between $160.00 - 170.00. Coal is
necessary in daily life and it supplies the motive power in all
industrial enterprises. Consequent upon the rise in the price of
coal the Shanghai Waterworks Company, the Shanghai Power Company,
various hotels, restaurants, bath houses, hot water shops, etc.
all increased their charges. The livelihood of the people has
been seriously affected. Many factories have been forced to
reduce the number of their employes owing to the high price of
coal. Some factories have raised the prices of their products
to balance the rise in the cost of production; hence the
abnormal conditions in Shanghai.

In view of the above we consider it of first importance
to force down the price of coal as in the case of rice. We beg
the Council to set a limit to the price of coal, to instruct
the various coal shops to strictly observe the fixed price, to
ascertain the present stocks in Shanghai, to prosecute profiteers
and to facilitate the importation of coal. As this matter has
a very serious bearing on the livelihood of the people, and
the peace and safety of the city, we earnestly beg the Council
to take prompt action.

(Chopped) Secretariat, Shanghai First Special District
Citizens' Federation.

上海第一特别区市民联合会致工部局信函译文。

日期：1940年2月7日。

煤价。

上海各类商品价格大幅上涨，尤其是煤炭。在当地战事发生前，煤炭售价约为每吨十余元，但目前价格已高达160.00至170.00美元之间。煤炭为日常生活所必需，也是所有工业企业的动力来源。由于煤价上涨，上海自来水公司、上海电力公司、各家旅馆、餐馆、浴室、热水店等均提高了收费。民众生计受到严重影响。许多工厂因煤价高昂而被迫减少雇员人数。有些工厂则提高产品售价以平衡生产成本的增长；因此上海出现了异常状况。

鉴于上述情况，我们认为当务之急是像对待大米一样压低煤价。我们恳请工部局限定煤价，指令各煤店严格遵守规定价格，查明上海目前的库存，起诉囤积居奇者，并便利煤炭进口。由于此事关系到民众生计以及城市的和平与安全，我们 earnestly 恳请工部局迅速采取行动。

（盖章）上海第一特别区市民联合会秘书处。

J. D. CHEN & COMPANY

260 Avenue Edward VII,
Shanghai, February 14, 1940.

G. Godfrey Phillips, Esq.,
Secretary General,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Sir,
Re: Small shops supplying hot water to the poors
in this Settlement.

With regards to the above, I have received many reports
stating that, up to this moment, they are still not in a position
to reopen for business due to the abnormally high of coal price.
Under such circumstance, the great number of the poors in this
Settlement, who are usually using hot water by purchasing from
small hot water shops, are meeting a great difficulty; and
consequently it would effect their health condition badly.

Of course, this might be a minor important problem among the
problems of importance. But for the sake of public health as well
as charity, I believe our Council must be able to do something
against the coal dealers who are quoting the unrational price
towards those small poor hot water shops.

I am responsible to give you the following facts for your
reference;
1.- that the original selling price of Kaiping dust No.2 (the
particular kind of coal desirable to the hot water shops) was
fixed by Kailan Sales office for Messrs. Yuan-Tai, Ye Tai Shing,
and Hwa Tung, the three authorized distributors of the said coal,
at $47.50, local dollars, per ton, and
2.- that not long ago, the Guild of the hot water shops has
approached the said three distributors, with a moral support of
Mr. Yu Ya Ching, requesting them to take this business partially
on the basis of public welfare and to sell that dust coal at the
price not over $95.00 per ton, but that was unaffectionately
declined.

Judging from these facts, the three distributors seem to be
very unfair and thus they drive the small hot water shops into
compulsory wind-up. Thereafter a great number of poors have to
run out of this daily necessity of hot water. Now the only hope
for the poors to cure the pending situation is OUR COUNCIL'S
PROPER MEASURES.

Yours faithfully,

J. D. Chen.

J. D. CHEN & COMPANY（陈氏公司）

上海爱多亚路260号，
1940年2月14日。

致：
G. Godfrey Phillips 先生，
秘书长，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

先生：
事由：本租界内为穷人供应热水的小店。

关于上述事项，我收到许多报告称，截至目前，由于煤价异常高昂，这些小店仍无法重新开业。在这种情况下，本租界内大量通常通过向小热水店购买来获取热水的贫困人群正面临巨大困难；因此，他们的健康状况将受到严重不良影响。

当然，在众多重要问题中，这可能是一个次要问题。但为了公共卫生以及慈善起见，我认为我们工部局必须能够针对那些向贫困小热水店报出不合理价格的煤商采取一些措施。

我有责任向您提供以下事实供参考：
1.- 开平二号末煤（热水店所需特定种类的煤）的原售价由开滦销售处定为每吨47.50元（本地货币），指定分销商为源泰、叶泰兴和华通三家商行，且
2.- 不久前，热水业公会在虞洽卿先生的道义支持下，曾接洽上述三家分销商，请求他们基于公益部分承担此项业务，以不超过每吨95.00元的价格出售该种末煤，但遭到冷漠拒绝。

从这些事实来看，这三家分销商似乎非常不公平，从而迫使小热水店被迫停业。此后，大量穷人将无法获得热水这一日常必需品。现在穷人解决当前困境的唯一希望在于我们工部局采取适当措施。

此致
敬礼，

J. D. Chen.

Translation of letter to Council from
Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
Dated 24th February, 1940.

Briquettes.

With regard to the advancement in the price of briquettes
this Chamber has on several occasions urged the machine-made
Briquette Dealers' Association to instruct the various briquette
factories to increase their output to the maximum with the view
to forcing down the price. The coal dust used in the manufacture
of briquette is obtained from mines in Annam. Each day the
Shanghai Market requires 1,000 tons of dust, or 30,000 tons
per mensem; the dust is shipped to Shanghai via Haiphong. At
present the freight has been greatly increased; this also adds to
the cost of briquettes and to the difficulty of forcing the price
down. After repeated consultations with people in the briquette
business, it has been decided that the only way to solve the
question is to beg the Council to call a meeting of the responsible
persons of various steamship companies, and request them to lower
the freight so that briquette factories may increase their output
and sell at reduced prices. As this proposal, if carried out,
will tend to stabilize the livelihood of residents, the Council
is requested to give it support.

(Chopped) Wong Hsiao-lei, Chairman.
Zi Chi-ching, Member of Standing Committee.

日期：1940年2月24日。

煤球。

关于煤球价格上涨一事，本商会曾多次敦促机制煤球同业公会指令各煤球厂最大限度地增加产量，以期压低价格。制造煤球所用的煤粉取自安南（Annam）的矿山。上海市场每日需要1,000吨煤粉，即每月30,000吨；煤粉经海防运抵上海。目前运费大幅增加；这也增加了煤球的成本，使得压低价格更加困难。经与煤球业界人士反复磋商，决定解决此问题的唯一途径是恳请工部局召集各轮船公司负责人开会，请求他们降低运费，以便煤球厂增加产量并以降低后的价格出售。由于此提议若得以实施，将有助于稳定居民生计，故请求工部局予以支持。

（盖章）主席：王晓籁。
常务委员：子智清（音译）。

National Herald :-

THEFT FROM RICE SHOPS IN POOTUNG

Many cases of thefts from rice shops have occurred in Pootung. On February 19 several rice shops at Hu Ka Moo Kiao (胡家木桥) were victimized. Post duty puppet policemen and Japanese soldiers did nothing although they saw the thefts. Rice shops in Pootung now close their doors and only leave a small opening to do business.

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following letter received from one Ho Liang (何量) :-

THE CAUSES FOR THE HIGH PRICES OF DAILY NECESSITIES

According to reports from reliable sources, the following are the causes for the sharp increases in the prices of rice, flour and coal briquettes in Shanghai and it is to be hoped that the authorities will take severe measures against such activities:-
(1) The principal element responsible for the manipulation of rice is the proprietor of the - Chong Rice (-昌) located at ---Bridge. He works in conspiracy with the - Chong - Rice Shop (-昌-) at the corner of ---- Road. He was responsible for the sharp increases in the prices of rice taking place after the withdrawal of Chinese forces from Shanghai in the winter of 1937. His activities were slightly checked after the issue of the joint proclamation by the two Municipal Councils but soon afterwards he entered into conspiracy with a foreign concern---- --- & Company and instigated it to enhance the price of foreign rice as a deterrent to joint purchases so as to enable the price of Chinese rice to go up.
(2) As regards flour, the - Kee Shop (-记) on North -- road is at the back of the rising tendency in the price of this commodity. Realizing that Dairen is short of supplies of this class of goods, the shop has ordered large consignments amounting to 350,000 bars of flour from various local leading flour mills, at a price of $4.30 to $4.50 per bag. As a result of this order the flour mills have been rendered short of deliveries for ordinary consumers, thereby resulting in a continued increase in the price. This affords a very good opportunity to make more profits. As it is not convenient to dispose of its purchases in large quantities and with a view to covering its activities from the public, the shop has started a cheap sale at a little

《国民新闻报》：

浦东米店遭窃案

浦东发生多起米店被盗案件。2月19日，胡家木桥的几家米店受害。执勤的伪警察和日本士兵虽然目睹盗窃行为，却未采取任何行动。浦东的米店现在紧闭大门，只留一个小口进行交易。

《中美日报》刊登了一封来自何量读者的来信：

日用品价格高涨的原因

据可靠消息来源报道，上海大米、面粉和煤球价格急剧上涨的原因如下，希望当局对此类活动采取严厉措施：
(1) 操纵米价的主要元素是位于---桥的-昌米行店主。他与----路拐角处的-昌-米店串通一气。1937年冬中国军队撤离上海后发生的米价急剧上涨，他难辞其咎。在两工部局发布联合公告后，他的活动稍受遏制，但不久后他又与一家外商---- --- & Company 串通，唆使其提高洋米价格，以阻碍联合采购，从而使华米价格得以攀升。
(2) 关于面粉，北--路的-记店是此类商品价格上升趋势的背后推手。该店意识到大连此类货物供应短缺，便以每袋4.30至4.50美元的价格，向当地各大面粉厂订购了大量面粉，共计35万包。由于此订单，面粉厂无法向普通消费者交货，导致价格持续上涨。这提供了赚取更多利润的绝佳机会。由于不便大量处置其采购货物，且为了掩人耳目，该店开始以略高于

over $10 per bag for 1,000 bags every day. Ostensibly
this appears to be a benevolent undertaking; in reality
the shop has thus been able to make a profit of about $6
a bag. The present shortage of flour supplies is
attributable to the activities of this shop.
(3) Last year when the price of coal
briquettes began to show signs of increase, the Dah Mou
Factory (大茂廠) made efforts to stabilize the price at
$3.60 per picul. This action on the part of the Dah Mou
Factory incurred the envy of the Nyi -- and six other
concerns. They later detailed persons to order large
consignments from the Dah Mou Factory with the result that
the latter's stocks were all ordered within ten days,
thereby rendering it impossible to meet other demands for
supplies, while on the other hand they lowered the prices of
their own goods to $2.80 or $2.90 per picul as competition.
The Dah Mou Factory started this sale because of the request
of Mr. Yu, but found itself unable to compete with others.
As a result the price of coal briquettes began to soar up to
over $4 per picul. Recently, advertisements were published
in the local Press stating that more than 20,000 tons of such
goods had been ordered for the public. In reality this is
but a kind of smoke screen to defraud the public.

(Editor's note: The letter received from the
writer contains full names and addresses of all those shops
responsible for manipulation of prices of rice, flour and
coal briquettes. This paper has purposely omitted them in
its publication, in the hope that the shops concerned will
quickly come to their senses. As this is a matter that
affects the livelihood of several million local residents,
as well as the peace and order of the district, we request
that local public bodies will ask the various factories and
hongs to stop delivery of the consignments ordered from them
and supply them to consumers among the general public so

每袋10美元以上的价格进行廉价销售，每天1,000包。表面上这似乎是一项善举；实际上，该店由此每袋获利约6美元。目前面粉供应短缺归咎于该店的活动。
(3) 去年，当煤球价格开始显现上涨迹象时，大茂厂努力将价格稳定在每担3.60元。大茂厂的这一举动招致了 Nyi --（音译）及其他六家商号的嫉妒。后来他们派人向大茂厂大量订货，结果大茂厂的库存在十天内被订购一空，导致无法满足其他供应需求，而另一方面，他们将自己的货物价格降至每担2.80或2.90元以进行竞争。大茂厂应虞先生之请求发起此次销售，但发现无法与其他商家竞争。结果，煤球价格开始飙升至每担4元以上。最近，本地报纸刊登广告称，已为公众订购了超过20,000吨此类货物。实际上，这不过是一种欺骗公众的烟幕弹。

POLICE FORCE
FOR INFORMATION
(Initialled)
7.2.1940
Shanghai, February 6th, 1940.
No. S. B. D. / 7555
Date 12 - 2 - 40

The Chief-Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

According to a joint petition submitted by the members
of this Association, Messrs. Cheng Nee-Shen of Sung Yuen, Sze
Yung-lee of Chung Ho Yuen, Chiu Ting-sung of Fu Sung Yuen and
others totalling 340 shops, it states:-

"After the out-break of the local hostilities, our fellow-
traders were notified by the Kailan Coal Mining Company to register
with them the names for direct purchase of their coal, when a few
hundreds of our fellow-traders registered their names with the
said Company and obtained their registration certificates and
their registration numbers. It is, indeed, a good idea to make
the direct purchase of coal, in order to obviate the squeeze of the
broker. Unexpectedly, after the registration, the amount of issuing
coal gradually decreased and they have even now rejected our
fellow-traders to obtain their coal as registered. As the said
Company rejects to supply coal to our fellow-traders, all the coal
shops take advantage of the coal in stock and advance the price
of coal to more than $100.00 per ton, which was formerly sold at
$40.00. We have never encountered such increase before. Although
our fellow-traders have slightly increased the charges of hot-
water to make good their loss, the hot-water concerns too much
with the common people and we have been attacked by the public
criticism. To increase the charge of hot-water at the time when
the price of the coal briquettes is at level makes no difference
with fishing from a drying pond. Consequently, our fellow-traders
are unable to maintain their business and several shops have been
compelled to close every day. It will cause us a complete vanish,
if we let the present condition going on. However, it would,
thereby arouse some critical social problems as follows:-

1. As the result of the suspension of the hot-water shops
and the increase of the hot-water charges, the residents
will no doubt start to boil water themselves. At the present
time, the number of the inhabitants on the isolated island
has greatly increased, living in their houses just like
pigeon holes, it would cause them to run the risk of accidental
fire, if they continually keep their stoves in service day
and night.

2. The unextinguished coal stoves are not only liable to
cause the fire Hazard, but also produce coal ordour to
block up the peoples' respiration, and the ratio of death
in this manner would be consequently increased.

3. The labouring classes are compelled to drink cold
water so they are liable to suffer diseases.

4. About ten thousand persons depend their livelihood
on the hot-water shops in this Municipality and they
would be turned out unemployed after the suspension of the
hot-water shops.

上海，1940年2月6日。

日期 1940年2月12日

致：
上海公共租界工部局
总巡捕长，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

根据本会会员提交的联合请愿书，松园（Sung Yuen）的郑尼申（Cheng Nee-Shen，音译）、中和源（Chung Ho Yuen）的施永利（Sze Yung-lee，音译）、福松园（Fu Sung Yuen）的邱廷松（Chiu Ting-sung，音译）等共计340家店铺陈述如下：

“自本地战事爆发以来，开滦煤矿公司通知吾等同业向其登记直接购煤名单，当时有数百名同业向该公司登记并获得了登记证书及登记号码。直接购煤以消除中间商盘剥，确属良策。不料，登记之后，煤炭供应量逐渐减少，甚至现在拒绝吾等同业按登记获取煤炭。由于该公司拒绝向吾等同业供煤，所有煤店利用库存煤炭，将煤价从原先的每吨40元提高至100元以上。我等从未见过如此涨幅。虽然吾等同业略微提高了热水收费以弥补损失，但热水供应与百姓生活息息相关，我们因此遭受公众批评。在煤球价格持平之时提高热水费，无异于涸泽而渔。因此，吾等同业无法维持经营，每天都有数家店铺被迫关闭。若让现状持续下去，我们将彻底消失。然而，这将由此引发一些严重的社会问题，如下所示：

1. 由于热水店停业及热水费上涨，居民无疑将开始自行烧水。目前，孤岛上的居民人数大幅增加，居住条件拥挤如鸽笼，若日夜不断生火，将使它们面临意外火灾的风险。

2. 未熄灭的煤炉不仅容易引起火灾隐患，还会产生煤烟气味阻碍人们呼吸，因此以此方式导致的死亡率将会增加。

3. 劳动阶层被迫饮用冷水，因此容易患病。

4. 本市约有万人依靠热水店谋生，热水店停业后，他们将失业。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
The outcome of the above four social problems is surely troublesome
sooner or later, but the real cause of this criticism entirely rests
upon the fact that the said Company refuses to sell their coal to
our fellow-traders. The amount of coal required by our fellow-traders
every month is approximately over 3,000 tons. It is not a small
amount, so we are at a loss to understand why they refuse to supply us.
We hereby jointly petition you to write to the said Company, asking
them to follow the usual registration method by selling their coal
direct to our fellow-traders, in order to waive our difficulties
and we also request you to send circular letters to every powerful
groups and social leaders, asking for their assistance to this effect.
This will be a great favour to our fellow-traders and citizens."

The foregoing petition submitted by our members represents the
true state of affairs. Considering that you are the leader of our
people and are keenly interested in peoples' torture, we trust that
you have given special attention and sympathy to this serious social
problem. We forward herewith their original letter and request that
you will be kind enough to render your valuable assistance to them
and write to the Kailan Coal Mining Company, asking them to follow
the usual method of purchase through registration and sell their coal
direct to our fellow-traders at a reasonable price.

Yours faithfully,

The Chair-man
of the
Hot-water Fellow-traders' Association
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

Encl. One Petition submitted by 340 Hot-Water Shops in Shanghai.

SECRETARIAT NOTE- No enclosure and no address.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
上述四个社会问题的后果迟早会带来麻烦，但这一批评的真正原因完全在于该公司拒绝向吾等同业出售煤炭。吾等同业每月所需煤炭量约为3,000吨以上。这不是一个小数目，因此我们无法理解他们为何拒绝向我们供货。我们特此联合请愿，恳请您致函该公司，要求其遵循常规的登记方法，直接向吾等同业出售煤炭，以解除我们的困难；我们也请求您向各有力团体和社会领袖发出通函，请求他们在此方面提供协助。这将对吾等同业和市民大有裨益。”

前述由我方会员提交的请愿书反映了真实情况。鉴于您是民众的领袖，并深切关注民众的疾苦，我们相信您会对这一严重社会问题给予特别关注和同情。现随函附上他们的原信，恳请您慷慨向他们提供宝贵援助，并致函开滦煤矿公司，要求其遵循通过登记进行购买的常规方法，以合理价格直接向吾等同业出售煤炭。

此致
敬礼，

大上海热水业同业公会

February 1, 1940.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao, Ta Mei Pao, National Herald and Sin Wan Pao :-
CITIZENS' FEDERATION DISCUSSES STABILIZATION OF COAL
PRICES

With the rise in the price of coal, the charges
for electricity, hot water, etc. have likewise been increased,
thereby greatly affecting the livelihood of the poor people.
Acting on a suggestion for joint purchases of
coal as a means to stabilize its price, the Shanghai First
Special District Citizens' Federation held a meeting of the
members of its Executive Committee at 2 p.m. yesterday, at
which the following resolutions were discussed and passed:-
(1) That the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements be requested to fix a standard price for coal
to be observed by all coal trading concerns.
(2) That the authorities be asked to ascertain
the coal stocks in Shanghai.
(3) That public efforts be made to check
hoarding and manipulation.
(4) That a letter be sent to the Coal Trade
Guild asking it to prevent its members from causing
deliberate enhancement of the price of coal.
(5) That the coal hoarders be advised to sell
out their goods on hand so as to stabilize the coal price.
The question of joint purchase of coal, the
meeting resolved, was to be shelved for further discussion.

《申报》、《大美晚报》、《国民新闻》及《辛闻报》：
市民联合会讨论稳定煤价

随着煤价上涨，电费、热水费等也随之增加，从而极大地影响了贫民的生计。
响应通过联合购煤以稳定价格的建议，上海第一特区市民联合会于昨日下午2时召开执行委员会会议，讨论并通过以下决议：
(1) 请求外国租界当局规定煤炭标准价格，所有煤炭交易商须予遵守。
(2) 请求当局查明上海的煤炭库存。
(3) 努力制止囤积和操纵行为。
(4) 致函煤炭业同业公会，要求其防止会员故意抬高煤价。
(5) 劝告囤煤者出售手头货物，以稳定煤价。
会议决定，联合购煤一事留待进一步讨论，暂时搁置。

With reference to the attached newspaper cuttings
from the Evening Post, Shanghai Times and China Press
regarding the hoarding and profiteering in coal, enquiries
show that Pierre H. Dupuy, No.668 Szechuen Road, the Kee
Tai Shing Coal Shop, No.184 Sinza Road, and the Dah Loong
Shing Coal Shop, No.40 Mei Lan Fang Terrace, Rue Amiral
Bayle, are the three chief importers of coal from Indo-
China at present. During the past two months, Pierre H.
Dupuy has imported some 12,000 tons of coal and the majority

Kee Tai Shing has imported some 4,200 tons and 3,600 tons

advantage of its supplies in hand has increased the price
to $46.00 per ton. The small coal shops, however, retail
their stocks at about $52.00 per ton and this would point
to the reason for the high prices prevailing.

High Living Cost
Due To Fuel Rate

Hostilities Increase
Prices On Local
"Food Exchange"

The cost of living in Shanghai
is now much higher than that
prevailing here before the out-
break of hostilities. The mount-
ing price of fuel is, more than
any other factor, responsible for
the general increase, according to
information received from the
National Tariff Commission.

Indices for the five principal
constituents of daily living, name-
ly food, fuel, clothing, house
rental and miscellaneous ex-
penses, it is learnt, all showed
sharp increases for the month of
August. Since September, they
have settled to a more or less
steady trend, although they were
still well over and above the
normal figures in peace time.

An analysis of prices revealed
that fuel has caused the greatest
worry to the housewife, followed
by food and miscellaneous items
but the cost of clothing and house
rental have not risen so precipit-
ously.

The soaring of the price of fuel
is believed to have been caused
largely by a shortage of coal, while
food has become more expensive
by reason of the scarcity of oils
and vegetables.
page_data.zh:
高昂的生活成本
源于燃料费率

战事加剧导致
本地“食品交易所”
价格上涨

据从全国关税委员会获得的消息，上海的生活成本现在远高于战事爆发前在此通行的水平。燃料价格的上涨比其他任何因素都更应对总体增长负责。

据悉，日常生活的五个主要组成部分，即食品、燃料、衣物、房租和杂项开支的指数，在八月份均显示出急剧上升。自九月以来，它们已趋于相对稳定的趋势，尽管仍远高于和平时期的正常数字。

对价格的分析显示，燃料给家庭主妇带来了最大的担忧，其次是食品和杂项，但衣物和房租的成本并未如此急剧上升。

燃料价格的飙升被认为主要是由煤炭短缺引起的，而食品变得更加昂贵则是由于油和蔬菜的稀缺。

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, AUGUST 10, 1937.

Possibility Of Coal
Shortage Again Seen
If Tension Continues

Shipments Of Coal Into City Fall Off 30 To 40
Per Cent In Past Month; K.M.A.
Is Biggest Supplier

There has been no coal shortage in Shanghai due to the trouble in North China, but shipments from the north have been so curtailed that such a situation might presumably come about in another month if there is no change in the Sino-Japanese scene.

It was estimated yesterday that shipments of coal into this city have fallen off from 30 to 40 per cent during the past month. The stock on hand continues to be nearly normal, but since the city's daily consumption is about 20,000 tons this cannot go on indefinitely.

Prices have remained at the same levels, despite the fact that there have been no fixtures on shipping from the Tientsin area for over a month. It is indicated that they may be boosted in the near future, however, unless a change occurs.

Fortunately the largest single stock of coal, that of the Kailan mines, is sent here from Chinwangtao and for the most part on foreign-registered ships. Hence there has been no interruption at all of this source, which represents about 30 per cent of Shanghai's total consumption, or about 5,000,000 tons a year.

Other large amounts are sent from Shantung via Tsingtao, and this is likewise operating unhampered. That from the Tangku region, however, is currently almost nil.

With many spinning and weaving mills, silk filatures, large power, gas and water plants and other big industrial units, Shanghai is naturally the greatest coal consumption center in the Far East and the difficulties in the north have caused anxiety over the possible shutting off of these fields, which account for virtually all the city's supply.

（批：085 / (D.S. R-15) / 04R / 10/8 / 1078）

《大美晚报》，1937年8月10日，星期二。

若紧张局势持续
可能再次出现
煤炭短缺

过去一个月入城煤炭运输量下降30%至40%；开滦矿务局
是最大供应商

由于华北的动荡，上海并未出现煤炭短缺，但从北方运来的煤炭大幅减少，如果中日局势没有变化，这种情况可能会在一个月内发生。

据昨日估计，过去一个月进入本市的煤炭运输量下降了30%至40%。现有库存继续保持接近正常水平，但由于该市每日消耗量约为20,000吨，这种情况不能无限期持续下去。

尽管来自天津地区的航运已有一个多月没有固定安排，但价格仍保持在同一水平。不过，有迹象表明，除非情况发生变化，否则价格在不久的将来可能会上涨。

幸运的是，最大的单一煤炭库存，即开滦煤矿的煤炭，是从秦皇岛运往这里的，且大部分通过在外注册的船只运输。因此，这一来源完全没有中断，它约占上海总消耗量的30%，即每年约5,000,000吨。

其他大量煤炭经青岛从山东运来，这也同样畅通无阻。然而，来自塘沽地区的煤炭目前几乎为零。

上海拥有许多纺织厂、缫丝厂、大型电力、煤气和水厂以及其他大型工业单位，自然是远东最大的煤炭消费中心，北方的困难引起了人们对这些矿区可能被关闭的焦虑，这些矿区实际上构成了该市的全部供应。

（批：085 / (D.S. R-15) / 04R / 8月10日 / 1078）

CS-6, Special Branch,
August 6, 1937.

Situation on the local Coal Market.

The situation on the local coal market remains
normal at the present time. Holdings on Shanghai
wharves, etc. on July 31, 1937 amounted to 256,000
tons.

No difficulties have yet been experienced by
Shanghai wholesalers and companies in moving the
commodity from the mines in the North to Shanghai via
Chingwantao and Tientsin. More tonnage than usual, however,
is passing through Chingwantao, which port is being used
by certain mining concerns in preference to Tientsin, in
view of the present political situation in that neighbour-
hood.

Certain rumours now prevalent in Shanghai to the
effect that the Kailan Mining Administration is in serious
difficulties with regard to its present supply from its
mines in the North, can be looked upon as being entirely
void of truth. Its supply from the North, if anything,
is above the normal import tonnage figures, and no shortage
is expected by the concern in the near future. Neither
does it expect any difficulty in shipping the commodity to
Shanghai via northern ports under the circumstances pre-
vailing there at present.

All local public utility concerns have large stocks of
coal on hand and whilst arrangements have been made to cope
with the situation in the event of shortages occurring, no
apprehension is being felt by any of the managements of
the concerns in question..

Certified true copy.

（签名）

本地煤炭市场状况。

目前本地煤炭市场状况保持正常。截至1937年7月31日，上海码头等地的煤炭库存量为256,000吨。

上海的批发商和公司在通过秦皇岛和天津将煤炭从北方矿区运至上海的过程中，尚未遇到任何困难。然而，鉴于该地区目前的政治局势，某些矿业公司优先使用秦皇岛港而非天津港，导致经由秦皇岛的运输吨位高于往常。

目前上海流传着一些谣言，称开滦矿务总局在其北方矿区的当前供应方面面临严重困难，这些谣言完全可以被视为毫无根据。事实上，其来自北方的供应量甚至高于正常的进口吨位数字，该公司预计在不久的将来不会出现短缺。在目前 prevailing 的情况下，该公司也不预期经由北方港口将货物运往上海会遇到任何困难。

所有本地公用事业公司手头都有大量的煤炭储备，虽然已做出安排以应对可能发生短缺的情况，但相关公司的管理层均未感到担忧。

核证无误副本。

（签名）

THE CHINA WEEKLY REVIEW
July 24, 1937
Where Will Shanghai Get Its Coal When Japan
Starts War in the North ?

THE possibility of a coal shortage worries
Shanghai industrialists. If you don't be-
lieve it, just ask them.
The problem of securing an adequate supply
of coal for industrial projects in Shanghai has
always been a tough one, and now that the situa-
tion in North China has become critical the pos-
sibility of a curtailment of supplies coming from
that region is bringing beads of perspiration to
the brows of foreign and Chinese industrial lead-
ers in Shanghai. Here's how:
Shanghai, the largest industrial and com-
mercial city in China, used about three million
tons of coal in 1935. Shanghai factories consume
about 20,000 tons of coal each day, the most im-
portant users being cotton spinning and weaving
mills, briquet factories, silk filature plants, paper
mills, power plants and water works.
For many years the chief sources of the
coal used in Shanghai has been North China, the
Manchurian provinces and Japan, but as Japan
has become more and more industrialized her
demands on the supplies of coal available in the
Far East have become greater and greater and her
exports of coal to China are decreasing while her
imports from Manchukuo and North China are in-
creasing. Until 1933 much Manchurian coal came
to Shanghai, but since then, the high duty ($4.60
per ton) has made the use of Manchurian coal
almost prohibitive and has stimulated the pro-
duction of Chinese mines.
At least 40 per cent of the coal used in
Shanghai comes from the Kailan mines in the
East Hopei Zone. The mines there have the
largest annual production of any of the mines in
China (about five million tons per year), the
mining cost is only $2.20 per ton, and the trans-
portation costs are small because the coal can be
sent by short railroad haul to Chinwangtao where
it can be shipped by steamer to Shanghai The
long water haul reduces transportation costs con-
siderably.
Second as a source of coal for Shanghai are
the mines in Shantung, which ship coal to Tsing-
tao and from there by water to Shanghai. These
mines, as well as the Kailan collieries, are now
each shipping about a million tons of coal to Ja-
pan every year.
These two regions supply the bulk of the
coal used in Shanghai (about 60 per cent), and for
this reason the recent aberrations in the North
have caused industrialists to fear the possibilities
in the situation.
What can Shanghai do to get the coal it
needs? Well, some coal, mostly anthracite, is
being imported from Indo-China, but the total is
not very great. Attempts were made to find an
adequate supply of coal in Australia, but the
transportation costs were prohibitive. The best
source of supply for coal is still within China it-
self, but here again, transportation costs have
raised the price of coal from its original reason-
able level to an almost prohibitive sum. Never-
theless, even conservative estimates place China
among the leaders of those countries having ex-
cellent supplies of coal. Unfortunately China's
supplies have not been developed, and probably
will not be developed until better transportation
facilities make the coal available at a reasonable
rate to the industrial centers.
The average production cost of Chinese
mines is $3.80 per ton, while the production cost
of the Japanese mines is around $4 per ton.
Nevertheless, the fact that Japanese coal was
shipped by the relatively inexpensive water route,
and Chinese coal came over the fairly expensive
railroad route, has given Japanese coal the pre-
ference in many cases.
Owing to political disturbances, Chinese rail-
roads have frequently been interrupted during
the last decade, and many times have been prac-
tically destroyed. Furthermore, during times of
disturbance, coal cars are frequently conscripted
for the transportation of troops (as Shanghai in-
dustrialists discovered during the Sian crisis).
Other aspects of the problem, such as taxes, must
also be taken into consideration. Foreign owned
mines have been subjected to lower and more
uniform taxes than have the Chinese owned
mines. For instance, the Kailan mines pay a tax
of only 15 cents per ton, while the taxes on Chin-
ese owned mines are frequently many times that
figure. Thus, the high costs of transportation
inland, the frequency of disturbances, the high
taxation, and in some cases mismanagement, in-
sufficient capital, and labour troubles have played
their part in keeping Chinese owned mines in an
undeveloped state.
The Kailan mines in East Hopei, originally
organized by Herbert Hoover, still have the ad-
vantage on the Shanghai market, for the produc-
tion cost is small ($2.20 per ton), the transporta-
tion cost is low, and Kailan has the largest pro-
duction of any mines in China. During 1935
the Kailan collieries marketed their products in
the following districts (production has increased
somewhat since then):
Japan and Korea .................... 516,000 tons
North China ...................... 1,477,000 "
Central China .................... 1,292,000 "
South China ...................... 217,000 "
Other places ..................... 826,000 "

《密勒氏评论报》
1937年7月24日
当日本在北方发动战争时，上海将从何处获得煤炭？

煤炭短缺的可能性令上海工业家们感到担忧。如果你不信，只管去问问他们。
为上海的工业项目确保充足的煤炭供应一直是个棘手的问题，如今华北局势变得危急，来自该地区的供应可能缩减，这让上海的外国和中国工业领袖们额头上冒出了汗珠。情况如下：
上海是中国最大的工商业城市，1935年消耗了约三百万吨煤炭。上海工厂每天消耗约20,000吨煤炭，主要用户包括棉纺织厂、煤球厂、缫丝厂、造纸厂、发电厂和水厂。
多年来，上海所用煤炭的主要来源是华北、满洲各省和日本，但随着日本工业化程度越来越高，其对远东可用煤炭供应的需求越来越大，其对华煤炭出口正在减少，而从满洲国和华北的进口却在增加。直到1933年，大量满洲煤炭运抵上海，但此后，高额关税（每吨4.60美元）使得使用满洲煤炭几乎变得令人望而却步，并刺激了中国煤矿的生产。
上海使用的煤炭中至少有40%来自冀东地区的开滦煤矿。那里的煤矿年产量居中国各矿之首（约每年五百万吨），开采成本仅为每吨2.20美元，且运输成本低廉，因为煤炭可以通过短途铁路运输到秦皇岛，然后由轮船运往上海。长途水运大大降低了运输成本。
上海煤炭的第二大来源是山东的煤矿，这些煤矿将煤炭运至青岛，再从那里经水路运往上海。这些煤矿以及开滦煤矿，目前每年各自向日本运送约一百万吨煤炭。
这两个地区供应了上海所用煤炭的大部分（约60%），因此，最近北方的动荡让工业家们对局势的可能性感到恐惧。
上海能做些什么来获得所需的煤炭呢？嗯，有一些煤炭，主要是无烟煤，正从法属印度支那进口，但总量不大。曾试图在澳大利亚寻找充足的煤炭供应，但运输成本高得令人望而却步。最好的煤炭供应来源仍然在中国境内，但同样，运输成本已将煤炭价格从原本合理的水平推高至几乎令人望而却步的程度。尽管如此，即使是保守估计也将中国列为拥有优质煤炭供应的国家之一。不幸的是，中国的供应尚未得到开发，可能在更好的交通设施使煤炭能以合理费率供应给工业中心之前，都不会得到开发。
中国煤矿的平均生产成本为每吨3.80美元，而日本煤矿的生产成本约为每吨4美元。尽管如此，由于日本煤炭通过相对便宜的水路运输，而中国煤炭通过相当昂贵的铁路运输，在许多情况下日本煤炭更受青睐。
由于政治动荡，过去十年间中国铁路经常中断，很多时候实际上遭到破坏。此外，在动荡时期，运煤车经常被征用用于运送军队（正如上海工业家在西安危机期间所发现的那样）。问题的其他方面，如税收，也必须加以考虑。外资煤矿所承受的税收比华资煤矿更低且更统一。例如，开滦煤矿每吨仅纳税15美分，而华资煤矿的税收通常是这个数字的许多倍。因此，内陆高昂的运输成本、频繁的动荡、高额的税收，以及在某些情况下的管理不善、资本不足和劳工问题，都导致华资煤矿处于未开发状态。
冀东的开滦煤矿最初由赫伯特·胡佛组织，在上海市场上仍具有优势，因为生产成本低（每吨2.20美元），运输成本低，且开滦的产量居中国各矿之首。1935年期间，开滦煤矿在以下地区销售其产品（此后产量有所增加）：
日本和朝鲜 .................... 516,000 吨
华北 ...................... 1,477,000 "
华中 .................... 1,292,000 "
华南 ...................... 217,000 "
其他地方 ..................... 826,000 "

July 24, 1937 THE CHINA WEEKLY REVIEW 267

As as illustration of the large amount of coal coming to Shanghai from areas that would be seriously affected in case of trouble in the north, the following table lists the sources of coal for Shanghai in 1935:
Kailan 1,022,600 tons
Chunghsing Shantung) 397,500 "
Shantung (other mines) 540,000 "
Shansi 160,000 "
Other collieries in China 385,600 "
French Indo-China 112,800 "
Japan 164,700 "
Fushun (Manchuria) 135,600 "

Shansi is considered the Saar of China, but the mines there have not been developed because the long rail haul from Shansi to the coast would make the coal too expensive. Most of the coal that is produced in Shansi is consumed locally, largely because railroad freight costs from Shansi to Shanghai are more than $8 per ton.

In Anhwei the mines are more developed, some of the coal being sent to Shanghai and Japan, but the transportation costs still tend to reduce the market. Mines in Honan have a considerable production, despite the high cost of mining, but only a small percentage of the output finds its way to the Shanghai market, the rest being used locally or being sent to Hankow. Kiangsi, Hunan, Kiangsu and Chekiang also have large deposits, but the mines which are operating in those regions sell the production, for the most part, to local consumers.

Generally speaking, the coal production in China, and the chief coal consumption for that matter, is in the hands of foreign interests. Eighty per cent of the coal used in Shanghai comes from foreign owned mines, from mines containing Chinese capital but controlled by foreigners, or from abroad. Shanghai and the Yangtse Valley get coal from the Kailan (British controlled) mines and from Japan and Chefoo. The Kwangtung area absorbs mainly the anthracite from French Indo-China. And these two regions are the two main coal using regions in China.

Thus, Shanghai industrialists are worried for the following reasons:
1. Most of the coal used in Shanghai comes from North China or Japan.
2. Japan's industrialization has called for a greater and greater supply of coal from China.
3. Chinese mines have been poor sources of coal in the past because of the high transportation costs.
4. Even if Chinese coal would become available to the Shanghai market, any serious disturbances in the North would seriously cut down transportation since coal cars are generally conscripted during times of trouble for the movement of troops.
5. Transportation or production costs make all other Chinese or imported coal too expensive to be used in Shanghai. And what is more important, even in ordinary times shipments of coal from the interior are so uncertain that consumers in Shanghai do not like to depend on the Chinese mines for their regular coal supplies.
FRANCIS W. GAPP

为了说明一旦北方发生动乱，将有大量煤炭无法从受影响严重的地区运抵上海，下表列出了1935年上海煤炭的来源：
开滦 1,022,600 吨
中兴（山东） 397,500 "
山东（其他煤矿） 540,000 "
山西 160,000 "
中国其他煤矿 385,600 "
法属印度支那 112,800 "
日本 164,700 "
抚顺（满洲） 135,600 "

山西被认为是中国的萨尔区，但那里的煤矿尚未得到开发，因为从山西到海岸的长距离铁路运输会使煤炭过于昂贵。山西生产的煤炭大部分在当地消耗，很大程度上是因为从山西到上海的铁路运费超过每吨8美元。

在安徽，煤矿开发程度较高，部分煤炭运往上海和日本，但运输成本仍然倾向于抑制市场。河南的煤矿尽管开采成本高，但产量可观，不过只有很小一部分产出进入上海市场，其余部分在当地使用或运往汉口。江西、湖南、江苏和浙江也有大量储量，但在这些地区运营的煤矿大多将产品出售给当地消费者。

一般而言，中国的煤炭生产，乃至主要的煤炭消费，都掌握在外资利益集团手中。上海使用的煤炭中，有80%来自外资煤矿、含有华资但由外人控制的煤矿或国外。上海和长江流域从开滦（英资控制）煤矿以及日本和烟台获得煤炭。广东地区主要吸收来自法属印度支那的无烟煤。这两个地区是中国两个主要的用煤地区。

因此，上海工业家们出于以下原因感到担忧：
1. 上海使用的大部分煤炭来自华北或日本。
2. 日本的工业化要求从中国获得越来越多的煤炭供应。
3. 由于运输成本高，中国煤矿过去一直是糟糕的煤炭来源。
4. 即使中国煤炭能进入上海市场，北方的任何严重动荡都会严重削减运输能力，因为在动荡时期运煤车通常被征用用于运送军队。
5. 运输或生产成本使得所有其他中国产或进口煤炭过于昂贵，无法在上海使用。更重要的是，即使在平常时期，来自内地的煤炭运输也极不确定，以至于上海的消费者不喜欢依赖中国煤矿作为其常规煤炭供应。
弗朗西斯·W·加普

Special Branch,
July 29, 1937.

SITUATION ON THE LOCAL COAL MARKET

According to enquiries made during the past week,
the amount of coal on hand in Shanghai at the moment is
approximately 250,000 tons, which is almost the normal
amount of holdings on wharves, in godowns and sidings, etc.
This figure is the approximate amount of coal used in
Shanghai for one month.

Quantities of coal have arrived from the North during
the last few days and at present the situation is normal,
or nearly so, but in view of the fact that the greater
part of the coal used in Shanghai emanates from Shansi
and other north-western provinces, and bearing in mind
that practically all of it arrives in Shanghai via Tientsin
and Chingwantao, the future situation in Shanghai in
regard to imports is entirely dependent on the trend of
events between the Chinese and Japanese warring factions
in the north. It is felt, however, by local importers
and dealers, that should the northern ports be closed in-
sofar as exports are concerned, sufficient amounts of
coal can be brought down the Yangtze and up from Haiphong,
to meet local demands, but in this event prices would
naturally rise, since transportation would be more expensive,
further the commodity would be of far inferior quality.

During the last week one or two of the larger local
retailers have increased their average tonnage prices from
$1.50 to $2.50, but taking all dealers as a whole, there
is as yet no increase.
page_data.zh:
特务科，
1937年7月29日。

本地煤炭市场局势

根据过去一周的调查，
目前上海手中的煤炭存量约为
25万吨，这几乎与码头、仓库和侧线等地的正常
持有量相当。
这一数字大致相当于上海一个月的煤炭用量。

在过去几天里，已有大量煤炭从北方运抵，
目前局势正常，或接近正常，但鉴于
上海使用的大部分煤炭来自山西
和其他西北省份，且考虑到
几乎所有煤炭均经天津和秦皇岛运抵上海，上海未来
在进口方面的局势完全取决于北方
中日交战双方事态的发展趋势。然而，当地进口商
和经销商认为，如果北方港口
在出口方面被关闭，仍可通过长江运下以及从海防（Haiphong）运上
足量的煤炭，以满足本地需求，但在这种情况下，价格自然
会上涨，因为运输成本更高；此外，商品质量也将远为低劣。

在过去的一周里，一两家较大的本地
零售商已将平均吨价从1.50美元提高至2.50美元，但就所有经销商整体而言，
目前尚未出现涨价。

( 2 )

It is of interest to note that the Shanghai Power Company
the largest user of coal locally, has made arrangements for
the conversion of all their plants from coal burners to
oil burners in the event of there being a drastic shortage
of coal on the Shanghai market.
Touch will be maintained with local dealers, importers,
retailers and wholesale merchants, and as soon as there
is any indication of a shortage occurring on the Shanghai
market, a further report will be submitted.

CERTIFIED TRUE COPY.
G. Y. C. M Venn

我们将与当地经销商、进口商、
零售商和批发商保持联系，一旦上海市场

REPORT
Date December 23, 1936.

Subject Expected shortage of Coal in Shanghai

Made by D.S.I. Coyne Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the report that a shortage of
coal is expected in Shanghai, I have to report that the
Kailan Mining Administration are unable to state at present
whether they will be able to obtain their usual supply from
North China, owing to the present tense situation. Under
the circumstances that firm is not prepared to make any
statement which might have an effect on the price of
forward sales.

The rumoured shortage has already sent up the
price of coal and Mr. Amano of the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha
states that at the existing price his firm will be able
to supply all local demands from Japanese and Manchurian
sources. This supply can be maintained as long as the
price on the local market is high enough to cover import
duties.

J Coyne

The local coal situation does not appear to be any
easier than when last reported on, on December 18, 1936.
Mentioned in my last report were the figures of
20,000 tons as being the total holdings of coal on hand in
Shanghai. This figure is apt to be misleading, as further
enquiries have shown, but the following lines will clarify
this point. The various grades and types of coal are
divided into two classes :- contract coal and free coal.
The former expression denotes coal for which contracts were
tendered by the various coal concerns and accepted some
months ago for the ensuing winter season at a fixed contract
price per ton. Contract coal is supplied to all public
utility concerns, manufacturing plants in the eastern,
northern and western districts, all hotels, apartment houses
and the majority of larger office-buildings.
Free coal is that which is supplied to the man in
the street who buys direct from the retailer.
Naturally enough, with the output of power, electri-
city, gas, water, plant power, etc. etc., to mention but a
few points, contract coal very greatly exceeds in tonnage
the amount of free coal used in Shanghai. The figure of
20,000 tons given in the previous report, therefore, represents
the approximate amount of free coal now in Shanghai.
The total amount of coal - contract and free - on hand
in Shanghai on December 1, 1936, was 284,000 tons. Since
that time, minute quantities have arrived from the north,
whilst increasing amounts of an inferior grade from the

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. ... / No. S. B. D. 7555 / Date ...）

Subject Situation on local coal market.

Made by D.C. Pitts. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached report dated October 6,
1936 relative to the situation on the local coal market, conditions
have since changed considerably with the result that there is
now a definite shortage of coal in Shanghai which has necessitated
an increase in prices of the commodity.

This situation has been primarily brought about by the
present warfare in Suiyuan as a result of which the Chinese
Government has been compelled to commandeer railway trucks and
wagons for the purpose of transporting troops and war materials
to the zone of operations, a series of moves which have depleted
the rolling-stock of numerous concerns engaged in the mining of
coal and its transportation to such an extent that is now imposs-
ible to bring coal to the various ports on the coast or on the
Yangtsze for transfer to ships en route to Shanghai. In addition
it is believed that the warlike activities now taking place in
Sian may result in still further shortages of coal in the near
future.

Most of Shanghai's supply of coal emanates from Shansi
and other north-western provinces, and that the present Shansi
impasse is thought to be having grave consequences in the local
coal market is the concensus of opinion among dealers here.

During the last few days the retail prices on all grades
of coal have increased from $3 to $8 per ton, and according to
various sources the total holdings of coal on hand in the local
wharves does not exceed 20,000 tons.

This office will maintain touch with the local market and
a further report will be submitted on the prevailing situation
in a few days.

D.C. (Special Branch). [Signature] J. Pitts.
J. S.

主题：本地煤炭市场情况。

制作人：D.C. Pitts。转呈人：[签名]

关于附上的1936年10月6日有关本地煤炭市场情况的报告，此后情况已发生很大变化，导致上海目前出现明确的煤炭短缺，从而 necessitated（致使）该商品价格上涨。

造成这一局面的主要原因是绥远当前的战事，中国政府因此被迫征用铁路货车和车皮，用于向作战区运送部队和军用物资。这一系列举措耗尽了众多从事煤炭开采及运输企业的滚动库存（rolling-stock），程度之深使得如今已无法将煤炭运至沿海或长江各港口，以便转运至驶往上海的船只。此外，据信西安目前发生的军事活动可能导致近期煤炭供应进一步短缺。

上海的大部分煤炭供应来自山西和其他西北省份，当地商界普遍认为，目前的山西僵局正对本地煤炭市场产生严重后果。

在过去几天里，所有等级煤炭的零售价格每吨上涨了3至8美元，据多方消息来源称，本地码头现有的煤炭总库存不超过20,000吨。

本处将继续关注本地市场动态，并将在数日内就当前局势提交进一步报告。

D.C.（特科）。[签名] J. Pitts。
J. S.

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by D.B. Ross C.D.
Discreet enquiries made from various sources and
in spheres affecting importers, brokers, dealers, sellers
and large buyers, have made it quite manifest that no
shortage of coal, with the resultant skyrocketing of prices,
is expected on the local market during the coming months.
There is no likelihood of the Japanese attempting
to corner the market for the very simple reason that they
cannot bring enough coal into Shanghai from Shantung (Japanese
owned and controlled mines) to satisfy this city's require-
ments, and even if they could, they would be acting in a
manner inimical to their own interests, insofar that their
own national needs would suffer. The importing of coal
from Japan is almost out of the question, as a duty a $4.50
per ton is levied on all foreign coal entering this port.
(N.B. Japanese Shantung coal is not considered as foreign.)
Tonnage production figures in the Shantung, Hopei,
Honan, Shansi, Anhwei, and Kiangsu coal-mining areas have
been slightly above normal for the last six months, whilst
the average monthly tonnage imported into Shanghai from all
sources has been 250,000 to 275,000 - again slightly above
the normal figures.
Fairly large stocks are on hand locally, whilst
the fact that the Chinese Government has, until three months
ago, been accumulating huge coal reserves for the rolling
stock of its various railways, can be looked upon as a more
or less annual practice.

通过对涉及进口商、经纪人、经销商、卖家和大买家的各方渠道进行谨慎查询，结果十分明显：在未来几个月内，本地市场预计不会出现煤炭短缺及随之而来的价格飞涨。
日本人试图垄断市场的可能性微乎其微，原因很简单：他们无法从山东（日本拥有并控制的矿山）向上海输入足够的煤炭以满足本市的需求；即使他们能做到，这种做法也将损害其自身利益，因为其本国需求将受到不利影响。从日本进口煤炭几乎是不可能的，因为进入本港的所有外国煤炭均需征收每吨4.50美元的关税。（注：日本产的山东煤炭不被视为外国煤炭。）
在过去六个月中，山东、河北、河南、山西、安徽和江苏产煤区的吨位产量略高于正常水平，而从所有来源进口到上海的月平均吨位为250,000至275,000吨——同样略高于正常数字。

Coal Situati 


Except for considerable increases in prices 
there has been no marked change in the coal situation 
during the month of August. The hich prices now 
prevailing are attributed to the refusal by Japanese 
Authorities to release any apprecieble quantities 
of coal from the huge stocks which they control. 

129,010 tons of bituminous coal arrived in 
Shanghai during the month. This shows a decrease 
of approximately 33,000 tons compared with July's 
figures. An increase of approximately 4,000 tons 
of anthracite coal arrived in port during the month. 
A comparison of tne July and August total arrivals 
of all coal show a decrease of about 30,000 tons. 

Stocks on wharves, however, have increased 
by about 11,000 tons. In view of the fact that the 
demand for coal has not declined in any way it 
must be assumed that certain quarters are continuipg 
the hoarding of this commodity. It is a matter of 
conjecture whether the reason for this hoarding is 
one of possible future financial gain or of military 
necessity. 

It is reliably learned that ship freight 
charges on coal from tne South have been reduced 
by about G.$1.00 during the past two months. This 
would, no doubt, have a marked effect on coal prices 
if it were possible to effeet the release of the 
stocks mentioned in the preceding paragraph. 


It is again necessary to draw attention:to
